CCLauncher is a minimalist Android launcher designed to help reduce screen time and distractions due to all the apps present (like social media apps for example). Unlike traditional launchers, apps are hidden by default.
 Key Features:
 Apps invisible by default (type to search)
 Digital wellbeing tools (screen time tracking)
 Double-tap to lock screen
 Customizable gestures (swipe left/right/up/down shortcuts)
 App renaming/hiding capabilities

 Swipe up to search apps

izzyondroid:com.google.android.projectio.summary: Custom Android Auto launcher, unleash your AA app, unlock more features!
izzyondroid:com.google.android.projectio.description:
XLauncher Unlocked is a custom launcher for Android Auto which will unlock more features in your Android Auto app. It can launch existing / hidden Android Auto screens with root / ADB commands. Classic can be launched without root.
 If using the Xposed module, then it will also hook into an existing Android Auto function, to run some additional code behind it, to make some of the "installed as Google Play" checks always come back as valid, which does not modify the AA app itself.

izzyondroid:com.shub39.grit.name: Grit: Habit Tracker, ToDo List
izzyondroid:com.shub39.grit.summary: Simple to-do list & habit tracker with streaks, analytics and widgets
izzyondroid:com.shub39.grit.description:
Grit combines a to-do list and a daily habit tracker in one focused, ad-free app — so you can plan your day and build routines in the same place.
 Whether you want a simple checklist, a habit streak, or a measurable goal, Grit keeps everything on your phone, offline and in sync.
 ▸ TASKS THAT STAY ORGANIZED * Categorize tasks into custom lists * Add subtasks by long-pressing a task * Set per-task reminders and mark tasks done straight from the notification * Drag to reorder your list, and reorder automatically as tasks are completed
 ▸ HABITS THAT ACTUALLY STICK * Yes/No habits and Measurable habits with a target value and unit (8 km, 3 hours, 10 pages…) * Choose which days of the week each habit runs on * Get a daily reminder for any habit * Current streak, the best streak and consistency score for every habit
 ▸ SEE YOUR PROGRESS * Habit heat map and calendar view of completed days * Weekly comparison charts, up to a full year of history * Week day breakdown to find when you are most consistent * Monthly and overall analytics across all your habits
 ▸ BUILT FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN * Four widgets: All Tasks, Habit Overview, Habit Streak and Habit Week Chart * Live widget previews and quick refresh
 ▸ MAKE IT YOURS * Material 3 Expressive design with Material You wallpaper colours * AMOLED dark theme, custom fonts and custom colour palettes * Biometric app lock, 24-hour clock, and configurable week start * Adapts to tablets, foldables and desktop
 ▸ YOUR DATA, YOUR DEVICE * Works fully offline — no account required * Export and restore your data any time * Open source, GPL-3.0 * Available in 35+ languages
 Grit Plus unlocks extra themes, unlimited habits, subtasks and full analytics. Prefer everything unlocked? The FOSS variant on GitHub and F-Droid includes every feature for free.
 Made with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Open source under GPL-3.0 — contributions welcome.

fdroid:com.passpony.android.name: PassPony: Git Password Manager
fdroid:com.passpony.android.summary: Password manager for pass and passage stores, synced with git
fdroid:com.passpony.android.description:
PassPony opens and edits pass (OpenPGP) and passage (age) password
stores. Your keys, your files, synced with your own git remote.
There is no server and no account. The store is just files, the
same format the pass and passage command line tools use, so it
stays interoperable with desktop clients.
Features:
* Browse and search entries across a pass or passage store
* One-time codes: scan a QR code, paste an otpauth link, or type
 the key; live codes with a countdown ring, in the same format
 pass-otp uses
* Password generator with length and character-class options
* An ephemeral clipboard that clears itself after 45 seconds
* Git sync: clone, push, and per-entry conflict resolution
* System Autofill. Only entry names are indexed; nothing decrypts
 until you fill
* Biometric unlock with a shared grace window
* A Diagnostics screen with a copyable report for support
 requests, with nothing secret in it
* Localized in English, Spanish, French, German, Simplified
 Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian, with live in-app
 language switching
* A first-run tour: pick a language, choose a format, clone an
 existing store or import keys, add a first entry, and turn on
 autofill without leaving the app
Open source, Apache-2.0. The crypto core is a separate,
independently auditable Rust library shared with PassPony iOS.

fdroid:com.santiagorodriguez.countaway.name: CountAway
fdroid:com.santiagorodriguez.countaway.summary: Count days to or from dates with local home-screen widgets
fdroid:com.santiagorodriguez.countaway.description:
CountAway keeps important dates simple and visible on your home screen.
Create multiple local events and choose whether each one counts down to a future date or counts up from a start date. Pick an event type or custom icon and add compact or resizable widgets. Fixed widgets support both count directions, while Next countdown automatically follows your nearest upcoming count-down event.
Add an optional time to an event for live hours, minutes and seconds on Home. A dedicated live-hours widget is designed specifically for timed events, alongside the classic day-count widgets. For distant dates, it can show days and a running clock when space allows.
Count-down events can optionally repeat weekly, monthly, or yearly. Monthly dates keep their original day when possible and use the last valid day in shorter months. Optional local reminders can alert you on the event day or 1, 3, or 7 days before.
Reset an eligible date-only count-up to today from Home, with confirmation and Undo. Share an event as a local image card, import or export JSON backups manually, and switch between English, Español, and Català or follow the system language.
Automatic event backups are optional and off until you enable them. Verified JSON copies go to Downloads/CountAway by default on Android 10+, or to a folder you choose. Android 8–9 asks you to select a folder. CountAway aims to keep seven distinct verified copies when safe cleanup is available; restore events with Import.
CountAway works without accounts, ads, analytics, or an Internet permission. Event data stays local unless you choose to save a backup through a document provider, which may sync that file independently.

fdroid:de.kromke.andreas.safmediascanner.description:
Scans SAF (Storage Access Framework) paths for audio files and builds a database to be used by Unpopular Music Player or Opus 1 Music Player. Contrary to the Android service it knows about composers, works, movements, conductors etc.
 Application Field: 
* The SAF scanner can access USB memory devices, like USB sticks via OTG adapter, in Android 6, 7 and 8. Note that Android 9 and 10 natively allow (read) file access to USB memory, just like to SD cards.
* The SAF scanner can extract album art on SD cards and USB memory devices, this is currently not possible with the classical scanner, because without SAF it is limited to read-only access.
* The SAF scanner can access SMB or SFTP servers, if the respective document provider is installed.
* The SAF scanner even deals with non-seekable files by reading them completely into memory before further processing.
 Features: 
* Can be run manually whenever audio files have been added, removed or changed.
* Auto scan (incremental) or complete scan (rebuild) selectable.
* Various audio file types (mp3, mp4, flac, ogg, ...).
* Multi CD albums: sub-subdirectories "CD1", "CD2", ..., with common folder image.
* Common and non-common text tags.
* Composer and grouping (work, movements).
* Proprietary Apple iTunes tags for classical music.
* Extracting of embedded images if none already exists.
* Downscaling of both extracted and existing album images.
* Original images can be kept as backup, if desired.
* Maximum image size is configurable.
* Creates a standard SQLite database in /ClassicalMusicDb that can be accessed from PC or other apps.

fdroid:de.singular.writer.name: Pocket Prose
fdroid:de.singular.writer.summary: A writing app for a folder of Markdown notes, filed by tag.
fdroid:de.singular.writer.description:
Pocket Prose is a writing app for Android. If you write and don't know what Markdown is, this app might be for you. If you're looking for a Markdown editor with a preview pane, it might not.
Point it at a directory full of Markdown files or start building your notebook from scratch — no storage permission needed. Notes are filed by the tags in their frontmatter, nested with /, and nowhere else.
Uninstall it and the folder is byte-identical to how it found it, apart from edits you actually made.
It was built for a personal archive of lyrics and prose, a couple of hundred notes written over years, which is why it is opinionated about leaving things alone.
Early-stage release — expect rough edges. Feedback and bug reports welcome via Issues.
 What it will not do 
This is the point of the app rather than a list of missing features.
* No renaming files to match their titles, no injecting IDs or app-owned keys into frontmatter, no rewriting frontmatter it did not itself change.
* No importing into an internal database. No required folder layout, naming scheme or index file.
* No auto-deleting a note because its file vanished, and no auto-merging when one changes underneath it — a synced folder does that. Conflicts are surfaced, never resolved for you.
* No cloud account, no telemetry, no network permission.
 Filed by tag 
* A tag tree read from the frontmatter tags: list and nothing else. F# in a lyric is a sharp; a #hashtag in the text is text.
* Nesting with /, filtering by a parent takes its children, and a tag can be renamed across the folder — the children go with it.
* Pin a note by tag: notes carrying the pin tag sit at the top of the library, whatever the sort. It is an ordinary tag in every other way, so it syncs with the note and outlives the app.
* A folder that still keeps its tags and titles in the text — as another editor's export left them — gets a one-time offer to move them into the frontmatter, with a count of what would change. The zip export can write them back.
 Reading and writing 
* Titles come from the frontmatter, never from the file name — the two often differ, and duplicate titles across files stay separate notes.
* Dates come from the file. A note written in 2015 is dated 2015, not the day the app first saw it, and re-filing a note under another tag does not move its date; only writing does.
* Relative images and attachments resolve against the note's own folder, so a chord diagram in attachments/ renders and a linked PDF opens in an external viewer. Add an image and it is written beside the note, not into the app.
* A plain editor that writes ordinary Markdown and rewrites none of yours. A source view shows the note with nothing hidden. Headings render as headings, and a --- under a line of text stays a rule rather than turning the line into a heading.
* Scratch lines: start a line with a + glued to the text and it shows dimmed while you write; an eye button reads the note without them. It is plain text in the file, and the app never adds or removes one.
* Saves are atomic — temp file plus rename — so a sync client never sees a half-written note.
 The library 
* Full-text search, filter by tag, by attachments, or down to duplicate titles.
* Sort by last change, by creation date, title or length; full rows or compact ones; a start tag to open on.
* Share text from any app into a new note. Long-press the icon for New note and Search.
* Select several notes to retag, merge or delete them.
* Export the whole folder as a zip, byte for byte, with each note's entry dated as the note is.
 Reading comfort 
* Literata or EB Garamond for the notes, or the system font; five text sizes and three line spacings.
* Light, dark or system theme. English and German.
 License 
GPL-3.0-only. The icon and the wordmark are CC BY 4.0; the name is not licensed, so a fork needs its own.

fdroid:io.github.exclude0122.xivpn.name: XiVPN
fdroid:io.github.exclude0122.xivpn.description:
XiVPN is a GUI wrapper for Xray that utilizes Android's built-in VPN feature to route internet traffic through the Xray core.
It aims to provide an intuitive user interface for all common Xray configurations, allowing non-technical users to take advantage of powerful features without writing complex JSON files.
What is Xray?
Xray is a high-performance network proxy tool that supports multiple protocols including VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, and more. Unlike traditional VPNs that route all traffic through a single server with standard protocols, Xray offers more flexibility and stealth capabilities. This makes Xray widely used in regions with high internet censorship where traditional VPNs (like WireGuard and openvpn) blocked.
What unique does XiVPN offer?
- Proxy Chains: Connect multiple proxy servers in sequence to create layered tunnels for better privacy
- Proxy Group: Organize servers into groups and easily switch between different servers
- Routing Rules: Routes internet traffic to different servers or groups based on IP address, port number, and domain name
- Separate process for Xray core: Runs the Xray core as a separate process, preventing memory leaks during restarts and avoiding app-wide crashes caused by core panics

fdroid:net.typeblog.shelter.name: Shelter
fdroid:net.typeblog.shelter.summary: Isolate and run multiple instances of apps using Work Profiles
fdroid:net.typeblog.shelter.description:
Shelter is a Free and Open-Source (FOSS) app that leverages the "Work Profile" feature of Android to provide an isolated space that you can install or clone apps into.
For a full description, please read from the Git repository of Shelter. A summary is provided below.
The main use-cases of Shelter include:
- Installing apps inside a work profile for isolation
- "Freeze" apps inside the work profile to prevent them from running or being woken up when you are not actively using them
- Installing two copies of the same app on the same device
Note that Shelter depends on the Work Profile feature of the Android system, so any bugs related to Work Profiles in the Android-derived system you are using will affect Shelter. In addition, Shelter can only be as secure as the Work Profile implementation.

flathub:org.freecol.FreeCol.name: FreeCol
flathub:org.freecol.FreeCol.description:
The FreeCol team aims to create an Open Source version of Colonization (released under the GPL). 
 At first we'll try to make an exact clone of Colonization. 
 The visuals will be brought up to date with more recent standards but will remain clean, simple and functional. 
 Certain new 'features' will be implemented but the gameplay and the rules will be exactly the same as the original game. 
 Examples of modern features are: an isometric map and multiplayer support.
 This clone will be developed incrementally and result in FreeCol 1.0.0 which will be an almost exact Colonization clone. 
 Incremental development basically means that we'll add features one at a time. 
 This allows us to have a running program at all times and also to release an unfinished but working game once in a while.
 Once FreeCol 1.0.0 is finished we'll start working towards FreeCol 2.0.0. 
 FreeCol 2 will go beyond the original Colonization and will have many new features, it will be an implementation of our (and our users') image of what Colonization 2 would have been.

flathub:org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp.name: Godot 3 (C#/.NET)
flathub:org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp.description:
NOTE: This Flatpak is unofficial and not supported by Godot Engine developers. 
 Find officially supported binaries on godotengine.org.
 The feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. Godot Engine provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games without having to reinvent the wheel. Games can be exported in one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) as well as mobile (Android, iOS), web-based (HTML5) platforms and consoles (Switch, PS4 and Xbox One - via thirdparty publishers).
 Completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached, no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours down to the last line of engine code. Godot's development is fully independent and community-driven, empowering you to help shape the engine to match your expectations. It is supported by the non-profit Godot Foundation.
 Create games with ease, using Godot's unique approach to game development:
 Nodes for all your needs. Godot comes with hundreds of built-in nodes that make game design a breeze. You can also create your own for custom behaviors, editors and much more.
 Flexible scene system. Create node compositions with support for instancing and inheritance.
 Visual editor with all the tools you need packed into a beautiful and uncluttered context-sensitive UI.
 Friendly content creation pipeline for artists, level designers, animators and everything in between.
 Persistent live editing where changes are not lost after stopping the game. It even works on mobile devices!
 Create your own custom tools with ease using the incredible tool system.
 Limitations of the Flatpak version:
 Although built with Mono 6, this Flatpak uses .NET 8 for building C# solutions in Godot projects. To (re)build a C# solution in the Godot editor, make sure that "Editor -> Editor Settings --> Mono --> Builds --> Build Tool" is set to "dotnet CLI", and not "MSBuild (Mono)", before (re)building the C# solution, otherwise Godot won't be able to find MSBuild. It should be set to "dotnet CLI" by default, but if it isn't, reset it by going to the editor settings as previously described.
 C#/.NET/Mono external editor support does not work out-of-the-box, though this is currently being discussed and worked on. See: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.GodotSharp/issues/2 and https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp/issues/2
 External script editors are still supported (for use outside of Mono), but you need to follow the steps described here: https://github.com/flathub/org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp#using-an-external-script-editor
 After the first C# script is created, it is necessary to click build within Godot. Alternatively, running dotnet restore in the IDE's terminal would work as well.
 For projects using text-to-speech, make sure libspeechd is installed on your system, so that this Flatpak can access it.

fedora-packages:boinc-client/boinc-clien.name: boinc-client
fedora-packages:boinc-client/boinc-clien.description: The Berkeley Open Infrastructure for Network Computing (BOINC) is an open- source software platform which supports distributed computing, primarily in the form of "volunteer" computing and "desktop Grid" computing. It is well suited for problems which are often described as "trivially parallel". BOINC is the underlying software used by projects such as SETI@home, Einstein@Home, ClimatePrediciton.net, the World Community Grid, and many other distributed computing projects. This package installs the BOINC client software, which will allow your computer to participate in one or more BOINC projects, using your spare computer time to search for cures for diseases, model protein folding, study global warming, discover sources of gravitational waves, and many other types of scientific and mathematical research.

fedora-packages:boost/boost-numpy3.description: The Boost Python Library is a framework for interfacing Python and C++. fedora-packages:conda/conda.description: Conda is a cross-platform, Python-agnostic binary package manager. It is the package manager used by Anaconda installations, but it may be used for other systems as well. Conda makes environments first-class citizens, making it easy to create independent environments even for C libraries. Conda is written entirely in Python. The Fedora conda base environment is special. Unlike a standard anaconda install base environment it is essentially read-only. You can only use conda to create and manage new environments.

fedora-packages:credentials-fetcher/cred.summary: Credentials Fetcher Service is used to connect to Active Directory from Linux Instances
fedora-packages:credentials-fetcher/cred.description: Credentials-fetcher is a Linux daemon that retrieves gMSA credentials from Active Directory over LDAP. It creates and refreshes kerberos tickets from gMSA credentials. Kerberos tickets can be used by containers to run apps/services that authenticate using Active Directory. fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-ext-anchorlink
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.summary: Flexmark extension to generate anchor links for headers
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains an extension for generating anchor links for headings using a GitHub-compatible ID algorithm, with options for the rendered HTML tags.

fedora-packages:golang-github-inconshrev.description: Go-vhost is a simple library that lets you implement virtual hosting functionality for different protocols (HTTP and TLS so far). Go-vhost has a high-level and a low-level interface. The high-level interface lets you wrap existing net.Listeners with "muxer" objects. You can then Listen() on a muxer for a particular virtual host name of interest which will return to you a net.Listener for just connections with the virtual hostname of interest. The lower-level Go-vhost interface are just functions which extract the name/routing information for the given protocol and return an object implementing net.Conn which works as if no bytes had been consumed. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/inconshreveable/go-vhost

firefox-addons:2815308.name: Cache Disabler
firefox-addons:2815308.summary: Ensure you get the latest changes during web development.
firefox-addons:2815308.description:
Effortlessly disable the browser cache. 
Add a hostname (domain) and all requests originated from that domain will always be fresh.
Plus, there's no need to re-enable hostnames upon browser restart. All settings are persisted.
This extension is quite similar to the "disable cache" function in Developer Tools.
But without the need to keep them continuously open.
Made by Alejandro Akbal, https://akbal.dev.
This extension is proudly open source.
 https://github.com/AlejandroAkbal/Cache-Disabler-Extension

firefox-addons:2880172.description:
Translate lyrics displayed in Spotify’s web player into your chosen language. With seamless multilingual support and an intuitive interface, enjoy real-time lyric translations while listening to your favorite songs. 
Install with ease and select your preferred target language directly from the extension’s popup. A new translation button will appear on the player interface allowing you to toggle the translation !

firefox-addons:2983208.name: Simple AI Translator
firefox-addons:2983208.summary: Lightweight AI translator for popup input and on-page selected text.
firefox-addons:2983208.description:
Simple AI Translator is a focused browser extension for fast, everyday translation workflows.
Key features:
 Popup translation for typed or pasted text
 On-demand dictionary lookup for eligible short input
 Selection translation with a floating action button and draggable result bubble
 Script-aware language direction assistance for common Latin/CJK input
 Configurable AI provider endpoint (OpenAI-compatible APIs)
How it works:
 Translate text in the popup
 Or select text on any page and translate inline
 Optionally review dictionary-style meanings when lookup is available
Privacy and data:
 The extension stores only required settings (such as provider configuration and language preferences)
 Source and translated text are not persistently stored as translation history
 Translation requests are sent to the user-configured third-party provider endpoint for processing
Permissions:
 storage: save extension settings
 Host access (<all_urls>): enable user-triggered selected-text translation on visited pages

firefox-addons:617244.name: Download Notifications
firefox-addons:617244.summary: Native notification integration for completed downloads.
firefox-addons:617244.description:
This add-on creates native notifications when a download is completed in the browser. The frequency and persistence of these notifications is highly customizable in the addon's preferences page which can be found by navigating to about:addons, selecting the Download Notifications addon, and opening the "Preferences" tab. 
Features:
- Customize when notifications should be automatically dismissed from the system tray or not
- Selectively skip notifications for temporary or other user-customizable file patterns
- Customizable sound cues to play when a download is completed
This project is open source and MIT licensed. For bug reporting and feature requests, please create an issue on this project's github page: https://github.com/ion201/gnome-download-notify

firefox-addons:2948507.name: Multiple PDFs Downloader - Download Bulk PDF Files
firefox-addons:2948507.summary: Download all PDF files linked on a webpage with a single click.
firefox-addons:2948507.description:
Multiple PDFs Downloader lets you instantly download all PDF files linked on a webpage with just one click. No more wasting time clicking links one by one. This tool finds every PDF for you and saves them all at once.
Features:
🖱️ One-click bulk PDF download from any webpage
⚡ Fast and lightweight — works instantly without delays
📁 Automatically detects all PDF links on a page
🔒 Secure downloads — files are saved directly from their source
🎓 Perfect for students, researchers, and professionals handling large numbers of PDFs
Simplify your workflow — collect, save, and organize all PDFs in seconds with Multiple PDFs Downloader.

firefox-addons:746917.name: AVG SafePrice
firefox-addons:746917.description:
The best free price comparison and coupon finder online
Save money with AVG SafePrice, the intelligent, convenient browser extension that will find you the best deals for nearly everything you want. 
After installing and enabling the plugin, just search for the item you’re looking for on your favorite online store. From there, AVG SafePrice will automatically check every other trustworthy, reputable shopping website and give you a comprehensive list of the best online deals and free coupons. Then, all you have to do is click on the deal you want, and presto, we’ll take you there and you can finish your purchase.
Shopping around for a vacation? You can even use AVG SafePrice to find and book world-class deals for hotels when you travel, ensuring you have a comfortable, cost-effective place to rest when you’re far from home.
And to top it all off, AVG SafePrice is completely free and unobtrusive, vanishing out of sight when you’re not shopping to cut down on the clutter in your browser. So download AVG SafePrice today, and start shopping smarter, saving money, and making the most of your time online.
 Personal Data We Process 
While using SafePrice, we process the following Service and Device Data: 
 Service data 
Domain name and host Service Provision (36 months) - To identify shopping sites upfront
URL and referrers Service Provision (36 months) - To display discount coupons and price comparison offers relevant to the website that you are visiting
Search query Service Provision (36 months) - If submitted you, to search for relevant products and discount coupons
Product name and price Service Provision (36 months) - To display price comparison offers relevant to the product that you are shopping for
User’s feedback (ratings, comments) Service Provision (36 months) - To tell whether the offers you received are relevant and up-to-date, and collect product feedback
 New Product Development (36 months) - To develop new products based on the user’s feedback
 Device Data 
Internal extension identifier (GUID) Service Provision (36 months) - For ensuring continuous functionality and breaking down entries in database
 New Product Development (36 months) - To measure product telemetry and calculate aggregated statistics
Information on computer or device (browser) New Product Development (36 months) - To obtain usage statistics
Extension information (installation source and time, version and campaign ID) Service Provision (36 months) - To make sure our offers are relevant and product features function as expected
 New Product Development (36 months) - To obtain usage statistics, evaluate our marketing campaigns and perform feature A/B testing
Country Service Provision (36 months) - To make sure our offers are relevant, and collect statistics on SafePrice usage by country
Language Service Provision (36 months) - To make sure our offers are relevant, and collect statistics on SafePrice usage by language

firefox-addons:2781935.name: DualSafe Password Manager & Digital Vault
firefox-addons:2781935.summary: DualSafe Password Manager extension lets you safely manage passwords in one place to autosave, autofill & access them anytime.
firefox-addons:2781935.description:
DualSafe Password Manager extension lets you safely manage passwords in one place to autosave, autofill & access them anytime.
Keep secure and productive with this password management tool. DualSafe Password Manager extension enables you to manage passwords securely & simply in just one place. You only need to remember one single password.
The DualSafe Password Manager plugin can autosave your login credentials in a secure digital vault with your grant. Then the saved passwords will be auto-filled on the sites whenever you need to log into.
With the best password manager browser addon, you don’t need to install a password manager application on your computer anymore. Password management has never been easier with the DualSafe Password Manager extension. Add it to your browser now!
What makes DualSafe the best password manager?
🔒100% Secure🔒
All your data is completely locally encrypted using AES256. Nobody, including us (DualSafe), can access your personal information but yourself.
When it comes to data synchronization, we use HTTPS to transfer the already encrypted data to our cloud server. The whole process is 100% safe because of SSL.
We are not here to just help you remember something but to help you secure everything. We monitor the dark web day and night to make sure you will be informed immediately if your account and password were leaked. We help you check the strength of your password each time you add it to our extension, and give you suggestions to fix it. 
✔️Intuitive and Easy to Use✔️
DualSafe Password Manager extension allows you to save your credentials with just one click. The next time you need to log in, we will auto-fill your username and password. The only thing you need to do is to remember one single password to access our plugin.
Each time you update your account name or password of a site, we will automatically update it for you.
We order your saved account information according to your last update time to make sure you can easily find sites that you visit regularly. A search function is also provided for you to find your favorite ones.
➕Far More Than A Password Manager➕
DualSafe is not just a password manager, but your one-stop digital vault. You can also save your Secure Notes, Payment Info, or Personal Info with us. Once again, everything is safe with us.
🛠️Extra Free Tools🛠️
DualSafe is so proud of providing users with 4 extra free tools: Password Generator, Dark Web Monitor, Password Health, Import & Export.
Password Generator can help you generate a strong and secure password that no one can guess. Don't worry about it being too complex. You don't need to remember it, we help you remember.
Dark Web Monitor can help you monitor sensitive data leaks on Dark Web. We will let you know and give you suggestions once upon we find the leaking sites containing your information.
Password Health is able to check if a password is vulnerable. We will give a low score for weak, reused, or compromised passwords to prevent your passwords from being cracked.
Import & Export allows you to import data from your browsers or other password tools, and export your saved data to a CSV file with just 1 click.
❤️Forget about forgetting passwords from today on. Have your important information at your fingertips with DualSafe Password Manager.❤️

bluejetty:00175004:ios.description:
Nomorobo blocks annoying robocalls, telemarketers, spam texts, and phone scammers from calling your phone. Bring peace and quiet back to your life. Try it for free.
## 3x App Store "App of the Day"
## Featured by Apple as "New Apps We Love"

## PC Magazine Editor's Choice
FEATURES
- Real-time protection from over 10,000,000 annoying robocallers, telemarketers, and phone scammers
- Over 1,500+ new robocallers identified every day
- Important robocalls, like school closings and weather alerts, are able to get through
- Privacy friendly - Never accesses your call logs
- Block or identify robocalls (your choice)
- Protection from text spam and phishing attempts
- Listen to thousands of robocall messages in our database
- Block "neighbor spoofed" calls. These are numbers that are very similar to yours.
## Over 1.5 BILLION robocalls stopped since 2013
## Trusted by over 2,500,000 people every day
AS SEEN IN
- The New York Times
- The Wall Street Journal
- CBS News
- NBC Nightly News
- Wired
- eWeek
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION 
- All plans come with a free trial
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription here: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. 
- When purchasing a subscription, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited.
- Privacy policy & terms of use are here: https://www.nomorobo.com/pages/privacy
TROUBLESHOOTING
- Please don't swipe-up (aka quit) Nomorobo since it prevents us from refreshing in the background.
- If you suddenly can't enable Nomorobo in Settings (it won't stay on), please delete the app, reboot your phone, and reinstall. This clears out an iOS caching issue and will get you back up and running.
- Have other questions? Look here: http://support.nomorobo.com

bluejetty:00084200:ios.description:
READ BEFORE DOWNLOADING: Please expand this description and read the full list of supported devices below to confirm that your device is supported.
TWO LEVELS FREE
Play the first two levels of Lara’s Aztec adventure for free, then unlock levels 3-14 and all DLC via a single in-app purchase.
===
Battle, platform and puzzle your way through the Mexican jungle in an action-packed tomb-raiding adventure. Explore temples, traverse toxic swamps and navigate volcanic caverns to defeat Xolotl, the Keeper of Darkness, before he plunges the world into eternal night.
DUAL PISTOLS AND TWIN STICKS
Carve a path through undead hordes in fast-paced combat, and bolster your arsenal with unlockable weapons and superpowered relics.
BRAIN TEASING AND CHASM LEAPING
Leap, grapple and swing your way past cunning puzzles and trap-laden challenges.
SOLO ACTION OR CO-OP CAPERS
Save the world solo or bring a friend for seamless multiplayer, via local network or online.
PICK UP AND PLAY — AGAIN AND AGAIN!
Beat high scores, tackle side objectives and discover hidden collectables on every level.
TOUCHSCREEN OR GAMEPAD CONTROLS
Customise the touchscreen controls to taste, or connect your favourite gamepad.
===
We recommend playing Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light on iOS 17 or later. You need 4GB of free space on your device, though we recommend at least double this to avoid initial installation issues.
Supported iPhones: 
 • iPhone XR and later
 • iPhone SE 2nd Generation (2020) and later

3 Wins app is a simple, yet effective achievements tracker, that helps bring out your positive thoughts and form a good habit of appreciating your accomplishments during the day. 
Celebrate your daily achievements with 3 Wins. During the d
bluejetty:00023080:ios.description:
3 Wins app is a simple, yet effective achievements tracker, that helps bring out your positive thoughts and form a good habit of appreciating your accomplishments during the day. 
Celebrate your daily achievements with 3 Wins. During the day whenever you achieve your goal or something positive enter it right away into the 3 Wins app. You can also pause at the end of your busy day to summarize and record your wins/achievements. By doing this, your brain will shift more towards positive thinking. 
Track your achievements or personal goals, every day. Stretch your brain and take the good thoughts out before going to sleep and forgetting about them.
=== WHAT IS A WIN? === 
A win can be anything positive you think of that was completed during the day. It can be something personal for example no junk food ate, or you made the bed in the morning. Treat all accomplished tasks in the day as a win and celebrate by checking them off. You can also track your business goals and achievements for the day, for example you met or exceeded your daily sales quota or finished that project you were working on for weeks! 
Appreciate your daily wins more!
=== SAMPLE WINS ===
• No junk food
• Drank 8 glasses of water
• Completed stretching
• Breathe
• Finished workout
• Marketing project completed
• First 5K run
• Had a healthy snack
=== HOW IT WORKS? === 
Each day has a goal to write down at least 3 wins to close the day on green. You can add random completed goals or create a repeating task that you will check off every day. Why 3? We want to stretch your brain and think more on the positive side. There had to be at least 3 things you have completed today?! Did you drink enough water, took a bike to work, parked further to walk more, said thank you, smiled. Any positive task completed is a win! And don’t be tied just to 3, if it was 1 or 10 write them all down!
=== KEY FEATURES ===
• Super simple achievement tracking.
• Calendar view will show you a glance color coded view of your month. Dark green colors mean you have achieved 3 or more wins, lighter colors not quite there, but it is better than none!

listings.name: Daily Achievements with 3 Wins
listings.description:
3 Wins app is a simple, yet effective achievements tracker, that helps bring out your positive thoughts and form a good habit of appreciating your accomplishments during the day. 

Celebrate your daily achievements with 3 Wins. During the day whenever you achieve your goal or something positive enter it right away into the 3 Wins app. You can also pause at the end of your busy day to summarize and record your wins/achievements. By doing this, your brain will shift more towards positive thinking. 

Track your achievements or personal goals, every day. Stretch your brain and take the good thoughts out before going to sleep and forgetting about them.


=== WHAT IS A WIN? === 
A win can be anything positive you think of that was completed during the day. It can be something personal for example no junk food ate, or you made the bed in the morning. Treat all accomplished tasks in the day as a win and celebrate by checking them off. You can also track your business goals and achievements for the day, for example you met or exceeded your daily sales quota or finished that project you were working on for weeks! 

Appreciate your daily wins more!


=== SAMPLE WINS ===
• No junk food
• Drank 8 glasses of water
• Completed stretching
• Breathe
• Finished workout
• Marketing project completed
• First 5K run
• Had a healthy snack


=== HOW IT WORKS? === 
Each day has a goal to write down at least 3 wins to close the day on green. You can add random completed goals or create a repeating task that you will check off every day. Why 3? We want to stretch your brain and think more on the positive side. There had to be at least 3 things you have completed today?! Did you drink enough water, took a bike to work, parked further to walk more, said thank you, smiled. Any positive task completed is a win! And don’t be tied just to 3, if it was 1 or 10 write them all down!


=== KEY FEATURES ===
• Super simple achievement tracking.
• Calendar view will show you a glance color coded view of your month. Dark green colors mean you have achieved 3 or more wins, lighter colors not quite there, but it is better than none!
• Daily general reminder to get things noted.
• Set reminders for your scheduled wins to get reminded to complete them.
• Create wins/tasks that are repeating/recurring.
• Supports Siri Shortcuts.
• Apple Watch app.
• iCloud sync
• Confetti celebration for a full day of wins!

In Airplane Pilot Airport Tycoon, step into the shoes of a new airline pilot with a passion for aviation. Your goal? Build and manage a world-class airport, catering to the needs of thousands of passengers and aircraft daily. From humble beginnings to a bustling travel hub, the sky's the limit!

- Transport passengers to the airport with airport shuttles and taxi-driving
- Put out fires across the islands from the sky as an airborne firefighter
- Take out enemy threats and perform army drills in military aircraft and jets
- Load and deliver important cargo with forklift, truck, and baggage carrier driving
- Real airplane flight physics
- Intuitive flying controls: buttons, joystick, or accelerometers
- Plane crashes and smoke effects.
- Realistic lighting and sound effects
- High-quality world environments with high res satellite imagery
- Highly detailed realistic airplane cockpit environment.
- Multiple on-board cameras to get every angle of the aircraft
- Huge selection of aircraft and vehicles drive
Airplane Pilot Airport Tycoon offers an immersive experience with stunning graphics and realistic gameplay. Choose from a wide range of aircraft, customize your airport's appearance, and watch as your airport comes to life with bustling terminals, busy runways, and happy passengers.
Are you ready to take the helm of your own aviation empire? It's time to spread your wings and embark on an exciting journey as an Airplane Pilot Airport Tycoon. Get ready to build, manage, and dominate the skies like never before!

OnTime Mobile gives couriers the tools they need in the field. Process your assigned orders and keep in constant communication with dispatch.
This app requires an appropriate OnTime 360 subscription. If you are not sure about your company’s subscription or the services you have access to, please contact your IT department.
SIGNAL AVAILABILITY: Keep dispatch informed where you are at, when you are available, and when you expect that to change. Great for independent contractors!
ATTACH PHOTOS: Save photos with an order at collection, delivery, or any stage in between.
COLLECT SIGNATURES: Capture signatures using the touchscreen on your device.
EDIT ORDERS: Make adjustments to an order while on the go, without contacting dispatch.
SELF DISPATCH: Access the unassigned order list to assign an order to yourself, or transfer to another driver.
GPS: Let dispatch know where you are with accurate and consistent location tracking.
BARCODE SCANNING: Use the camera on your device to quickly read a barcode from any label. The app will find the corresponding order on your list and offer appropriate actions.
MAP ROUTING: Use Apple Maps to plot a route from your current position to the address of your next stop.
OFFLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: Continue to work quickly with or without an internet connection. Features continue to work even when offline and will automatically synchronize the results once an internet connection becomes available.
SECURE: Data is transmitted to and from the app securely with encryption.
* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

listings.name: OnTime Mobile
listings.description:
OnTime Mobile gives couriers the tools they need in the field. Process your assigned orders and keep in constant communication with dispatch.

This app requires an appropriate OnTime 360 subscription. If you are not sure about your company’s subscription or the services you have access to, please contact your IT department.

SIGNAL AVAILABILITY: Keep dispatch informed where you are at, when you are available, and when you expect that to change. Great for independent contractors!

ATTACH PHOTOS: Save photos with an order at collection, delivery, or any stage in between.

COLLECT SIGNATURES: Capture signatures using the touchscreen on your device.

EDIT ORDERS: Make adjustments to an order while on the go, without contacting dispatch.

SELF DISPATCH: Access the unassigned order list to assign an order to yourself, or transfer to another driver.

GPS: Let dispatch know where you are with accurate and consistent location tracking.

BARCODE SCANNING: Use the camera on your device to quickly read a barcode from any label. The app will find the corresponding order on your list and offer appropriate actions.

MAP ROUTING: Use Apple Maps to plot a route from your current position to the address of your next stop.

OFFLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: Continue to work quickly with or without an internet connection. Features continue to work even when offline and will automatically synchronize the results once an internet connection becomes available.

SECURE: Data is transmitted to and from the app securely with encryption.

* Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00200002:ios.name: Jump Desktop (RDP, VNC, Fluid)
bluejetty:00200002:ios.summary:
Leave your laptop behind. Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere. 
Jump Desktop is a remote desktop application that lets you securely connect to any computer in the world. Compatible with both RDP and VNC, Jump Desktop is secure, relia
bluejetty:00200002:ios.description:
Leave your laptop behind. Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere. 
Jump Desktop is a remote desktop application that lets you securely connect to any computer in the world. Compatible with both RDP and VNC, Jump Desktop is secure, reliable and very easy to set up. Jump Desktop also supports our own, high performance, next generation remote desktop protocol called Fluid Remote Desktop. 
Easy setup and reliable:
Jump Desktop is very easy to setup; anyone can do it! Just visit: https://jumpdesktop.com on your PC or Mac, click the ‘Automatic Setup’ link and follow step-by-step instructions. You’ll be up and running in no time. Also - not subscriptions!
Secure:
Jump encrypts the connection between computers to ensure privacy and security. Automatic connections are always encrypted by default. Supports NLA, TLS/SSL encryption for RDP. SSH Tunnelling and SSL/TLS encryption for VNC. Fluid Remote Desktop uses DTLS for secure connections.
Powerful features:
* Works with almost any computer and operating system.
* Supports physical mice! On iOS 13 and iPadOS, Jump Desktop supports the accessibility mouse with some limitations. Jump Desktop also supports special physical mice with no limitations. For more information visit https://jumpdesktop.com/mice. 
* Fluid Remote Desktop protocol supports high performance remote desktop and audio.
* Easy and secure setup: Automatically configure your PC or Mac for remote access using Wi-Fi/3G/LTE without worrying about your router settings. Setup as many computers as you like – there are no limits! 
* Built for iPad Pro, iPad, iPhone and iPod
* iPad Pro features: Full support for split-screen multitasking and Apple Pencil. 
* Open multiple simultaneous connections
* Live connection previews
* Protect your server settings using Touch ID
* Connection syncing via iCloud connection syncing
* Advanced Bluetooth keyboard: The best bluetooth keyboard support on the App Store. Shortcuts, function keys and arrow keys - everything works. Also includes macros for keys no available on bluetooth keyboards (i.e function keys)
* SSH tunneling with password and public key authentication supported
* Supports large custom screen resolutions and VGA/HDMI out 
* Full mouse support via touch gestures: left, right and middle button clicks, dragging, scrolling, precision pointer movement
* Multiple gesture support - includes the ability to draw or write using your finger
* Copy/paste: Transfer text to or from your computer using the pasteboard
* HDMI/VGA external monitor support: View your desktop on an external monitor using a cable or AirPlay. Jump Desktop will let you utilize you external display as a true monitor (not as a mirror like other apps on the store). 
* Multi-core rendering engine makes Jump Desktop one of the fastest RDP and VNC engines on the planet
* Full support for Linea and Infinea barcode and MSR scanners. Includes support for E2E encryption.
RDP features:
* Supports RD Gateway
* Supports custom resolutions. Set any resolution you want including Retina resolutions.
* Dynamic RDP resolution updates on Windows 8.1+
* Remote printing: Send print outs from your computer to your iPad/iPhone device (exclusive RDP print redirection feature on the App Store!)
* Folder sharing
* Audio streaming
* Console sessions
* International keyboard layouts
* Multiple monitor support on Windows 7+
* Multi-touch redirection support on Windows 8+
Fluid Features:
* Super high performance, adaptive remote desktop
* Audio streaming 
* Strong encryption built into the protocol
* Connect from anywhere, even restricted networks without requiring networking knowledge
* Clipboard sharing
VNC features:
* Tested with Mac OS X, TightVNC, RealVNC, UltraVNC, Linux (Ubuntu Remote Desktop)
* Secure: Supports SSH tunneling as well as SSL encryption
* Black & white, gray scale, 8, 16 and 24-bit color to help optimize bandwidth
* Multiple monitor support
* Macs: Support locking the Mac's screen and syncing the pasteboard

bluejetty:00163380:ios.description:
Discover WonJo Kids - Award-winning destination for safe, fun-filled learning. 
Exciting games, engaging cartoons, interactive activities and much more.
Join now and experience the new joyful play experience.
Start your free trial of WonJo Premium Subscription now to access all content for the duration of your subscription. Here are the benefits you will get with a WonJo Premium membership:
** INTERACTIVE ACTIVITIES ** 
Embark on an adventure tailored for the intellectual champions of tomorrow! Our curated selection of interactive games, songs, and activities serves as a treasure trove of delightful and educational content, encouraging your little ones to grow, think, and share laughter. We're committed to turning learning into an entertaining journey filled with discovery and creativity.
** EDU-TAINMENT SCREEN TIME **
Say yes to smart screen time with WonJo Kids! Enjoy wholesome digital entertainment through original, educational content crafted and personalized for your child's development. Seamlessly blending contemporary life skills with academic learning, WonJo Kids offers a dynamic mix of interactive games, captivating songs, and engaging activities.
** CURATED EDUCATIONAL CONTENT **
Our games and activities are meticulously designed following educational principles established by Digital Promise, Common Core, NGSS, Head Start, and CASEL. 
WonJo Kids covers a wide spectrum of subjects, from art to assertiveness, storytelling to science, reading to resourcefulness, and empathy to math. Additionally, we provide ample opportunities for social-emotional growth, offering exercises to enhance emotional intelligence, foster constructive dialogue, introduce mindfulness techniques, and nurture environmental awareness.
** TRACK PROGRESS FOR MULTIPLE KIDS **
Make sure to track up to five child profiles across devices, each profile tailored to your child’s own personal progress and preferences. Easily monitor their achievements, track progress, and celebrate their success!
** 100% AD-FREE AND KID-SAFE **
With games, videos, songs, and more, WonJo is the ultimate companion for shaping young minds and unlocking their full potential, all while having a blast!
-Encouraging Growth – We believe in the power of playful learning. Our content is carefully crafted to expand young minds and inspire a lifelong love for exploration.
-Positive Impact – Every video we create supports social-emotional development, encouraging self-expression and the art of friendship through values like respect and empathy.
-Enriched with Music – Catchy tunes and songs to make education an unforgettable experience.
Here's to bright minds and even brighter futures! Come join us: let's learn and laugh together! 
Privacy Policy:
At WonJo Kids, we are committed to safeguarding your privacy and that of your children. We adhere to COPPA & kidSAFE guidelines, ensuring your child's online information is protected without the need for constant supervision during playtime.
https://wonjo.kids/policy/
Terms of use:
https://wonjo.kids/terms-of-use/

Exclusive 8K wallpapers, hand-crafted by real artists. No ads. No subscription required.
Make your lock screen and home screen your own with over 3,000 backgrounds. Download the first wallpaper in every pack free forever — no account needed.
ORIGINAL ART. NEW EVERY WEEK.
• Discover artwork from 39 designers, commissioned directly from each creator and made exclusively for WallpaperZ.
• Every pack credits its designer, with an in-app profile where you can explore their work.
• Each pack is one theme explored ten ways: a coordinated collection for your lock screen and home screen.
• Two new packs arrive every week — 20 new wallpapers to discover.
BEYOND HD AND 4K
• Every wallpaper measures 7,680 × 7,680 pixels — around 59 megapixels.
• The square format gives you room to choose different crops for your phone or tablet.
• Explore different parts of the same image for a fresh look, or download the full 8K file for your desktop.
• Our in-house, patent-pending resizing system automatically adapts your chosen crop to your device's native resolution, so you don't need to store the full 8K image every time.
• Choose the view you love, and we handle the sizing.
FIND YOUR STYLE
• Browse abstract art, minimalist backgrounds and dark AMOLED wallpapers.
• Explore nature, space, landscapes and 3D designs, alongside gradients, retro styles and monochrome artwork.
• Discover seasonal backgrounds for spring, summer, autumn and winter, plus collections for Halloween, Christmas and more.
• Search for a theme you love or explore the whole collection.
FREE TO START. UNLOCK WHAT YOU LOVE.
• Unlock full packs with CoinZ, WallpaperZ's in-app currency.
• Buy CoinZ through one-off purchases, or earn them through daily rewards.
• Spend them on the packs you choose.
• CoinZ never expire, and no subscription is required.
DESIGNED AROUND THE ART
• Explore collections through WallpaperZ's unique, patent-pending interface.
• Spin each pack's thumbwheel to preview all ten wallpapers, with a satisfying haptic click as you move.
• A clean, ad-free experience keeps the focus on the artwork.
YOUR COLLECTION, ACROSS DEVICES
• Your favorites, unlocked packs and wallpaper history — including wallpapers you've applied or downloaded — are saved to your account and synced across devices.
• Sign in on another supported device and your collection is there, ready to explore.
• Use Apple, Google or an emailed sign-in link — no password to remember.
Find your next wallpaper. Make your screen your own.
• Terms & Conditions: https://legal.wallpaperzapp.com/terms.html
• Privacy Policy: https://legal.wallpaperzapp.com/policy.html
• By using our app, you agree to Apple’s Standard License Agreement. https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00046584:ios.description:
Bem-vindo ao nosso aplicativo!
Este aplicativo foi meticulosamente desenvolvido e constantemente aprimorado com um propósito claro: oferecer segurança e gestão social para Condomínios, Residências e Empresas.
Nota Aos Usuários:
Com a flexibilidade como princípio norteador, reconhecemos e respeitamos a diversidade de necessidades dos nossos clientes. Por isso, é possível que as funcionalidades variem de um condomínio, residência ou empresa para o outro, proporcionando uma experiência única e adaptada às suas necessidades.
Se, por acaso, sentir falta de alguma funcionalidade esperada ou enfrentar qualquer desafio, por favor, entre em contato conosco. Estamos dedicados a auxiliá-lo e a compreender melhor suas expectativas.
Sua satisfação é essencial para nós. Agradecemos por escolher nosso aplicativo e desejamos que tenha uma experiência enriquecedora!
Funcionalidades Avançadas do app Atende Portaria Mobile:
■ Personalização Completa (Whitelabel): Customize a solução para refletir a identidade da sua marca.
■ Interatividade em Tempo Real:
○ Atendimento de interfone diretamente pelo aplicativo.
○ Visualização em tempo real das câmeras de segurança.
■ Acessibilidade & Segurança:
○ Entre no seu condomínio, residência ou empresa utilizando:
• Reconhecimento facial.
• Chave virtual.
• QR code passivo.
• LPR (identificação pela placa do veículo).
■ Gestão de Visitantes:
○ Lista de convidados com funcionalidade de auto-cadastro.
○ Permita o acesso de visitantes e prestadores de serviços via:
• Reconhecimento facial.
• Chave virtual.
• QR code passivo.
• LPR.
■ Monitoramento & Comunicação:
○ Acompanhe em uma timeline todos os eventos relevantes.
○ Alertas para situações de pânico, entradas assistidas, emergências médicas e mais.
○ Módulo de portaria para vigilantes com capacidade de interação com usuários.
■ Privacidade & Conformidade: Solução em conformidade com a LGPD, totalmente personalizável (whitelabel).
■ Facilidades & Integrações:
○ Integração com armários inteligentes (lockers).
○ Desbloqueio do aplicativo via biometria ou reconhecimento facial.
○ Agende compromissos, reporte ocorrências, armazene documentos, e conduza assembleias online.
○ Enquetes, murais de recados, gestão de correspondências e mais.
■ Transparência & Gestão: Acesse relatórios detalhados e recursos de auditoria para uma gestão eficiente.
Solução Inovadora da Atende Portaria.
■ Plataformas & Integração:
○ Disponível para web, smartphones, smartwatches e CarPlay.
○ Aplicativos nativos para iOS.
○ Integração com mais de 25 soluções, incluindo Business Intelligence, PSIM, VMS, PMS, Beacon, Parking e muitos outros.
■ Tecnologia & Protocolos Avançados:
○ Tecnologia WebRTC e Protocolo SIP para comunicação eficiente.
○ Hospedado 100% na AWS para máxima confiabilidade e desempenho.
○ Suporte a múltiplas contas e idiomas.
■ Segurança & Privacidade:
○ Criptografia de ponta a ponta, garantindo a proteção dos seus dados.
○ Autenticação robusta utilizando tecnologia tipo blockchain.
■ Personalização & Flexibilidade:
○ Solução completamente whitelabel, permitindo personalização completa.
○ Adapta-se a diferentes necessidades e cenários de uso.
Descubra os Serviços Premium Oferecidos pelas Soluções da Atende Portaria Mobile:
1. Portaria Autônoma
2. Portaria Remota
3. Portaria Híbrida
4. Controle de Acesso
5. Gestão Social

Available exclusively for Netflix members.
By day, manage a shop in an idyllic village. By night, explore dungeons, slay monsters and unlock mysteries in this best-of-both-worlds adventure.
Step into the shoes of Will, a courageous shopkeeper who secretly dreams of becoming a hero in this action RPG. 
Features include:

• Community building. Get to know fellow villagers as you restore prosperity in the small town of Rynoka. Help establish new businesses and watch them grow.
• Crafting and enchanting. Interact with villagers to craft new armor and weapons, and enchant existing equipment to level up your abilities.

Pick a target size of 10 MB, 25 MB, or 50 MB, or choose the quality you want, and compress. It helps you share videos by email or chat, fit upload limits, and save storage space. Compression runs entirely on your device, so your videos are never uploaded for processing.
The free version lets you compress videos one at a time by target size or quality. Batch compression and fine-grained settings are available in the Pro version (one-time purchase).
■ Shrink videos for storage, email, and social media uploads
- You keep seeing "Storage Almost Full"
- Your photo library is packed with videos of kids and pets
- A video is too large to attach to an email or send on WhatsApp or Discord
- A submission form or social platform rejects your upload
- You want to keep 4K footage without it eating up space
- You want to convert H.264 to HEVC (H.265)
- You want to convert MOV to MP4 (Pro)
■ Compress to a target size (Target Size mode)
Choose 10 MB, 25 MB, or 50 MB, and the app automatically works out the resolution, bitrate, and audio settings for you. No technical knowledge needed.
- See the estimated size and resolution before compressing
- Get a heads-up before compressing if the target is unrealistic
- If the result exceeds the target, the app adjusts the settings where possible and compresses again
- Pro lets you set any target from 1 to 500 MB in 1 MB steps
Note: Some videos cannot be reduced to the size you specify.
■ Compress by quality (Quality mode)
- Choose a resolution: 4K, Full HD, HD, SD, or 360p
- Adjust the bitrate to balance quality against file size
- Supports H.264 and HEVC (H.265) codecs
- Pro adds resolution in 1% steps, frame rate changes, and muting audio
■ Compare before and after, then save
View the original and compressed videos on one screen to check the quality before saving or sharing. Replace the original with the compressed version and tidy up your library to free up storage. Pro lets you play both videos simultaneously and delete the original right from the app.
■ Find videos quickly
Thumbnails show file size, resolution, duration, file format, codec, and bitrate, so the largest videos are easy to spot. You can compress videos from the Files app (such as iCloud Drive) as well as your photo library.
■ Background compression
On iOS 26 and later, compression keeps running when you switch to another app. On devices with a Dynamic Island, you can check the progress there.
Note: Compression may be interrupted by system conditions or if you force quit the app.
■ On-device compression, no upload required
All processing happens on your device. Your videos are never uploaded to an external server for compression. Videos stored on your device can be compressed offline.
■ Pro version (one-time purchase)
Pro is a single purchase. There are no monthly or yearly fees.
- Compress multiple videos at once
- Set the target size in 1 MB steps
- Set the resolution in 1% steps and change the frame rate
- Mute audio for an even smaller file
- Convert to MP4
- Keep the original date, time, and location (MOV output also keeps camera information)
- Delete the original video from within the app
- Play the original and compressed videos side by side
- Sort by duration, width, height, and more
- Filter by duration or file format (MP4 / MOV)
- Customize the file name of compressed videos
- No ads
■ How it works
1. Pick a video from the list
2. Choose a target size or a quality
3. Tap Compress
4. Compare before and after, then save or share
■ Requirements
iPhone and iPad running iOS 15 or later
Available since 2020 and trusted by users around the world.
Questions or suggestions? Use Contact in the app settings.

bluejetty:00150092:ios.name: Pizza Simulator!
bluejetty:00150092:ios.summary:
Build Your Dream Pizzeria From Scratch!
Step into the world of pizza making and run your very own pizzeria! Create a wide variety of delicious pizzas including cheese, potato, and pepperoni pies. Expand your kitchen, unlock new areas, hire
bluejetty:00150092:ios.description:
Build Your Dream Pizzeria From Scratch!
Step into the world of pizza making and run your very own pizzeria! Create a wide variety of delicious pizzas including cheese, potato, and pepperoni pies. Expand your kitchen, unlock new areas, hire part-timers, and manage everything from toppings to prices. From dough to delivery, you're in charge of every slice!
[Design & Grow Your Pizza Shop]
Decorate and expand your pizza shop to attract more hungry customers. Reorganize your kitchen layout for smoother operations and create a welcoming dining area to boost satisfaction. Adjust pricing for each pizza on your menu to stay competitive and profitable. The more you optimize your space and service, the faster your store grows!
[Restock the Kitchen, Keep the Oven Hot!]
Order fresh ingredients online using your in-game computer. Whether it's mozzarella, potatoes, pepperoni, or sauce—everything needs to be stocked and ready. Arrange your inventory smartly to keep your kitchen efficient and avoid running out during lunch or dinner rushes. A well-stocked oven is the heart of your pizzeria!
[Run the Counter, Handle the Rush!]
Operate the cashier station with speed and precision. Manage card and cash payments, maintain customer flow, and keep lines short during peak hours. Stay alert—some customers might try to sneak away without paying! Fast service and clean operations keep satisfaction high and profits steady.
[Create Your Signature Pizzas]
Cook up customized pizza recipes that suit every customer's craving. From classic cheese to crispy potato and spicy pepperoni, experiment with different ingredients to craft your signature menu. Set prices for each item, test limited-time specials, and keep evolving your menu to stay ahead in the pizza business.
[Expand Your Pizza Empire]
Reinvest your earnings to scale your operation. Hire skilled staff, upgrade your cooking equipment, and open new seating areas. Renovate with stylish décor, new lighting, and improved workflow to make your shop the best in town. Start as a small pizza stand and grow into a bustling restaurant chain!
The Most Realistic Pizza Shop Sim Ever!
Immerse yourself in a lifelike simulation with detailed 3D visuals and day-to-day management challenges. Control everything from ingredient orders and staff schedules to pricing and shop expansion. Whether you're passionate about food, management, or simulation gameplay—this is your ultimate pizza tycoon experience.
Ready to Take Over the Pizza World?
Download Pizza Simulator now and turn your pizza shop dreams into reality. Perfect for fans of restaurant sims, business management games, cooking tycoon challenges, and food-themed gameplay. Master the oven, manage your team, and build the most famous pizza brand in town!

bluejetty:00115406:ios.description:
Sort Factory — The Ultimate Sorting Puzzle Game
Sort Factory is a puzzle game built entirely around sorting puzzle mechanics. In this satisfying sort puzzle, your goal is simple: sort items correctly, keep the factory running, and solve increasingly challenging puzzle levels. Easy to play and hard to master, Sort Factory is a casual puzzle game designed for players who love logic, order, and smart decision-making.
Puzzle Gameplay — Smart Sorting Under Pressure
Each level is a carefully designed sorting puzzle where items move through a factory conveyor system. You must sort objects by type, color, or category before they reach the end. As the puzzle difficulty increases, faster flows, new item types, and tighter spaces will test your ability to think ahead and solve complex puzzle challenges.
This is not just a simple sort game — it’s a strategy-driven puzzle experience that rewards planning, timing, and precision.
Features of the Sorting Puzzle Experience
Highly addictive sorting puzzle gameplay with smooth, satisfying interactions
Dozens of handcrafted puzzle levels that focus on sorting logic
Gradually increasing puzzle difficulty to keep every sort challenge fresh
Factory-themed sort puzzle mechanics with conveyor belts and dynamic flow
Casual puzzle game design with deep strategic depth
Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain games, and sorting challenges
Why Sort Factory Is the Perfect Puzzle Game
Sort Factory blends classic puzzle game design with modern sorting puzzle mechanics. Every level is a new sort challenge, pushing you to optimize movement, reduce mistakes, and master the flow. Whether you’re playing for relaxation or looking for a true brain-training puzzle, Sort Factory delivers a rewarding sort puzzle experience every time.
If you enjoy puzzle games, sorting puzzles, and satisfying problem-solving, Sort Factory is the perfect game for you.
Download Sort Factory and master the art of sorting in this addictive puzzle game.

bluejetty:00042363:ios.description:
Ivim is integrative health. Start and manage your programs, check in and stay on track, celebrate milestones with direct access to your care team. Learn something new and chat daily with friends and other members on their care journey. 
Start your personalized health plan

bluejetty:00077114:ios.description:
Indoor rowing workouts and plans that make you fitter, stronger and leaner. Live sync with your Concept2 PM5 monitor, plus heart rate from your Apple Watch.
Follow a guided plan, row in time with the stroke metronome, and watch your progress build week by week. Whether you're new to the rowing machine or want more structure in your training, there's a plan for you.
WHY ROWING MACHINE WORKOUTS?
Rowing works your legs, core, back and arms in every stroke. It's low impact, burns serious calories and fits any fitness level. This app turns your rower into a coach: clear plans, guided intervals and real data from your machine.
Train from just 2 days a week. New to rowing? Start with the Beginner Plan. Want to lose weight? Follow the Weight Loss Plan. Every plan builds gradually to help your body adapt and reduce the risk of injury or burnout.
CONNECTS TO YOUR ROWER
• Concept2 PM5: connect over Bluetooth for live split, stroke rate and metres during your workout
• Smart rowers: connect a wide range of Bluetooth rowing machines for live workout data
• Any other rowing machine: follow the guided workouts with the timer and metronome
• Apple Watch: stream live heart rate to your iPhone while you row
FEATURES
GUIDED PLANS
Choose a plan for your level and goal. HIIT intervals, target stroke rates and rest guidance tell you exactly what to do and when.
STROKE RATE METRONOME
Hit your target strokes per minute (SPM) with an audio metronome and phase guide that keep your rhythm steady.
AUDIO COACHING
Voice cues guide you through every interval while your own music plays in the background.
CUSTOM WORKOUTS
Build your own sessions. Set your SPM and duration and row your way.
FREE ROW

bluejetty:00120572:ios.description:
Explore Human Anatomy Like Never Before with Skeleton 3D Anatomy!
Skeleton 3D Anatomy is the ultimate educational tool for medical students, healthcare professionals, and anatomy enthusiasts. Featuring highly detailed 3D models of the entire human skeletal system with high-resolution textures up to 4K, this app transforms the way you study and understand bone structure. Perfect for exam preparation, classroom reference, or professional development.
Key features:
- High-Detail 3D Models: Every bone reconstructed with anatomical accuracy and 4K textures for crystal-clear visualization
- Interactive Exploration: Rotate 360°, zoom, and navigate with intelligent camera controls that automatically adjust the center of rotation
- Regional Organization: Bones grouped by anatomical regions for systematic study and clear understanding of skeletal structure
- Hide/Show Individual Bones: Isolate specific bones to focus your study and understand their position in the skeleton
- Interactive Labels: Tap anatomical pins to view precise terminology for every bone detail
- Multi-Language Support: Available in 12 languages including Latin, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Turkish
- Dual Language Display: Show anatomical terms in two languages simultaneously for enhanced learning
How It Works:
1. Select the skeletal region you want to study (skull, spine, ribs, limbs, etc.)
2. Rotate and zoom the 3D model to examine bones from any angle
3. Tap on any bone to see its anatomical name and details
4. Hide or show specific bones to understand their relationships
5. Use the search function to quickly find specific structures
6. Switch languages as needed to study anatomical terminology

Discover Sudoku Offline – the ultimate offline sudoku puzzle game that challenges your mind anytime, anywhere!

Embark on a dynamic adventure where every move sharpens your logic and hones your number skills. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned puzzle master, our game adapts to your pace and style.

Key Features:

• Play Anywhere, Anytime: Enjoy seamless offline gameplay—perfect for on-the-go fun, whether you’re commuting or taking a break.

• Progressive Levels & Thematic Journeys: Tackle progressively challenging puzzles in beautifully designed levels featuring unique themes like the mysterious “Abyssal.” Every stage offers fresh visual delights and mental challenges.

• Daily Challenges & Rewarding Missions: Boost your skills with new daily puzzles and personalized missions. Earn stars, trophies, and bonuses as you track your progress on an interactive rewards calendar.

• Multiple Game Modes & Customizable Difficulty: Choose from an array of exciting modes—Sudoku Link, Skyscraper, Express, Jigsaw, and Killer—with difficulty settings ranging from easy to extreme to suit your expertise.

• Insightful Statistics & Handy Tools: Monitor your performance with detailed stats on games played, wins, and error-free sessions. Utilize smart tools like undo, erase, notes, and hints to perfect your strategy.

• Elegant Dark Mode: Play comfortably in any lighting environment with our sleek dark theme that’s easy on the eyes.

Join millions of puzzle enthusiasts and unlock your potential with Sudoku Offline. Elevate your sudoku experience, challenge your brain, and master the art of logic. Download now and transform every moment into a captivating puzzle adventure!

bluejetty:00018293:ios.description:
RetirePlan is an iPad app that helps you answer all your questions about your retirement. If you have questions about your retirement finances, this is the app to answer them. 
When can I retire?
How much do I need to save every year?
How much money will I get every year in my retirement?
How long will my money hold out in my retirement?
In just a few seconds you can enter your data and assumptions and the graph will update to show you if your plan will work. If you have more time to spend you can enter as much detail as you want to refine your plan. 
The sliders give you an easy way to see what different values will do to your plan. Need to enter a value outside the slider range? press the amount and a calculator will pop up to let you enter whatever number you need. The slider range will update automatically. 
Bring up the spreadsheet to see all the details for every year of the plan, or check out the Monte Carlo simulator to see how likely your plan is to succeed!
Email your results. 
Use the settings to add your spouse, include or remove Social Security, and show or hide inflation and interest rates. 
Use the + button to add a pension, send a child to college, large upcoming expenses, add additional rates of return and retirement income assumptions.
Include Tax assumptions to get an even more accurate picture of your future.

bluejetty:00015754:ios.summary:
