The Strength Training app is powered by a team of physiotherapists, m
bluejetty:00015754:ios.description:
Build strength with guided workout plans, gym routines, and in-depth biomechanics. Muscle & Motion brings training to life with 3D visuals that show how your body moves.
The Strength Training app is powered by a team of physiotherapists, movement experts, and professional animators. We turn your device into a visual strength-training lab and show you exactly which muscle structures are working, so you can understand the anatomy and biomechanics of the exercise, and train smarter while reducing injury risk.
Made for personal trainers, strength coaches, therapists, students, and dedicated lifters, this app connects what you feel in the gym with what’s really happening in the body.
Designed for visual learners
If you learn best by seeing, this app is made for you.
Why trainers, coaches & students love it
- Makes complex anatomy easy to understand through clear 3D animations
- Shows exactly which muscles and joints are involved in each exercise
- Reveals common mistakes so you can coach better form
- Explains concepts far better than static images or textbooks
Backed by thousands of 5-star ratings and trusted by movement professionals worldwide.
Instead of static diagrams, you get animated 3D views of real lifts: muscles slide, shorten and lengthen as the movement happens, making it much easier to remember which structures are doing what, and why it matters
Key features:
• Interactive 3D Anatomy Model
Rotate, zoom, and explore every muscle, joint, and bone for a deeper understanding of human movement.
• Access to 3D Exercise Anatomy Library (1,200+ exercises, updated weekly)
Comprehensive library of science-based exercise videos, each with full anatomical analysis and common mistakes to avoid. See prime movers, synergists, stabilizers and antagonists highlighted with clear color-coding, and learn how to target or de-emphasize specific muscles by changing stance, range, or grip.
• Educational Videos 
Discover a range of videos designed to make learning anatomy easy and engaging. From core fundamentals to advanced mechanics.
• Workout Plans
Create & assign customized workouts
What our users say
“An absolute must for understanding movement and the anatomy behind it! It’s like watching under the skin.”
“I’ve finally found an app that helps me prevent injuries by showing exactly what not to do!”
“This app makes complex anatomy simple and has helped me become a more effective trainer for my clients.”
Who is this app for?
Strength Training by M&M is built for anyone who wants to train and teach with confidence: 
- Personal trainers & strength coaches
- Physical therapists, chiropractors & rehab professionals
- Pilates, yoga & movement teachers
- Bodybuilders, powerlifters & fitness enthusiasts
- Kinesiology, physiotherapy & sports-science students
- University and college instructors who teach exercise anatomy/biomechanics
Use it to prepare sessions, design programs, teach classes, or deepen your own understanding of lifting mechanics.
Free access & subscriptions
You can download the app and start learning with a free tier that unlocks a portion of the content so you can explore the 3D model and try sample exercises.
To access the full library of exercises, 3D anatomy content, and all workout-building tools, you can upgrade with an in-app subscription:
Subscriptions give you full access to all videos, exercises, workouts, and the 3D model for the duration of your plan.
Subscriptions auto-renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID account settings.
You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions on your device.
For full details, please see:
Privacy Policy: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.muscleandmotion.com/terms-of-use/
Support
Have a question, feature request or need help with your subscription?
Our team is happy to help at info@muscleandmotion.com.

bluejetty:00026372:ios.summary:
Noir is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.
It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Noir, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.
And the results look great too. N
bluejetty:00026372:ios.description:
Noir is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.
It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Noir, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.
And the results look great too. Noir generates a custom dark style for each website you visit, based on the colors that are used on a page. You won’t even notice this happening in the background – that’s how fast it is – but you’ll certainly appreciate the end result: a beautiful dark mode tailored for each website, where contrast is preserved and highlights still pop. And with over 20 built-in themes and the ability to create your own, you can customize the results exactly the way you want.
Noir works with any website you visit in Safari, automatically. By default, Noir is linked to your device’s Dark Mode, so websites will only go dark when you want them to. But you can easily customize this to your liking, even per website. Only want to use Noir on just a few specific websites? Sure thing! Disable Noir on some websites? No problem!
Built from the ground up for iOS and iPadOS, the app feels right at home on your device. It supports the brand new Safari web extension feature, which means there’s no need to manually activate it every time you load a new page. The app also tightly integrates with system features such as Shortcuts, Control Center, Focus Filters, and Widgets to fully integrate Noir in all your workflows. And your settings are automatically synced to all your devices using iCloud.
And just as importantly, Noir takes your privacy seriously: it doesn’t collect any of your browsing data. Period.
Noir is made by an indie iOS developer. It does not include any subscriptions or ads. Buy Noir once, use it forever.
Notes:
• Found a website where Noir’s dark mode doesn’t look just right? Let me know by reporting it. The app will be frequently updated to address issues that are reported.
Privacy Policy:
• The Noir extension requires access to the websites you visit to analyze the existing style of the page and to override it with Noir's dark style.
• Noir never collects your browsing data. The only data Noir ‘collects’ are your settings, and those will never leave your device or iCloud account.
• You can read Noir’s full Privacy Policy at https://getnoir.app/privacypolicy

A virus outbreak on a distant trans-federation planet unleashes
bluejetty:00017098:ios.description:
Purge the undead! Awesome upgradeable guns and armor, unique class skills, and 4 player co-op! Play the most intense zombie shooter on mobile, from the makers of Bloons TD 5.
A virus outbreak on a distant trans-federation planet unleashes horrors from humanity's past. A powerful, rapidly growing zombie horde threatens the very existence of humankind, and the only ones capable of fighting back are the highly skilled, highly weaponized special forces of the S A S. Choose from 3 unique character classes, maximize the fully customizable skill tree, and select from hundreds of weapons and armor pieces to build the ultimate zombie killing hero. Play dynamic, challenging levels in single player or 4 player cooperative multiplayer and give our ravaged civilization its last best hope for survival.
INTENSE ACTION
Zombies swarm the screen, exploding into bits under your hail of bullets. Each of the 17 unique zombie types have special attacks and behavior, and they can evolve - manifesting terrifying new powers as you progress through the game. And just when you think you've beat them all, savage boss zombies hunt you down, puking out acid worms or storming after you in rage mode. Learn their strengths and weaknesses as you lead the action across 7 story-driven maps with varying victory conditions.
UNBEATABLE 4 PLAYER CO-OP
Quickmatch with up to 3 other players of similar level and use the custom skills and weapons chosen by all players to form an effective fire team. Coordinate auto-turret placements, high level room-clearing powers like Assault Team, Aerial Bombardment, and Zombie Antidote, and move physics objects to create temporary cover while you paint the room red.
HEAPS OF EPIC LOOT
Over 160 incredible guns and armor pieces are locked up tight inside increasingly rare strongboxes that you can find in secret rooms or on the mangled remains of your enemies. Your loadout includes a pistol and two rifle class weapons - choose from fast firing submachine guns, devastating shotguns, high damage assault rifles, brutal machine guns, flamethrowers, rocket launchers, lightning guns, and more. Armor up for protection against physical, thermal, and chemical attacks, then round out your arsenal with auto-turrets, grenades, and special high damage ammo to rip through the undead before they rip through you.
AMAZING RPG-STYLE UPGRADES
The Assault, Medic, and Heavy Gunner classes each have unique upgrade trees, giving each character 19 skills to customize. Hundreds of guns and armor pieces have a range of grades and a powerful RED version when you reach high levels. In addition you can add powerful augmentations to your guns and gear which enhance core properties like damage and rate of fire, but can also improve reload time, resist damage, and heal.
Download for free and play SAS: Zombie Assault 4 now!
Currently in development - private matches and events. Please be patient and know that private matches is a top priority.
Please Note: SAS: Zombie Assault 4 is free to download and play (aside from internet, carrier, data, device, and other services for which the player is financially responsible), but some in-game items can be purchased with real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device's settings.
SAS: Zombie Assault 4 is recommended for players 12 years of age and older, and the fantasy violence, gibs, and zombie blood are to be expected given the survival theme. listings.name: SAS: Zombie Assault 4
listings.description:
Purge the undead! Awesome upgradeable guns and armor, unique class skills, and 4 player co-op! Play the most intense zombie shooter on mobile, from the makers of Bloons TD 5.

A virus outbreak on a distant trans-federation planet unleashes horrors from humanity's past. A powerful, rapidly growing zombie horde threatens the very existence of humankind, and the only ones capable of fighting back are the highly skilled, highly weaponized special forces of the S A S. Choose from 3 unique character classes, maximize the fully customizable skill tree, and select from hundreds of weapons and armor pieces to build the ultimate zombie killing hero. Play dynamic, challenging levels in single player or 4 player cooperative multiplayer and give our ravaged civilization its last best hope for survival.

INTENSE ACTION
Zombies swarm the screen, exploding into bits under your hail of bullets. Each of the 17 unique zombie types have special attacks and behavior, and they can evolve - manifesting terrifying new powers as you progress through the game. And just when you think you've beat them all, savage boss zombies hunt you down, puking out acid worms or storming after you in rage mode. Learn their strengths and weaknesses as you lead the action across 7 story-driven maps with varying victory conditions.

UNBEATABLE 4 PLAYER CO-OP
Quickmatch with up to 3 other players of similar level and use the custom skills and weapons chosen by all players to form an effective fire team. Coordinate auto-turret placements, high level room-clearing powers like Assault Team, Aerial Bombardment, and Zombie Antidote, and move physics objects to create temporary cover while you paint the room red.

HEAPS OF EPIC LOOT
Over 160 incredible guns and armor pieces are locked up tight inside increasingly rare strongboxes that you can find in secret rooms or on the mangled remains of your enemies. Your loadout includes a pistol and two rifle class weapons - choose from fast firing submachine guns, devastating shotguns, high damage assault rifles, brutal machine guns, flamethrowers, rocket launchers, lightning guns, and more. Armor up for protection against physical, thermal, and chemical attacks, then round out your arsenal with auto-turrets, grenades, and special high damage ammo to rip through the undead before they rip through you.

AMAZING RPG-STYLE UPGRADES
The Assault, Medic, and Heavy Gunner classes each have unique upgrade trees, giving each character 19 skills to customize. Hundreds of guns and armor pieces have a range of grades and a powerful RED version when you reach high levels. In addition you can add powerful augmentations to your guns and gear which enhance core properties like damage and rate of fire, but can also improve reload time, resist damage, and heal.

Download for free and play SAS: Zombie Assault 4 now!

Currently in development - private matches and events. Please be patient and know that private matches is a top priority.

Please Note: SAS: Zombie Assault 4 is free to download and play (aside from internet, carrier, data, device, and other services for which the player is financially responsible), but some in-game items can be purchased with real money. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device's settings.
SAS: Zombie Assault 4 is recommended for players 12 years of age and older, and the fantasy violence, gibs, and zombie blood are to be expected given the survival theme. We have included a "Gore" setting on the Options screen specifically for young or sensitive players, and this removes the blood and gibs when Gore is toggled Off.

bluejetty:00128181:ios.description:
Des portraits de femmes inspirantes aux astuces bien-être en passant par les tendances mode, découvrez la richesse de l’univers de Madame Figaro dans cette application gratuite. Chaque jour, Madame Figaro vous propose l’expertise de sa rédaction dans ses articles et vidéos, ainsi que ses nombreux conseils et services.
[Nouveau] Le design de votre application a été repensé.
Découvrez notre nouvelle page d’accueil et la refonte de Ma Une, un nouveau look pour les pages articles ainsi qu’un un menu de navigation simplifié.
Au quotidien, les journalistes de Madame Figaro vous informent sur :
■ La société : Des expertes décryptent pour vous toute l’actualité au féminin.
■ La mode : Les dernières actualités et tendances des marques et des créateurs, présentées et commentées par la rédaction.
■ La beauté : Madame Figaro vous aide pour le maquillage, les soins, vos cheveux ou vos choix de parfum. Découvrez tous nos tests produit et tutoriaux.
■ La cuisine : Des tendances à l’actualité des chefs, retrouvez de nombreuses idées recettes et astuces nutrition pour une cuisine saine et gourmande.
■ Le bien-être : Forme et détente, nutrition, psycho… Tous nos conseils et astuces.
■ Le business : Des outils pratiques, du coaching pour réaliser vos objectifs de carrière.
■ La culture et les people : Les grandes figures du cinéma, du monde de la musique, la vie des festivals et les têtes couronnées sont à l’honneur dans Madame Figaro.
■ Le foyer : Éducation, couple, famille, tendances mariage… Comment vivre au mieux les moments importants de votre vie.
■ La déco & design : Inspirations et tendances, nos conseils pour votre intérieur.
■ L’évasion : Voyages, escapades, week-ends, découvertes… La rédaction vous fait découvrir les bons spots pour vous faire rêver toute l’année.
■ L’astro : votre horoscope personnalisé au quotidien. Retrouvez également l’astro du mois, de l’année et l’horoscope chinois.
■ Les bons plans et concours de Madame Figaro.
Vous pouvez personnaliser votre application Madame Figaro en fonction de vos centres d’intérêt, en sélectionnant vos rubriques ou votre signe astrologique. Imaginez vous-même votre une, que vous pourrez lire même si vous n’êtes pas connecté à Internet. Vos articles “favoris” sont eux aussi disponibles hors connexion. Choisissez les sujets sur lesquels vous voulez être alertés en vous abonnant aux notifications qui vous intéressent, ou en suivant une marque, une personnalité, un chef… La navigation reste fluide et l’ergonomie intuitive pour une lecture plus agréable: feuilletez les pages de droite à gauche pour passer d’un article à un autre. Vous cherchez la dernière tendance mode ou comment faire un poke bowl ?

listings.name: Madame Figaro, le news féminin
listings.description:
Des portraits de femmes inspirantes aux astuces bien-être en passant par les tendances mode, découvrez la richesse de l’univers de Madame Figaro dans cette application gratuite. Chaque jour, Madame Figaro vous propose l’expertise de sa rédaction dans ses articles et vidéos, ainsi que ses nombreux conseils et services.
 
[Nouveau] Le design de votre application a été repensé.
Découvrez notre nouvelle page d’accueil et la refonte de Ma Une, un nouveau look pour les pages articles ainsi qu’un un menu de navigation simplifié.
 
Au quotidien, les journalistes de Madame Figaro vous informent sur :

■ La société : Des expertes décryptent pour vous toute l’actualité au féminin.

■ La mode : Les dernières actualités et tendances des marques et des créateurs, présentées et commentées par la rédaction.

■ La beauté : Madame Figaro vous aide pour le maquillage, les soins, vos cheveux ou vos choix de parfum. Découvrez tous nos tests produit et tutoriaux.

■ La cuisine : Des tendances à l’actualité des chefs, retrouvez de nombreuses idées recettes et astuces nutrition pour une cuisine saine et gourmande.

■ Le bien-être : Forme et détente, nutrition, psycho… Tous nos conseils et astuces.

■ Le business : Des outils pratiques, du coaching pour réaliser vos objectifs de carrière.

■ La culture et les people : Les grandes figures du cinéma, du monde de la musique, la vie des festivals et les têtes couronnées sont à l’honneur dans Madame Figaro.

■ Le foyer : Éducation, couple, famille, tendances mariage… Comment vivre au mieux les moments importants de votre vie.

■ La déco & design : Inspirations et tendances, nos conseils pour votre intérieur.

■ L’évasion : Voyages, escapades, week-ends, découvertes… La rédaction vous fait découvrir les bons spots pour vous faire rêver toute l’année.

■ L’astro : votre horoscope personnalisé au quotidien. Retrouvez également l’astro du mois, de l’année et l’horoscope chinois.

■ Les bons plans et concours de Madame Figaro.

Vous pouvez personnaliser votre application Madame Figaro en fonction de vos centres d’intérêt, en sélectionnant vos rubriques ou votre signe astrologique. Imaginez vous-même votre une, que vous pourrez lire même si vous n’êtes pas connecté à Internet. Vos articles “favoris” sont eux aussi disponibles hors connexion. Choisissez les sujets sur lesquels vous voulez être alertés en vous abonnant aux notifications qui vous intéressent, ou en suivant une marque, une personnalité, un chef… La navigation reste fluide et l’ergonomie intuitive pour une lecture plus agréable: feuilletez les pages de droite à gauche pour passer d’un article à un autre. Vous cherchez la dernière tendance mode ou comment faire un poke bowl ? 
Retrouvez l’exhaustivité des contenus de Madame Figaro grâce au moteur de recherche interne.

bluejetty:00177601:ios.description:
Mit dieser App sind Sie rund um die Uhr umfassend und schnell informiert.
WELT News ist die kostenlose App der WELT, mit der Sie nichts mehr verpassen. 
Über 300 Journalisten berichten weltweit über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Sport, Panorama, Kultur und Wissen. Ergänzt wird dieses Angebot durch ausführliche Analysen, Testberichte und Meinungen. Erleben Sie Qualitätsjournalismus – immer und überall.
Hochwertige Videos, aktuelle Börsenkurse, lokale Wetterberichte und umfangreiche Bildergalerien machen diese App zum perfekten Begleiter durch den Tag. Personalisierbare Push-Nachrichten informieren Sie in Echtzeit, sobald etwas Wichtiges passiert oder Ihr Lieblingsautor einen neuen Artikel veröffentlicht hat. Bei aktuellen Lagen können Sie sich außerdem jederzeit via TV-Livestream informieren. Mit dem Newsticker bleiben Sie immer auf dem Laufenden, und wenn die Zeit gerade knapp ist, können Sie Artikel einfach im Profil zwischenspeichern. Außerdem können Sie sich die Startseite nach Ihren Vorlieben individuell zusammenstellen und jederzeit live das TV-Programm auf WELT verfolgen.
Mit einem WELTplus-Abonnement genießen Sie außerdem exklusive Artikel und weitere Vorteile.

Sie können Ihr Abonnement in Ihrem iTunes-Account verwalten und z.B. die automatische Verlängerung ausstellen.

bluejetty:00100705:ios.summary:

Whether you listen or read, you’ll
bluejetty:00100705:ios.description:
Welcome to a wide world of wonderful audiobooks, ebooks, and things that aren’t books but are still pretty great.
Storytel is home to beloved stories, in-depth podcasts, and exclusive Storytel Originals.
Whether you listen or read, you’ll find the right story for any moment.
• Explore a massive library of stories in English and other languages
• Jump freely from story to story until you find one you love
• Build your bookshelf and get personalized recommendations
• Find what fits your mood, like crime, feel-good, or self-development
• Follow your favorite authors and series
• Browse and share reviews and reactions
• Try out that book your friend keeps talking about
• Discover what’s trending in the culture
LISTEN AND READ YOUR WAY
• Listen to audio stories on your iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and CarPlay
• Stream stories or download them for later
• Switch between listening and reading anywhere in a book
• Listen at your own pace: regular, sped up, or slowed down
• Set bookmarks and attach your thoughts as notes
• Drift off to dreamland with the sleep timer
• Spare those pretty eyes with Dark Mode
• See your stats and set a Listening Goal
KIDS MODE INCLUDED
• Let your kid find adventure in a space with just children’s stories
• Show or hide children’s books in your bookshelf
• Set your own pin code for parental control
HOW IT WORKS
Storytel is available in 25+ countries, including both local and international story treasures in different languages. A subscription gives you access to our ever-growing library of audiobooks, ebooks, and other stories.
In-app subscriptions will be charged via your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of the subscription period unless auto renewal is turned off in your iTunes account settings at least 24 hours before your subscription period runs out.
When a free trial is offered, we will ask you to add a payment method when starting the trial. But don't worry – if you cancel before the last day of the trial you won't be charged.
The content, languages and subscriptions available may vary by region. Some titles and offers shown above may not be available in your country or selected subscription plan.
Terms and conditions: https://www.storytel.com/documents/terms-and-conditions
Privacy policy: https://www.storytel.com/documents/privacy-policy
Questions? Feedback? Speak to a real person! Reach us at support@storytel.com

bluejetty:00023252:ios.description:
Do you love fast paced crazy cook games?
Are you crazy about time management games?
Are you excited about renovating your own yacht and traveling around the world to build your own restaurant empire?
If you say "YES", the FREE Cooking Voyage - Crazy Chef's Restaurant Dash Game is your choice of time-management game & food games madness. Download & Play the free cook game for you now! Serve up the hungry customers in the restaurant, you can also decorate your own unique yacht! You can’t miss it! 
Cook like a chef with the cooking talent! Show your cook passion all the time, cook and serve delicious cuisines in each exotic restaurants all over the world to build your own restaurant empire. Sharpening your cook skills is not enough, master your time-management skills and spend your earnings on upgrades for food and appliances for your restaurant to be a five-star restaurant! Serve the hungry customers around the world and become the top in the cook events! You are destined for fabulous chef mega fame, just like famous chef Ramsey! 
Pack the cook talents that your papa and mama give you. Let's continue the exciting cook game.
Did we say you will own a yacht? Board your own megayacht to begin your worldwide journey! Visit famous cities and unlock the most famous landmarks! To discover different food cultures and cook various cuisines with tons of ingredients in distinctive diner or cafe or restaurants. The journey will never be bored while you could give your megayacht a complete makeover! Decorate and renovate your bedroom, kitchen, hall and design other rooms in just the way you want! Explore your creativity with hundreds of design options and design your dream megayacht while playing this engaging cook game, restaurant game and kitchen game!
Features
COOK massive tasty cuisines and recipes with hundreds of ingredients
EXPAND your restaurant empire with distinct restaurants in different cities
TRAVEL to explore unique food cuisines around the world
A YACHT to discover for new rooms and minigames
RENOVATE and DESIGN what your own megayacht looks like
BUILD LANDMARKS in each city with your progression
UPGRADE your unique kitchen and ingredients for premium dishes
TAP to PLAY over 1000+ levels and more to come
CREATE COMBOS to earn extra coins
SERVE a variety of cute customers
PLAY OFFLINE
Download for FREE and play the frenzy Cooking Voyage!
Enjoying Cooking Voyage? Learn more about the game! https://www.facebook.com/cookingvoyage/
Questions? Contact our Tech Support by sending an email to support@newvoy.com.

bluejetty:00063136:ios.description:
A top 10 strategy game all around the world!
A top-rated game!
Are you ready to step into the pit and punch someone? Your favorite Clash of Lords 2 Heroes are fighting in a free-for-all frenzy against a force of frightening fiends! Control the action and become the greatest warlord in all the land. To survive you’ll need wit, will, and we couldn't think of a word for strength but you get the picture. It's time to Clash!
Clash of Lords 2 is a strategy game with fun and innovative twists on the genre. Recruit over 50 Heroes and their mercenaries, build and defend a base, and fight alongside your friends in over 10 PvE and PvP modes! Get ready to Clash!
Game Features:
1. You control the action! Activate Heroes’ skills in real time!
2. Pair Heroes and Troops with our unique Mercenary system!
3. Play it Your Way! With over 10 PvE and PvP modes, there's always something fun and different to do!
4. Fight alongside your friends! Join a Guild, and clash with players from all over the world! You can even battle against players from different countries!
5. Free to Play! Log in every day to win free Heroes and Jewels!
Note: This game requires an internet connection to play.
Visit us on Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/clashoflords2
Subscription details and important things to note about Apple's official subscription feature:
1. Subscription Fees and Subscription Cycle
You can subscribe to the "Subscription Perks (Weekly)" within the game for $9.99. Subscription lasts for one week (7 days). (Prices may change based on your region.)
You can subscribe to the "Subscription Perks (Monthly)" within the game for $24.99. Subscription lasts for one month (30 days). (Prices may change based on your region.)
2. Subscription Content
Players who have bought the subscription get to enjoy the following perks during the subscription period:
- Free 10x Hero Hire: once/day
- Arena challenge chances: +1/day
- 200 Jewels/day
- 5 EXP Stone III/day
- 200 Ancient Spirit Shards/day
- 1 Crystal Epiphany/day
3. Automatic Renewal
Subscriptions will be automatically renewed on the App Store, and the fee will be charged to your iTunes Account. Automatic renewal settings must be manually changed on your iTunes/Apple ID settings. Your subscription will be automatically renewed if automatic renewal is not turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the subscription period.
4. Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
Terms of Service https://policies.igg.com/terms_of_service
Privacy Policy https://policies.igg.com/privacy_policy
5. Canceling Subscriptions
Follow these steps on your Apple device if you would like to cancel your subscription: Settings→iTunes and App Store→Tap on your Apple ID→Check Apple ID→Account Settings→Subscriptions→Manage→Select the corresponding subscription for "Clash of Lords 2"

bluejetty:00174820:ios.summary:
FORScan Viewer is an application that allows users to connect to a compatible OBD adapter and view information about the on-board network of Ford, Mazda, Lincoln and Mercury vehicles.
FORScan Viewer is an independent third-party applicatio
bluejetty:00174820:ios.description:
FORScan Viewer is an application that allows users to connect to a compatible OBD adapter and view information about the on-board network of Ford, Mazda, Lincoln and Mercury vehicles.
FORScan Viewer is an independent third-party application and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Ford Motor Company, Mazda Motor Corporation, or their affiliated brands. Ford, Lincoln, Mercury, and Mazda are trademarks of their respective owners and are used solely to describe vehicle compatibility.
The application communicates only with compatible third-party OBD-II adapters owned and operated by the user. The application does not control, modify, or operate any equipment manufactured by Ford, Mazda, Lincoln, or Mercury.
SUPPORTED OBD ADAPTERS
- OBDLink MX+ (recommended)
- vLinker FS Bluetooth (recommended)
- vLinker FD BLE (recommended)
- other ELM327-compatible WiFi or BLE adapter (not recommended). 
Attention! Some ELM327 adapters are not fully compatible with this application and may not work properly.
COMPATIBILITY
FORScan Viewer is designed to display information for the following vehicles:
 Ford, Lincoln, Mercury: 1996-2022 models, some 1994-1995 models
- Mazda: 1996-2022 models. Important note: Mazda 7G models (new Mazda 3, CX-30, MX-30, CX-50, etc) have limited or no support!
- Other vehicle manufacturers are NOT supported
FEATURES
- Reading and displaying information about the on-board network configuration of the connected vehicle (modules), including Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTC) for all modules
- More functions are available in FORScan Lite
LEGAL NOTICE
FORScan Viewer does not contain proprietary vehicle software, firmware, service manuals, or other copyrighted materials owned by vehicle manufacturers.
Vehicle data displayed by the application is obtained through standard diagnostic interfaces and user-authorized connections.

bluejetty:00086545:ios.description:
Rehlat App Features 
Rehlat App is your one-stop app for flight booking, hotel reservation, Saudi intercity bus booking, and train services. Download now & enjoy exclusive discounts, cashback, and much more. 
Why Rehlat?
Rehlat is a brand that believes in a world without borders. Rehlat has stayed ahead by continually upgrading its technology to meet the ever-changing demands of the rapidly developing travel market, steadily establishing itself as Middle East’s most trusted travel booking app. The app and the customer support cater in both Arabic & English. Travel safe with Rehlat & get a hassle-free & secure one-touch booking experience.
**Reasons to Install the Rehlat APP**
*Flight Ticket Booking* 
• Book flights for one-way or round-trips with fare comparison across leading airlines. Sort flight tickets by price, duration or departure, and arrival time.
• Search and book cheap flight tickets on Domestic and International Airlines.
• Domestic airlines that you can book with us are Saudi Arabian Airlines, flyadeal, and Flynas. You can also book cheap flight tickets for all international airlines like Air Arabia, Etihad Airlines, Emirates, Gulf Air, EgyptAir, Qatar Airways, Kuwait Airways, Jazeera Airways, and much more.
• Rehlat flight ticket booking app saves recent flight searches for you, so there’s no need to re-enter details.
• Pay a nominal fee & get a full refund guarantee of 80% of your flight booking amount.
• Get discounted airfares with exciting offers, earn cashbacks, and Karam rewards on every flight booking.
• Tune Protect insurance with up to 40,000 USD coverage. 
*Book Budget and Luxury Hotels* 
• Choose from over 1M+ hotels around the globe 
• Search, book & compare safe/hygienic hotels to stay
• Book a staycation for a relaxing getaway at a premium property near your city. Enjoy free room upgrades, free stay & meals for Kids, Wi-Fi, etc.
• Hotel comparison - Compare your favorite hotels and get the best price on hotel rooms
• Pay online or at the hotel when you check-in, guaranteed flexible booking & easy cancellation
• See reviews and ratings from the Trip Advisor community for all hotels
• Save up to 30% on online hotel booking
*Saudi Intercity Bus Bookings* 
• Search and book your intercity bus tickets from over 5000 bus routes available across Saudi Arabia.
• Routes which links to Saudi Arabia big cities: Mecca, Jeddah, Riyadh, Taif, Medina, Abha, Dammam, Hael, Tabuk, and Qassim. 
• Get flat 50% Off on bus ticket booking.
*Train Tickets Bookings* 
You can easily find and book trains – all the major Saudi routes are available on the app.
• Book tickets using the Rehlat app with a few clicks
• Change of plans? Cancel the booking anytime you want.
 * More features you'll love* 
• Price Drop Savings - Book your flight ticket & if the fare drops, we’ll credit or refund you the difference, no questions asked.
• Get Alerts - Never miss out on a good flight deal or hotel offer. 
• Manage Booking - Keep your flight tickets and hotel booking details handy on the My Trips. 
• Pricelock - Lock your fare and book at your convenience without worrying about fare jumps.
• WhatsApp - Just like flight radar that shows real-time flight information, Rehlat keeps you updated about your flight through WhatsApp. 
• Invite friends & earn 200 SAR KaramCash on signup & an additional reward on completion of their first transaction. #GoKaram
• Club Karam - Reward program that gifts shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle vouchers 
• Online check-in assistance - Our team would do an online check-in & get your preferred seat. 
• Payment flexibility - Pay in local currency using VISA, MasterCard, PayPal, SADAD Online Payment, or MADA.
• Have something to say? We are all ears. Share with us at help@rehlat.com.
We go wherever you go. Download & book.

bluejetty:00072804:android.description:
Solitaire Makeup is a solitaire card games to help girls and boys to makeover and dress up. Some of them are abandoned by their husbands or wives; some of them need to attend an important event or party; some of them need to revenge on their ex-boyfriends by showing them how pretty they are. solitaire: Play classic Klondike solitaire card games to get coins and diamonds. You can also use magic wands or hints in the solitaire card games.
Jigsaw Puzzle event: When play solitaire card games, you can also collect jigsaw pieces and get a beautiful artwork at each event finally.
Star Chest: When you play some solitaire card games, you will get a star chest, when the chest opens, you can get many gifts.
Daily Challenge: also, the daily challenge waiting for you every day.
Come on! You are the great designer of your models; help them to be the best. Play solitaire cards games to launch the makeover salon.

bluejetty:00117012:ios.description:
This app is a mobile version of international online shogi site "81Dojo" (http://81dojo.com) under the patronage of the Japan Shogi Association.
81Dojo is characterized by its unique and advanced functionalities such as the post-game analysis support, very real playing environment including professional byoyomi voice, and the internationalization. All of these feature are provided in this mobile version too. 81Dojo stays with you all the time, while you take it with your mobile to anywhere you go to. Why not take a little break and enjoy some short games at 81Dojo?
(81Dojo is completely free of charge, free download and free playing.)
[Note]
1. If you are not familiar with 81Dojo yet, it is recommended that you first try the web browser version and get used to its unique features and functionalities, before using this mobile app.
2. User account registration can be done via 81Dojo website. (Non-registered users can login with guest account as well.)
3. Any comments, wishes, bug reports to info@81dojo.com would be appreciated. We keep improving the app quality. We would also appreciate your sending ratings and reviews if you find this app satisfactory.

bluejetty:00076189:ios.description:
Welcoming to the stickman parkour runner game. Take your parkour race to the next level! 
In the stickman parkour runner game be a ninja hiding from the law and complete every level without dying and escaping the enemies. You have to run because you can't fight. In parkour race flip on top of surfaces, perform thrilling backflips, make genuine long jumps, and then plunge from the tallest buildings like Spider Stickman. Run from the enemies and make them run after you. In this stickman hook running game, you'll help the parkour runner leap over obstacles in the running game, climb ledges, and reach the portal as you take part in the trap adventure! In the stickman parkour race and jumping game, beat stages and execute tricks. Run through a variety of biomes with Skyblock-equipped players in the Skyland War world to be the best in the parkour race. To find the exit in Parkour run Craft World, jump, and Run. This stickman parkour runner game will test your ability to overcome challenges and reach freedom. 
You take on the role of the stickman hook in this stickman parkour race and jumping game. If you fail a level, you have a strong support system of friends who can assist you right away. After you enter the next realm through the portal, you will need to jump over gaps and run across platforms to get past a number of obstacles. Each level will have unique difficulties that might be written about at the beginning of the level. You can advance to the following level if you complete the platform's last level and reach the exit portal. Check out our progress in the stickman games. The aim of the parkour run game is to finish each level as soon as you can while racking up points for pulling off cool actions and grabbing power-ups along the way. As the player advances through the stickman vector running game, new difficulties and obstacles are often added at progressively harder stages.
One of the best Stickman games is the Stickman parkour race and Jumping game, an impossible Stickman hook running game. In the challenging, crazy stickman parkour platform, the stickman runs and jumps. Although the stickman hook running game is not an easy game, once you complete the impossible stickman parkour, you will feel so proud of yourself that you won't be able to stop. Parkour Run like other stickman vector is an addicting game and is one of the best in the craft world. To advance to the next level if you get stuck, watch the reward video. If you want to be the best in the parkour runner game, try to earn three stars on each level and locate the diamond. 
Amazing features of Stickman Parkour Race & Jumping Game 
 Stickman parkour runner gameplay
Run, jump, and swing from buildings tops in the jumping game
Number of running challenges to overcome
Use slimes to jump higher 
Amazing block craft world to run around
Interesting characters and amazing sound effects
To discover the gate leading to the next level in the stickman hook running game, use the stickman hook to jump and race through the craft world sky. To run and jump, hit the arrow buttons on the left and right, respectively in stickman vector - parkour run. Don't fall and run from arrows and bombs. You can jump higher thanks to slimes, and you can get to another craft block in the craft world via an elevator. Stay off the sand craft block for a short while in stickman vector - parkour run.
Let the wait be over and download this amazing stickman vector - stickman parkour runner game right away to beat and escape the enemies.

bluejetty:00149265:ios.name: Fit Block 3D: Color Blast Jam
bluejetty:00149265:ios.summary:
Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam – The Ultimate Color Block Puzzle Adventure!
Get ready to challenge your mind with Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam, a thrilling and addictive color block puzzle game that combines strategic thinking, logic, and fa
bluejetty:00149265:ios.description:
Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam – The Ultimate Color Block Puzzle Adventure!
Get ready to challenge your mind with Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam, a thrilling and addictive color block puzzle game that combines strategic thinking, logic, and fast-paced slide-and-blast mechanics. Your goal is simple but highly engaging: fit blocks into the right spaces, clear obstacles, and jam your way through increasingly difficult levels.
But don’t be fooled—this game isn’t just about matching colors. Each level introduces Woodoku-inspired mechanics, requiring you to think ahead, plan smart moves, and execute perfect strategies. Are you ready to master the block jam challenge?
Endless Puzzles, Infinite Fun
From beginner-friendly block jam levels to intense slide-and-blast challenges, this game keeps your brain engaged every step of the way. You'll navigate unique obstacles, shuffle and fit blocks, and unlock innovative mechanics that redefine the puzzle genre. Whether you love Woodoku-style puzzles, strategic block placement, or just want a colorful brain workout, this game has something for everyone.
Game Features
Color Block Puzzle Gameplay – Slide, shuffle, and blast blocks to fit them into their correct places. Every level introduces new Fit Bock mechanics to keep you on your toes.
Hundreds of Levels to Conquer – Take on endless block jam puzzles, from relaxing challenges to mind-bending Woodoku-style grid puzzles.
Exciting Obstacles & New Twists – Face tricky paths, unexpected color blast combos, and unique slide-and-fit mechanics that make every level fresh and fun.
Think Ahead, Plan Smart – Every move matters. Master block shuffling, plan carefully, and avoid jammed puzzles to clear levels efficiently.
Stunning Visuals & Smooth Controls – Enjoy a vibrant world filled with colorful blocks, seamless animations, and easy-to-learn gameplay designed for all ages.
Unlock Rewards & Exclusive Puzzles – Solve challenging color jam levels, earn exciting rewards, and unlock even harder Fit Bock brain teasers.
How to Play
Slide & Fit Blocks – Move color blocks into place and avoid getting stuck in a block jam.
Blast Through Challenges – Plan your moves strategically to overcome color blast obstacles.
Shuffle & Solve – Every level is a new Woodoku-style puzzle that demands critical thinking.
Unlock & Conquer – Progress through hundreds of levels and face off against the ultimate block jam showdown.
Why You’ll Love Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam
Perfect for Puzzle Enthusiasts – If you love Woodoku, color block puzzles, and strategic jam challenges, this is your next favorite game.
Easy to Play, Hard to Master – Simple mechanics make it accessible, but tougher block jam levels will truly test your skills.
A Perfect Blend of Fun & Brain Training – Play at your own pace and enjoy both a relaxing and mentally stimulating experience.
Sharpen Your Mind – Improve logical thinking, block placement strategy, and color puzzle-solving skills with every game.
If you're looking for the perfect mix of slide, jam, blast, and shuffle in a puzzle game, Fit Bock 3D: Color Blast Jam is the ultimate challenge. Download now and start solving color block puzzles today!

bluejetty:00179370:ios.description:
Get the party started with the number one social guessing game!
Charades is the ultimate multiplayer guessing game designed to bring people together. Whether you need a quick icebreaker for a night out, a fun activity for a family gathering, or a competitive group game for a party, this is the app for you. Put your acting skills, pantomime talents, and trivia knowledge to the ultimate test!
Heads up! This is the classic headbands style game where you place the phone on your forehead and guess the word. With thousands of cards across dozens of categories, including Netflix favorites and Harry Potter magic, the fun is endless. You can even create your own custom decks to make your next event truly unique.
Why Charades is the top choice for parties:
• Ultimate Party Games: Perfect for large groups, couples, or small teams.
• Massive Content Library: Play through thousands of unique cards across a wide variety of decks.
• Act it out & Mimic: Improve your communication and creativity through hilarious pantomime and gestures.
• Social Trivia & Quiz: Test your knowledge on pop culture, history, and modern trends.
• Multiplayer Fun: Play with two people or a hundred. It is the best social game for any crowd.
• No Internet Games: Our app works perfectly offline. It is the ideal no internet game for road trips, flights, and camping.
• Custom Decks: Create and save your own cards for inside jokes or specific events.
How to Play: Fast and Simple
Getting started with this headbands style game is fast and easy. It is the perfect offline game for any social setting:
1. Select a Category: Choose a deck that fits your group's vibe.
2. The Forehead Challenge: Heads up! One player lifts the device to their forehead. The countdown begins!
3. Act and Describe: Friends will use gestures, dances, and clues to describe the word on the screen.
4. Tilt to Score:
 - Tilt down if you guess correctly to earn a point!
 - Tilt up to pass and skip to the next word.
5. Beat the Clock: Get as many correct guesses as possible before time runs out!
Discover our Diverse Categories:
Our library is organized so you can find exactly what you need. Our decks cover everything from classic acting to the biggest trends of 2026:
• Pop Culture & Media: Blockbuster Movies, TV Shows, Netflix, Anime, K-pop, and Streamers.
• Special Interests: Harry Potter, Super Heroes, Soccer Legends, NBA Stars, and Internet Memes.
• Gaming & Tech: Video Games, Pokémon, Programming, and Crypto.
• Music & Legends: Music Hits, Rock Classics, 2000s Hits, and Latin Music.
• Classic Fun: Act it Out, Impressions, Family Time and Animals.
• Knowledge & Trivia: Landmarks, Periodic Table, Historical Figures, and Anatomy.
• Lifestyle & Brands: Famous Brands, Food, Dog Breeds, and Popular Apps.
• Travel & World: Iconic Cities, Countries, US States, and Travel Destinations.
• Decades & Eras: From the 1980s and 90s all the way to today.
Perfect for:
• Parties and Social Gatherings
• Family Game Nights
• Team Building and Icebreakers
• Road Trips and Long Flights
Download Charades today and turn any moment into a hilarious party!

bluejetty:00003802:ios.summary:
Read books in any foreign language and turn every unknown word into a flashcard you'll actually remember. Now with an account and cloud sync: your books and flashcards go with you to every device.
Polyglot Reader is your pocket library, di
bluejetty:00003802:ios.description:
Read books in any foreign language and turn every unknown word into a flashcard you'll actually remember. Now with an account and cloud sync: your books and flashcards go with you to every device.
Polyglot Reader is your pocket library, dictionary and flashcard trainer in one app. Tap any word or phrase in a book, get an instant translation with transcription, hear the pronunciation, and save it to a deck to review later. Built for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a refined dark theme.
— ACCOUNT & SYNC —
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email
• Books, card sets, flashcards and language pairs stay in sync across all your devices
• Your own books are uploaded to the cloud together with their covers
• New device? Sign in and your library and flashcards come right back
— READ —
• Completely redesigned reader, bookmarks, translation popup and settings
• New System theme that follows iOS automatically, plus refined Light and Dark
• Open books in PDF, EPUB, FB2, RTF and TXT
• Import from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or any file app
• Scan a paper page — the app recognizes the text and saves it as a book
• Highlights words you don't know yet, right inside the page
• Vertical scrolling, comfortable type settings, picture zoom
— LIBRARY —
• Thousands of free books in 38+ languages, sorted into sections like Classics, Sherlock Holmes, Shakespeare, Horror & Mystery, Fairy Tales, Philosophy, Adventure
• Adapted A2–B1 readers for German learners, plus original literature in English, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Latin, Greek and many more
• New sorting, new sections and search inside every shelf
• Filter to show only recent books
• Difficulty level and tags shown right on each cover
• Drag and drop books between shelves
• New "Added manually" section for everything you imported yourself
• Smoother search, scroll and sharing on iPad
— LEARN —
• Redesigned cards and study screens
• Ready-made flashcard sets for English, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese and Japanese — verbs, nouns and themed categories
• Smart virtual decks: All cards, Recent, Unknown — see progress at a glance
• Quick preview and actions inside every deck

bluejetty:00159130:ios.description:
Melooha is an AI-powered Vedic astrology app for real-life decisions.
Get hyper-personalized guidance using your birth details (date, time, place) - so your insights don’t feel generic, random, or copied-pasted.
Whether you’re stuck in your career, confused in love, planning marriage, worried about health, or just need direction - Melooha helps you make sense of what’s happening and what to do next.
** What you can do on Melooha
** Ask Questions (Personalized Q&A)
Ask direct questions like:
• “When will my career improve?”
• “Is this relationship right for me?”
• “Should I switch jobs?”
• “When is marriage likely?”
 Get answers personalized to your chart, not generic advice.
** Love & Marriage Compatibility (Matchmaking)
Check compatibility for:
• Love partners
• Marriage prospects
• Long-term relationships
 Understand attraction, emotional alignment, communication style, friction points, and what makes the bond work.
** Personalized Astrology Reports (Detailed & Actionable)
Get deep, structured reports across major life areas:
• Career Report - growth phases, job switches, stability, success periods, next best moves
• Health Report - stress patterns, energy dips, recovery phases, what to watch out for
• Relationship Report - emotional needs, patterns, red flags, relationship timing
• Marriage / Love Report - commitment windows, compatibility factors, long-term outlook
• Love Compatibility Report - instant compatibility insights for you + your partner
• Life Guidance Report - the bigger picture: your phases, opportunities, and caution periods
Built to feel like a real astrology reading, but faster, clearer, and tailored to you.
** Daily Horoscope (Free)
Start your day with a daily horoscope that’s quick, relevant, and easy to act on.
** Add Family Members (Free)
Create profiles for your loved ones and view their insights too:
Add family members easilySave profiles for quick accessCompare charts & compatibility when needed
** Why people use Melooha
• Personalized, not generic - based on your kundli/birth chart
• Fast clarity - useful when you’re anxious, confused, or overthinking
• Modern + rooted - Vedic astrology, explained clearly
• Practical insights - timelines, patterns, and guidance you can actually use 
** Privacy matters
Your birth details are used only to generate your personalized insights. We’re built for trust.
Download Melooha and get clarity on love, marriage, career, health, and life decisions through AI-powered Vedic astrology.

bluejetty:00169238:ios.summary: Welcome to your new go-to hair care haven! Our app isn't just about tackling hair woes; it's your personal guide to embracing and celebrating every strand of your unique hair journey. With over 50,000+ hours of lovingly curated content tail
bluejetty:00169238:ios.description:
Welcome to your new go-to hair care haven! Our app isn't just about tackling hair woes; it's your personal guide to embracing and celebrating every strand of your unique hair journey. With over 50,000+ hours of lovingly curated content tailored for every hair type, age, and style preference, we're here to ensure that your hair doesn't just look good but feels amazing, too.
What's Inside?
Endless Inspiration: Dive into a sea of hairstyles and care tips, designed for everyone from the trendsetting teenager to the graceful senior, and every age in between. Curly, straight, wavy, or coily—our library doesn't discriminate!
Track Your Progress: Ever wonder how your hair reacts to different seasons or treatments? Our intuitive tracker does just that, capturing your hair's mood swings and victories, making your care routine smarter with every entry.
DIY Hair Magic: From kitchen-shelf remedies to grandma's secrets, explore articles and videos packed with home remedies that promise to bring the best out of your locks, naturally.
Stay on Track with Smart Reminders: Never miss a beat in your hair care routine with our Smart Reminders. Set notifications for any hair care activity—be it conditioning, trimming, or massaging—and get timely nudges to keep your hair looking its best. Customize reminders to fit your schedule and hair care needs, ensuring you always stay on track.
Calm Your Mind with Meditation: Embrace a holistic approach to hair care with our new meditation feature. Relax and rejuvenate with guided meditations that not only reduce stress but also promote healthier hair growth.
Style Meets Substance: It's not just about looking good but feeling great. Our content is as much about style as it is about deep-rooted hair health, ensuring you've got the knowledge to keep your hair thriving.
Why You'll Love Us:
Personalized to Perfection: Say goodbye to one-size-fits-all solutions. Our app molds around your hair's needs, ensuring personalized advice that makes a difference.
Beyond the Surface: We're not just surface-level beauty. Dive deep into articles and videos that tackle everything from simple style hacks to the science of hair health.
Your Hair, Your Community: Share stories, swap tips, and connect with hair enthusiasts who are on the same journey as you. Your next hair bestie might just be a click away.
Simplicity at Its Best: Who said hair care has to be complicated? Our app breaks down complex routines into easy, actionable steps, keeping you motivated and on track.
Embark on a journey that's all about celebrating the true essence of your hair, armed with the best tips, tricks, and treatments from around the globe. Whether you're combating frizz, dreaming of volume, or simply looking to maintain your mane, our app ensures you have everything you need to make every day a great hair day.
Curious to see how we can transform your hair care routine? Download now and start exploring a world where your hair's potential is endless. For support or a chat about your hair goals, drop us a line at g@unicorn.games. Here's to good hair days, every day!

bluejetty:00022092:ios.description:
جامع الكتب التسعة أدق وأشمل تطبيق إسلامي خاص بعلم الحديث النبوي الشريف يشتمل على كتب الحديث التسعة المشهورة لدى علماء السنة النبوية الشريفة والتي تعتبر أهم المراجع وأوفاها وأشملها للحديث الشريف والتي تتضمن فتح الباري شرح صحيح البخاري و كتاب صحيح مسلم بشرح النووي وكذلك السنن الأربعة وهي ،عون المعبود شرح سنن أبي داود وتحفة الأحوذي شرح سنن الترمذي وحاشية السندي على كل من سنن النسائي ،سنن بن ماجة ، سنن الدارمي و مسند الإمام أحمد بن حنبل ولا يفوتنا ذكر المنتقى شرح موطأ الإمام مالك، ليكون التطبيق موسوعة الحديث الشريف لكل طالب علم في الحديث لاكتشاف الدرر السنية في هدي النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.
مزايا التطبيق
* كتب الحديث التسعة *
عرض لجميع الكتب التسعة بشروحها وفقا لأدق النسخ تحقيقا.
* رواة الحديث *
 التعريف برواة الأحاديث الشريفة الحديث سند الكتب التسع.
* البحث *
بحث متقدم بكلمة ، جزئ من حديث أو برقم الحديث وكذلك البحث بأبواب الكتب.
* الشجرة الموضوعية * 
 تقسيم موضوعي لكامل أحاديث الكتب التسعة.
* حكم ونوع الحديث * 
* الحكم على الحديث من وتصحيح وحسن وضعيف وكذلك نوع الحديث إن كان مرفوعًا أو موقوفًا أو قدسي أو مقطوع.
* الغريب *
شرح لغريب الحديث.
* تخريج الحديث *
تخريج الحديث وعرض الأطراف والشواهد 
* المشاركة *
مشاركة الحديث عبر وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي.
* الملاحظات والمفضلة *
تدوين الملاحظات وإضافة الأحاديث للمفضلة.
* إعدادات العرض *
تغيير نوع الخط وحجمه ولونه وإخفاء السند أو اظهاره وإمكانية عرض التطبيق بالنمط الليلي لسهولة القرآءة.

bluejetty:00091648:ios.description:
Keeneland’s free Race Day app is your guide to handicapping and enjoying a day of Keeneland Racing - all at your fingertips!
New: Beautiful new look and feel with improved user experience and interactive elements to help make your day at the races even more memorable!
Bet Simulator
 Use the Bet Simulator to calculate and save your bets on your phone so you know how much they cost and you’ll be prepared to place your bets when you get to the window.
  Mobile Betting
 Access mobile betting through Keeneland Select.  
View Entries 
Select your favorite horses in upcoming races and save them for future bets (just like circling horses’ names in the program) and view race results.  
Watch Live
 Watch Keeneland races live and look back at race replays.  
Keeneland Info 
View maps of Keeneland’s Grandstand and grounds, read about race-day events and special promotions and schedule a walking tour of Keeneland year-round. Need to find a dining room? Have a craving for burgoo? Use the interactive map with search and filter capabilities to navigate your way through Keeneland.
  Get Tips
 Access wagering tools such as Handicappers’ Consensus (picks from Mike Battaglia, Katie Gensler and others) and learn what the experts have to say about upcoming races.

bluejetty:00134084:ios.summary: NOAA Tide Chart & Forecast puts NOAA's official tide data right in your pocket: accurate predictions, real-time conditions, and easy station search, all in one…NOAA Tide Chart & Forecast puts NOAA's official tide data right in your pocket:
bluejetty:00134084:ios.description:
NOAA Tide Chart & Forecast puts NOAA's official tide data right in your pocket: accurate predictions, real-time conditions, and easy station search, all in one…NOAA Tide Chart & Forecast puts NOAA's official tide data right in your pocket: accurate predictions, real-time conditions, and easy station search, all in one app.
Whether you're sailing, fishing, boating, or surfing, our app helps you plan around the tides with confidence. 
Our app offers professional tide predictions for high and low tides across the globe, as well as day-to-day forecasts for in-depth tidal data on a specific date. You can also access real-time solunar data for sunrise and sunset times, as well as monthly reports for long-term planning.
Here is a summary of the features we offer:
Key Features:
- Global tide charts: high and low water predictions for stations worldwide, shown as a full curve so you can read the whole day at a glance rather than just the peak times
- Daily tide forecast: in-depth tidal insights for the day ahead, including the timing and height of each high and low.
- Find tides near you: location-based search picks up your nearest station instantly, so you get data for where you actually are rather than the nearest big port.
- Fishing tide chart tools: solunar data showing the major and minor periods that drive feeding activity, so you can time your trip around the best bite windows.
- Fish Activity Score: rates each day from 0 to 100 using solunar periods, moon phase and local conditions. It shows your best window for the day along with major and minor feeding times.
- Lunar calendar and real-time sunrise and sunset tracking: moon phase and daylight times for your station, useful for planning early starts and late returns.
- Monthly tide reports: see the full month ahead in one view to plan trips, spring tides and the lowest water of the month well in advance.
- Tide Alerts: set an alert for the conditions you care about and get notified before they happen, a low tide for clamming, slack water for diving, or the incoming push you've been waiting for.
- Wave and swell forecasts: height, period and direction for any station, so you know what the water will actually be doing before you head out.
- Tide history: quickly access past tide information to check conditions on a day that fished or sailed well, and plan around the same pattern next time.
- Flexible search: find any station by name, station ID or location, whether you know exactly where you're going or you're exploring somewhere new.
- Favorites: save the spots you use most and view their high and low data instantly, without searching again each time.
- Filtered views: switch between All, Nearest and Favorites to get to the station you need in a couple of taps.
- Customize units: set feet or metrs, 12 or 24 hour time, and the measurement preferences that match how you read conditions.
Terms of Use
https://tide.nextstack.org/public/terms-of-usage.pdf

bluejetty:00134276:ios.description:
Draw Easy AI: AR Trace Sketch
-> AI Drawing:
- Describe what you want to draw using a prompt, tap "Generate" to instantly create an AI-made image for trace and sketch.
-> AR Drawing:
- Select any image from camera, gallery, or ready-made categories
- Adjust edges or apply filters if needed
- Place the image on a surface through your phone's camera view
- Follow real-time AR outlines to trace accurately
->What is Tracing?
- Tracing is used to transfer an image into line work from a photo or artwork. Simply place your tracing paper over the image and let your creativity flow as you trace the lines. So, Trace it & Sketch it.
- Using this app you can learn drawing or tracing.
-Whether you're a beginner or an aspiring artist, this app is your perfect companion for learning drawing and tracing. 
-> So how does it works?
- Select an image from the gallery or capture an image with a camera, then simply apply the filter. Once applied, you will see the filtered image on the camera screen with transparency. Now, place a drawing paper or any desired surface on which you want to trace and draw. The image will not appear on the paper directly, but as a transparent overlay on the camera, allowing you to trace it accurately onto the paper.
- Draw on paper by looking at the phone with a transparent image.
- Select any image and convert it to a tracing image.
->Advance Filters. 
1. Edge level : With Edge Level filter, you can control the sharpness and definition of edges in your drawings, giving them a different and professional look. Adjusting the Edge Level can help you achieve different artistic styles and emphasise specific details.
2. Contrast :The Contrast filter lets you enhance the tonal range in your drawings, making the colors appear more vibrant and the shadows and highlights more pronounced. It adds depth and richness to your artwork.
3. Noise: To tackle any unwanted noise in your drawings or images, we have included a Noise filter. This feature helps reduce graininess or pixelation, resulting in cleaner and smoother lines and surfaces.
4. Sharpness : The Sharpness filter enables you to enhance the overall clarity and crispness of your drawings. By adjusting the sharpness level, you can achieve a more defined and polished look, making your artwork stand out.
Enjoy Drawing....

bluejetty:00068837:ios.description:
Count anything, anywhere. The most intuitive gesture-based tally counter for iOS, now with home screen widgets and Apple Watch support.
KEY FEATURES

Clean, Minimalist Design - Distraction-free interface with large, clear numbers. Focus on counting, not navigating menus.

Premium features like widgets and Apple Watch support take it further - track your counts across all your devices with seamless synchronization.

bluejetty:00027452:ios.description:
Resize, de-squeeze, and upscale your photos and videos — with batch processing, HDR, and Live Photo support. Apply 100+ templates for quick social media, optimization, and anamorphic results. Enter exact sizes up to 18,000 × 12,000 px for photos and 8K for videos for your custom results. Optimize format, file size, and color profile — while preserving high quality and metadata.
DESQUEEZE FEATURES:
Resize Photos and Videos
• Enter a new size in pixels, aspect ratios, and percentages
• Resize in three different ways: Stretch, Fill, and Fit
• Choose between Normal and Smart size for more flexible resizing
• Batch resize an unlimited number of photos and videos
• Reuse up to 10 recent resizing tasks with one tap
• De-squeeze anamorphic photos to achieve a natural look
• Resize Live Photos while preserving their format, or convert them to still images
Import Sources inside Desqueeze
• Select photos and videos from the Photo Library
• Select any full album from the Photo Library
• Select multiple photos and videos from the Files app
• Take a picture with the camera
Reformat Photos
• Choose between PNG, JPEG, HEIC, and TIFF image formats
• Specify compression quality for JPEG, HEIC, and TIFF formats
• Select Auto format to reuse the original image format when possible
• Adjust image resolution with a new DPI, or keep the original DPI
Reformat Videos
• Choose between MP4, QuickTime (MOV), and M4V video formats
• Select Auto format to reuse the original video format when possible
• Choose video codec between Auto, H.264, and HEVC(H.265)
• Specify video bitrate or use Automatic
Edit Photos and Videos
• Flip and rotate images or videos
• Choose a background color for Fit mode
• Specify default background color for photos and videos
• Adjust position and offset for Fill and Fit modes
Manage Colors for Photo and Video 
• Apply one of 12 Color Profiles, inlcuding Original (Automatic)
• Process photos and videos while preserving HDR
Templates
• Use a universal set of 100+ standard templates to resize photos and videos for specific platforms and standards, including Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and more
• Create personal templates for your own tasks
• Duplicate standard templates and modify personal templates
• Customize standard Tempalate Library for your workflow and needs
Photo Viewer and Video Player
• Preview photos or play videos on the Result screen (long press a photo or video to preview)
Share Photos and Videos
• Save results to the Photo Library or Files app
• Share results via Instagram, Mail, Facebook, Messages, etc
• Use original or custom names for shared results
———
Basic (Free) version has some limitations. You can learn more about them inside the app.
———
Upgrade to PRO to unlock all features and remove all Basic version limitations (In-App Purchase).
PRO version is available to other family members when Family Sharing is enabled. PRO version can be canceled at any time.
———
Maximum target pixel size for photos and videos:
Photos (8-bit): 
• Basic (Free) version: 4,032 x 3,024 px
• PRO version: from 12,000 x 10,000 px (iPhone XR) up to 18,000 x 12,000 px (iPhone 16 Pro)
Note: Maximum size for 16-bit photos is lower due to hardware limitations.
Videos: 
• Basic (Free) version: 1920 x 1080 px
• PRO version: 7680 x 4320 pixels (8K)
———
Contact & Links
• Contact us by Email: contact@desqueeze.com
• Follow us on Twitter and Facebook: @desqueeze
• Visit our Website: http://desqueeze.com
• Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
• Privacy Policy: http://desqueeze.com/privacy

bluejetty:00138945:ios.description:
Powered by advanced AI and grounded in medical science, Death Clock reveals not just when you might die—but how to live better, longer.
The Life Lab turns your health data into a personalized plan for longevity. Your AI health concierge guides you through every step: analyzing bloodwork, optimizing habits, and tracking progress as your projected lifespan evolves in real time.
Step 1: Discover Your Baseline
Understand your current life expectancy through our AI-driven longevity model, built from CDC data, global mortality research, and your lifestyle inputs like daily habits and workouts. Each subscription includes comprehensive blood testing, giving you deeper insight into key biomarkers like blood pressure, blood sugar, hormone levels, fasting blood glucose, and heart health that drive your overall health and lifespan.
Step 2: Build Your Health Plan
Get clear, evidence-backed recommendations for diet, exercise, supplements, and screenings—no noise, no gimmicks. Our clinical board of leading physicians and longevity researchers provides doctor-guided advice on every framework and feature we build, ensuring Death Clock reflects the latest science in preventive healthcare, and life-extension research. Use our AI health coach to form better habits and track your progress with a personalized health tracker.
Step 3: Add Years to Your Life
After answering questions related to your health and habits, Death Clock gives you a death date prediction, but every healthy change feeds back into your Life Clock, stretching time a little further each day. Track improvements in cholesterol, inflammation, kidney function, glucose, blood pressure, heart rate, and other biomarkers to see your projected lifespan increase in real-time.
The Concierge Difference
Trained on your unique health profile, your 24/7 AI health concierge interprets lab results, identifies next steps, and speaks the language of preventive medicine and healthcare. It’s like having a private longevity doctor or health tracker—without the $10,000 retainer. Sync your Apple Health data, or activity metrics from wearables like WHOOP and Oura Ring. Monitor vital signs like blood pressure, heart rate, blood sugar, and heart conditions with ease. The AI health concierge can also give you recommendations on supplements and medicine, and on how to get better sleep and relieve stress.
Privacy by Design
Your data is fully encrypted and never sold. Longevity should feel empowering, not invasive, as you use the Death Clock AI app’s features and bloodwork scheduling for better health.
Your Time Starts Now
Predict your death date and start the countdown. Schedule your blood draw. Create your longevity plan. Take your time back and extend your life with Death Clock, your AI health coach and tracker.
Download includes a free trial of all premium features. A subscription is required for full access to your personalized longevity data and tracking tools.
Terms of Use: https://deathclock.co/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://deathclock.co/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00177731:ios.name: Paddle Paddle
bluejetty:00177731:ios.summary: Paddle Paddle is the tracker made for life on the water. Kayak, canoe, paddle board or rowing shell: start a session and Paddle Paddle maps every stroke, keeps your numbers big and readable in the sun, and saves each outing so you can reliv
bluejetty:00177731:ios.description:
Paddle Paddle is the tracker made for life on the water. Kayak, canoe, paddle board or rowing shell: start a session and Paddle Paddle maps every stroke, keeps your numbers big and readable in the sun, and saves each outing so you can relive it, share it and beat it next time.
See everything at a glance. A full-screen map shows your route as you paddle, while clean floating panels keep speed, one-minute and total average speed, distance, stroke rate, stroke effort and heart rate in view. On bright days, switch to high-visibility mode for opaque panels, extra-large numbers and full screen brightness. Pause, Resume and Finish use slide-to-confirm controls, so splashes and wet fingers never stop your session by accident.
Paddle with purpose. Long-press anywhere on the map to set a target and Paddle Paddle shows the direction and distance to it. Loved a past route? Choose “Paddle this route again” and follow it on the map. Voice cues announce your time, distance, speed, heart rate and battery at the interval you choose, so you can keep your eyes on the water. Lock your iPhone and put it in a dry bag: tracking continues until you press Finish.
Know your stroke. Paddle Paddle measures your stroke rate with the iPhone’s motion sensors, tuned separately for kayak, canoe, paddle board and rowing. Wear an Apple Watch for even better wrist-based stroke rate, or pair a standard Bluetooth heart-rate strap for live heart rate.
Every session, beautifully organized. History gives you monthly totals, an eight-week trend and a route preview on every session, plus a map of everywhere you’ve paddled. Open a session to see your route colored by speed, charts of speed, stroke rate and heart rate over time, weather at the start and finish, notes and a timeline of your pauses. Trim the end of a session, merge two sessions, or change the equipment in a tap.
A real Apple Watch app. Start a session right from your wrist with live time, distance, speed, stroke rate and heart rate, plus Water Lock built in. Leave your iPhone on shore if you like: sessions recorded on the watch sync to your iPhone automatically. Paddling with both? Your watch adds its stroke rate and heart rate to the session recorded on your iPhone.
Share and sync. Create a shareable image of any session, export GPX or TCX files for other apps and services, or send sessions to Strava. Keep your history safe and in sync across your devices with iCloud. Paddle Paddle works with Apple Health: it reads your weight and age for accurate calorie estimates and saves each session as a paddle-sports workout. Distances can be shown in kilometers, miles or nautical miles.
Paddle Paddle is free to download and use for tracking, with ads. An optional subscription removes ads and unlocks iCloud sync, automatic upload to Strava and the full set of voice cues. Monthly and annual subscriptions are available, and the annual plan offers the best value. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://oxigenator.com/products/paddle-paddle/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://oxigenator.com/products/paddle-paddle/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00183168:ios.name: Omi Game
bluejetty:00183168:ios.summary: Welcome to Omi Game, the ultimate mobile version of the traditional card game in Sri Lanka. Experience the thrill of a cherished Sri Lankan tradition with "OMI: The Card Game" - a captivating mobile adaptation of the beloved Sinhala Omi. Im
bluejetty:00183168:ios.description:
Welcome to Omi Game, the ultimate mobile version of the traditional card game in Sri Lanka. Experience the thrill of a cherished Sri Lankan tradition with "OMI: The Card Game" - a captivating mobile adaptation of the beloved Sinhala Omi. Immerse yourself in the authentic gameplay, featuring quality graphics, mind-relaxing music, and the original essence of the traditional game.
Game Features:
Quality Graphics: Enjoy stunning visuals that bring the essence of Omi to life, from the beautifully designed cards to the captivating user interface.
Mind-Relaxing Music: Let the soothing melodies accompany you throughout your gameplay, creating a calming atmosphere as you strategize and make your moves.
Original Traditional Game Experience: We've meticulously crafted this mobile adaptation to stay true to the core elements and rules of the original Sinhala Omi. Get ready for an authentic and immersive gaming experience.
Multiplayer with Global Players and Friends: Challenge yourself against players from around the globe in multiplayer mode, where you can test your skills and strategies against a diverse array of opponents. Connect with friends and engage in friendly competitions, or make new acquaintances as you rise through the ranks to become a true Omi master. Plus, enjoy the added dimension of real-time communication with built-in voice chat, allowing you to coordinate strategies and share the excitement of gameplay with ease. Whether you're playing against local friends or facing off against players from distant lands, multiplayer Omi offers an immersive and connected gaming experience that transcends boundaries. Join the global community of Omi players today and experience the thrill of multiplayer gaming with voice chat!
How to Play:
Objective
Strive to win the highest number of tricks in each round to achieve victory.
Dealing Cards
A standard international 52-card pack is used, but only 32 cards are in play. Each player receives two batches of four cards, resulting in a total of eight cards per player.
Choosing the Trump Suit
The player to the dealer's right selects the trump suit, which will hold higher value over other suits for the entire round.
Leading the First Trick
The player who chose the trump suit leads the first trick by playing any card from their hand. Other players must follow suit if possible; otherwise, they can play any card.
Winning Tricks
The highest card of the suit led wins the trick unless trumps are played. In that case, the highest trump card takes the trick. The player who wins a trick leads the next one.
Counting Tricks and Tokens
After the eighth trick, both teams count the tricks they've won. Earning 5, 6, or 7 tricks with the trump suit awards one token to the team that chose the suit. Winning the same number of tricks without the trump suit gives two tokens to the other team. If a team secures all 8 tricks, they earn three tokens known as "Kapothi." If both teams win an equal number of tricks (4 each), no tokens are transferred, but the next team to win more than 4 tricks earns an extra token.
Winning the Game
The first team to accumulate 10 or more tokens emerges as the triumphant champion of Sinhala Omi!

To report any issues with usage or just to share feedback and tell us how we can improve, please email info@ceydigital.com
