bluejetty:00178269:ios.name: Sleep Cycle - Sleep Calculator
bluejetty:00178269:ios.summary: Does your phone alarm wake you up angry, make you mad for the whole day, and sometimes not even go off? Our sleep calculator will help you fall asleep and wake up in the most natural way and help you get your day started full of energy and
bluejetty:00178269:ios.description:
Does your phone alarm wake you up angry, make you mad for the whole day, and sometimes not even go off? Our sleep calculator will help you fall asleep and wake up in the most natural way and help you get your day started full of energy and with a smile on your face.
Waking up in the middle of a sleep cycle can leave you groggy and ruin your whole day. Our app helps you find the perfect moment to wake up or fall asleep in order to maximize your sleep and keep you fresh all day. A normal sleep cycle lasts 90 minutes and, using that as a foundation, our app calculates the exact moment when you’re brain and body are ready to awaken.
Our app uses natural sounds to slowly bring you out of your sleep cycle and make sure you are wide awake. Once you have selected the sound of your choice, the sound will be played slowly and steadily, increasing in volume, for one minute.
There are eight natural sounds you can choose from:
- Bird Song
- Birds in the forest
- Ambient loop
- Gentle piano
- Seaside Sounds
- Garden
- Rapid river 
- Kenyan Savannah Grassland
The app allows you to choose:
- when to wake up
- when to go to sleep
- when to wake up if you sleep now
You can also set up alarm with the app and browse all "Sleep Time" alarms inside our app.
This app is perfect for modern people who often don't get enough sleep. This app allows you to maximize the amount and quality of sleep you get and make sure you are never late (or groggy) to a class or meeting again!
Features:
- calculates when to wake up and when to sleep to feel great
- calculates when to wake up if you are already asleep now
- add an alarm by clicking on a time
- light and Dark themes
- choose from 8 natural sounds
- browse all "Sleep Time" alarms inside the app

Privacy policy: https://mysticmobileapps.com/legal/privacy/sleepcycle

bluejetty:00069871:ios.name: Paku - Air Quality & AQI Map
bluejetty:00069871:ios.summary:
See the air you’re actually breathing.
Most apps give you one AQI number for your whole city. Paku shows you live readings from thousands of PurpleAir and AirGradient sensors, so you know when it’s safe to open the windows, go for a run, o
bluejetty:00069871:ios.description:
See the air you’re actually breathing.
Most apps give you one AQI number for your whole city. Paku shows you live readings from thousands of PurpleAir and AirGradient sensors, so you know when it’s safe to open the windows, go for a run, or send the kids outside.
→ A map of real, live sensors
Every public PurpleAir and AirGradient sensor on a fast, beautiful map, indoors and out, with AQI, temperature, humidity, and how they’re trending. Official AirNow government stations are on the map too, and a Data Sources screen lets you choose which networks you see. Smart Select picks the most reliable sensor near you, not just the closest one.
→ Widgets for every screen
Put the nearest sensor, a favorite spot, or your own sensor on your Home Screen, Lock Screen, Apple Watch, or Mac desktop. Glance, then get on with your day.
→ Alerts that beat the smoke
Set a threshold on any sensor and Paku will notify you the moment it’s crossed, then again when the air clears. Nearby alerts can even follow you, watching the closest sensor as you move, entirely on your device. If you live with wildfire smoke or winter inversions, this feature is for you.
→ Live Activities
Keep the AQI and its trend in the Dynamic Island or on your Lock Screen while smoke moves through.
→ Your own sensors
Own a PurpleAir sensor? Add your private sensors and use them everywhere: on the map, in widgets, and with alerts.
→ Siri, Spotlight, and Shortcuts
Ask Siri for the air quality nearby, check it from Spotlight, or use the AQI in automations, like turning on the air purifier when the number starts climbing.
→ On every device, in sync
iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, with a live reading in your menu bar. Favorites and settings sync over iCloud.
→ Private by design
Your location never leaves your device. No account, no tracking, no data collection.
A few things reviewers have said:
“Does one job, does it very well, and keeps getting better... I wish all software was like this.”
“Seriously impressed by this app. It’s the perfect companion to my PurpleAir outdoor sensor.”
“Ten stars.”
Paku is made by one person, not a company. No growth team, no engagement tricks, just an app I use every day and keep making better. Alerts, Live Activities, and private sensors are part of Paku Pro, a small subscription or one-time lifetime unlock that keeps everything running. The map, the widgets, and the rest are free.

bluejetty:00016283:ios.description:
DICE makes going out easy. Discover the best shows, club nights, and festivals near you and get tickets in seconds.
DISCOVER PERSONALIZED EVENTS
Stay in the loop with events happening in your area with notifications and relevant shows appearing in your home feed. Connect your Spotify or Apple Music to discover events based on your taste. Create the nightlife you want by following friends, artists and venues. More music, less noise.
UPFRONT PRICING
See the full price upfront every time, with no surprises at checkout. No resellers or hiked-up prices, just secure and easy access to your tickets, right there on your phone. Get the chance to access sold-out shows at face value with our wait list.
QUICK & EASY
DICE takes fans from discovery to ticket purchase in just a few taps. Use Apple Pay or securely save your card in the app to make every purchase a breeze. Just show your QR code at the door, and you’re in. Not a PDF in sight.
PLAN WITH FRIENDS
Follow your friends, see what they’re going to and invite them to shows with a couple of taps. Share plans with your community as and when you choose. Transfer tickets between friends quickly, safely and easily.
THE BEST NIGHTS OUT ARE ON DICE
Discover the most share-worthy shows in your local area at incredible clubs and venues. We partner with the best artists, venues and promoters to bring you shows you’ll never forget. From emerging artists on the brink of greatness to the world’s most legendary bands, you can find your crowd tonight on DICE.
WE’VE GOT MERCH 
Get exclusive access to artist merch drops. Make your night out special with VIP access, artist meet-and-greets and a grab-bag of other fun extras. Do more than just tickets the DICE way.
We are the alternative. Join the 10 million+ fans using DICE every month to go out more.
——

bluejetty:00029939:ios.name: Shop Ethical!
bluejetty:00029939:ios.summary:
The SHOP ETHICAL! app gives you the low-down on the environmental and social record of companies behind common brands you buy in Australian supermarkets and beyond. Shop with a clear conscience!
The most comprehensive guide to ethical shop
bluejetty:00029939:ios.description:
The SHOP ETHICAL! app gives you the low-down on the environmental and social record of companies behind common brands you buy in Australian supermarkets and beyond. Shop with a clear conscience!
The most comprehensive guide to ethical shopping in Australia, Shop Ethical! has been designed to provide consumers with the easiest way to make informed purchasing decisions. 
The Shop Ethical! app provides consumers instant access to over 5,000 products with related company information and lets them make an informed and ethical decision whenever they shop.
By shopping ethically consumers can send a strong message for change and help support the practices that make our world a better place to live in.
The Shop Ethical! app uses the latest data from the Shop Ethical! website (ethical.org.au) and is also available as a book. The Shop Ethical! app has been downloaded thousands of times since 2010, and the Shop Ethical! book has sold over 135,000 copies since 2008.
Company ratings are based on information gathered from over 50 sources including the work of organisations such as Greenpeace, Choose Cruelty Free, WWF, Rank a Brand and Friends of the Earth.
Shop Ethical! is a collaboration between the Ethical Consumer Group and Outware Mobile. 
AS FEATURED ON CHANNEL 7 NEWS! 
CUSTOMER TESTIMONIALS : 
  Best app I have, I use it daily and it's changed the way I see the world. 
 Emma, VIC 
  Simply, "Thank you." I am so grateful that you have done all the hard work, so that lazy/tired/child-distracted mothers like me can confidently tell their whining 8 year olds "no, we are not buying that, because the people who will get our money hurt other people and/or animals".  I have always wanted this information but have never had the spare energy to go and find it myself. You have done a brilliant job. Please let me know if you have a panel of testers or proof readers which requires more members, or any other way in which I can contribute to your efforts from home while Miss 8 sleeps. I have been forwarding your "tell a friend" message onto everyone I know who has an iPhone.  
Annie, Boronia, VIC   
AWESOME app!! Thanks guys. I'm a naturopath that tries to educate my patients on the benefits of ethical shopping and living sustainably. Will definitely be recommending this app to my patients. Great work! 
 Elise, Vic   
Thank you big time for this app!! It's so easy to use at the supermarket and clarifies so many of the issues surrounding products and companies, making the weekly shop fit better with my conscience. My kids are also able to look and see if their favourite things are positive or negative and can make their own ethical shopping decisions. Brilliant!!!  
Sara, Canberra
This app works on both iPhone and iPad. It is optimised for smartphones, not tablets.

bluejetty:00131327:ios.name: SnoreLab : Record Your Snoring
bluejetty:00131327:ios.summary:
The most popular and innovative app of its kind, SnoreLab records, measures and tracks your snoring and helps you to discover effective ways to reduce it.
SnoreLab has monitored more than 50 million nights of sleep and has helped millions
bluejetty:00131327:ios.description:
The most popular and innovative app of its kind, SnoreLab records, measures and tracks your snoring and helps you to discover effective ways to reduce it.
SnoreLab has monitored more than 50 million nights of sleep and has helped millions of people to better understand or even eliminate their snoring problem.
The app is very easy to use: simply set SnoreLab running next to your bed whilst you sleep. In the morning you will discover your Snore Score, exactly when and how loudly you snored, and listen to some highlights!
SnoreLab lets you log and track lifestyle factors and any snoring remedies so you can see how they impact your snoring.
SnoreLab is attracting endorsements from doctors, dentists and users alike. The app can be useful in medical consultations when investigating sleep disorders such as sleep apnea.
Are you a room shaker or a snorter? A buzz saw or a whistler? Or do you just purr like a kitten? Discover the truth with SnoreLab! What's your Snore Score?
'An ingenious app' - Mail Online
'Best Health App - Runner-up' - Best App Ever Awards 2014
FEATURES:
▷ Snore Detection: Identifies snoring using advanced algorithms.
▷ Snore Recording: Captures sound samples of your snoring throughout the night.
▷ Snore Score: Measures snoring intensity to help you track your snoring over time.
▷ Breathing Analysis: BreathFlow®, SnoreLab’s unique measure of breathing stability correlated with apnea severity, analyzes sound patterns to detect indicators of irregular breathing. 
▷ Breathing Rate: Tracks your respiratory rate and identifies possible breathing interruptions.
▷ Nightly Comparison: See how your snoring changes from night to night.
▷ Remedy Testing: Measure how snoring remedies or lifestyle changes affect your results.
▷ Lifestyle Impact Tracking: Understand how factors like alcohol influence your snoring.
▷ Apple Health Integration: Syncs sleep and body stats seamlessly with Apple Health.
▷ Sleep Stats & Trends: Records detailed sleep metrics for better insights.
▷ Full-Night Recording: Continuous snore recording for deeper analysis.
▷ Share Recordings: Email snore sound files easily.
▷ Expert Remedies: Explore tips and information about effective snoring solutions.
▷ Simple & Intuitive: Easy to set up and use every night.
AWARDS:
▷ Top 10 Medical app in 30 countries
▷ "What's Hot" medical app in 33 countries
▷ Featured in Lifehacker, The Sunday Times, The Guardian, Quantified Self and others
SnoreLab has an average rating of 4.7 stars from over 10,000 user reviews. Here is a selection of some of our favourite reviews:
"This app is wonderful in that not only does it work, but its ease of use. This is a simple, effective tool to better health."
"Excellent app. This helped me to reduce my snoring by applying some of the remedies listed. My wife and I thank you, especially my Wife!"
"Take it from an MD... This program works and is a very useful tool to share with your doctor."
"SnoreLab is the best sleep recorder I have tried. My snoring is down 40 plus percent in just two weeks."
Your subscription can be cancelled or managed via your iTunes account settings. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24-hours before the end of the subscription period.
SnoreLab is not a medical device, nor is it intended to replace professional medical advice and/or diagnosis. SnoreLab is not intended to diagnose or treat sleep apnea or any illness/medical condition. Please consult with a licensed medical practitioner before making any decisions or taking any actions that may affect your health, safety and wellbeing. Do not disregard professional advice because of anything you have seen, heard or read in the app. Always consult with a healthcare professional if you have any questions or concerns about your snoring or general health.
Terms of Use: https://www.snorelab.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Notice: https://www.snorelab.com/snorelab-app-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00131537:ios.name: inRoute - Intelligent Routing
bluejetty:00131537:ios.summary:
Plan optimal routes or chart your own course using weather, elevation, curves and more. Then navigate safely with voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions that automatically check your route for severe weather. 
***Featured in Essential Navig
bluejetty:00131537:ios.description:
Plan optimal routes or chart your own course using weather, elevation, curves and more. Then navigate safely with voice-guided, turn-by-turn directions that automatically check your route for severe weather. 
***Featured in Essential Navigation Apps on the US App Store***
***As seen on the TODAY show in the Traveling This Summer segment***
“adding to both the safety of the ride and the pleasure of knowing beforehand what to expect” - Florin Tibu, “autoevolution”
“I used InRoute for planning six world record attempts. No weather app gives you more information, period.” - Carl Reese, Multiple World Record Holder
Key Features (some require inRoute Pro--see below):
• Voice guided navigation of up to 150 locations with automatic severe weather alerts*
• Optimize waypoint order for fastest time, or manually reorder
• Import from XLSX, GPX and KML files
• Create custom routes based on weather, elevation and curviness, or build your own route from available alternates on each leg of a route
• Interactive charts showing route elevation, curviness, weather (temperature, humidity, precipitation, wind speed/direction, severe weather alerts*), and sunrise/sunset times
• Search along a route—the whole route, every x miles/hours, or the next x miles/hours from a place—find gas, hotels, campgrounds or places to eat close to a route
• Enter your RV specs to avoid clearance issues and weight restrictions
• Set Departure and Layover Times—weather forecasts, road conditions (e.g. congestion), and travel times accurately reflect conditions throughout the trip
• Save your favorite routes and places, sync between devices, organize into folders, print via Airprint, and share with family and friends
• Easily add places to the map using a Dropped pin, Search, or Contacts
• Export routes to Apple Maps, Google Maps, Navigon, and Waze. Some apps use inRoute's "Agenda Nav" feature. See the in-app FAQ for more info.
• Export to GPS devices and apps compatible with GPX files
• Routes are stored on your device so you can access them even if you lose connection
inRoute Pro (for iPhone, iPad, CarPlay & Mac):
- $5.99 monthly, or $59.99 annually. 1 week free trial
- Create routes with up to 150 locations (8 in free version)
- Sync routes and pins between devices
- Weather charts/custom routes
- Speed limits and severe weather alerts* during navigation
- Export/share routes as GPX files
- RV routes based on vehicle description
*Severe weather alerts are available in select regions
Note: Since continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life, inRoute will automatically shut down if you haven't used it in a while.
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: http://inroute.com/privacy-policy
App Store EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00014191:ios.description:
The choice is yours! Joust for love and glory, solve an eldritch murder, find romance, or battle aliens with Magitek?
"Hosted Games" is a magnificent library of interactive novels, written by authors like you. Hosted Games are entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Try a few of these fan favorites:
• Zombie Exodus — Fight your way out of a zombie-filled city in this interactive horror story!
• Fallen Hero — Step into the shoes of a telepath turned villain and explore the dark side.
• Wayhaven Chronicles — Something stalks the shadows, and it's up to you to find out what!
• Sabres of Infinity — Step into the boots of a Royal Dragoon in this tale of war in a fantasy world.
• Golden Rose — Explore a medieval Europe where history took a different turn!
• Soul Stone War — Fight for the future—your own, and the world's! Your fate is yours.
• I, the Forgotten One — Can you defeat the rebellion in your kingdom before your past consumes you?
• An Unexpectedly Green Journey — From birth to death, craft your orc's legacy. Are you destined for glory?
• Fields of Asphodel — Join the ranks of the Underworld's misfit gods and make it your home!
• Tin Star — Ride out into the Old West as a U.S. marshal and craft a legend.
Authors just like you have developed these games using ChoiceScript, a simple programming language for writing multiple-choice interactive novels. Writing games with ChoiceScript is easy and fun, even for authors with no programming experience. Learn more at https://hostedgames.org

bluejetty:00187892:ios.description:
CommercialTruckTrader's mission is to bring everyone who needs commercial trucks to the dealers who sell and lease them. We believe in supporting small business and civic needs through robust search capabilities while delivering an easy visitor experience. CommercialTruckTrader is a part of the Trader Interactive family of sites, which also includes EquipmentTrader, CycleTrader, and RVTrader.
At CommercialTruckTrader, you will find the widest selection of classified ads with thousands of listings to choose from and dealers nationwide.
CommercialTruckTrader is the leading online classified advertising service bringing commercial buyers and sellers together in one virtual marketplace. We reach over 1 million active commercial buyers a month through our website, showcasing a variety of light, medium, and heavy duty vehicles.
CommercialTruckTrader provides dealers and independent owners alike access to commercial buyers who are interested in researching and purchasing new and used vehicles. CommercialTruckTrader is part of Trader Interactive's network of websites covering new and used vehicle categories such as trucks, equipment, boats, motorcycles, ATVs, and aircraft, as well as general merchandise.
Our number one goal is to provide the best service possible for our users. As a division of Trader Interactive, CommercialTruckTrader boasts the very best in technical support, hardware, and software to ensure that we are always ready when you need us.

bluejetty:00035294:ios.description:
Introducing AI Chatbot, the ultimate writing assistant that can take your.
Forget about communication stress and discover the world of efficient and effortless writing with AI Chatbot —the AI-powered keyboard that aims to make your chatting experience smoother and more enjoyable than ever before. Powered by AI, this amazing app can help you do much more than just type.
With AI Chatbot, you no longer have to worry about typos, grammar mistakes, or finding the right words to express yourself.
GET HELP FROM A SMART AI BOT
Streamline your daily writing tasks with an all-knowing AI assistant. Whether you need to craft a captivating text, summarize a book, or solve math problems and programming tasks, this chatbot has got you covered. Simply type in your request, and the app will carry out the tedious writing routine for you. On top of that, you can choose from hundreds of handy, ready-to-use prompts to jump into the conversation with the bot right away.
CHECK GRAMMAR AND SPELLING
AI Chatbot can check your text for grammatical errors in 7 different languages. Say goodbye to embarrassing typos and grammar mistakes.
WORDING RECOMMENDATION
AI Chatbot suggests better word choices for you to express yourself correctly. You won't ever find yourself thinking about the right words to say again.
TRANSLATION
AI Chatbot will translate your texts in real-time, no copy-paste needed!
LET AI COMPLETE YOUR MESSAGES
AI Chatbot can continue your texts based on the context you provide, making writing much faster. If you are in a hurry or simply don't feel like writing long paragraphs, leave it to TypeAI.
FINISH YOUR WRITING
Ever been in a hurry and couldn’t find the right words? Writely can analyze the context of your conversation and offer suggestions for completing sentences. It's like having a personal writing assistant right at your fingertips!
FLAVOR YOUR MESSAGES WITH EMOJIS
Our smart AI keyboard can add emojis to your messages, giving them a personal touch and making them more eye-pleasing. Writely suggests emojis based on the general tone of your message and the context of your conversation.AI Chatbot is a must-have app for anyone who writes on their phone. Download it now and take your writing to the next level!
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
• You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.

bluejetty:00066242:ios.description:
The premier console-quality water-racing game on mobile kicks everything into overdrive, with intense online multi-player races, upgradeable hydro jets and riders, improved graphics, an all-new career mode, and a whole new stunt system with dozens of new tricks!
Featuring rocket-powered hydro jets racing around futuristic tracks across a dynamic and interactive water surface, Riptide GP2 delivers a fast, fun, and visually stunning racing experience.
From Vector Unit, developers of acclaimed racing games Beach Buggy Racing, Shine Runner, and Hydro Thunder Hurricane!
• • GAME FEATURES • • 
• ONLINE MULTI-PLAYER
• Show off your skills and your custom-tuned hydro jet in 4-way online battles with friends and players around the world! 
• CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
• Race against your friends' best times in the exciting VR Challenge mode.
• ALL NEW CAREER MODE
• Play through Race, Hot Lap, Elimination, and Freestyle events to earn XP and cash that can be used to upgrade your hydro jet, unlock new stunts, and increase your rider's performance.
• ALL NEW WATERCRAFT
• Collect 9 powerful new hydro jets, and upgrade their performance and colors to gain an edge on your competition.
• ALL NEW STUNT SYSTEM
• Unlock and master 25 outrageous new stunts. Wow the crowd, charge your boost and make your competition eat wake. 
• NEW!! TOTAL CONTROL
• Seamlessly supports gamepads, extended gamepads, tilt, and touch-screen controls.
• GAME CENTER & iCLOUD ENABLED
• Race online, earn achievements and keep your game synced to the cloud with Game Center and iCloud integration.
• OPTIMIZED FOR METAL
• Full Metal optimization provides enhanced graphics, real time lighting and shadows, and super-smooth frame-rates on A7 and A8 devices (iOS 8 only).
• • CUSTOMER SUPPORT • • 
If you encounter a problem running the game, please email the device you're using, iOS version, and a detailed description of your problem to support@vectorunit.com. We guarantee if we can't fix your problem we'll give you a refund. But we can't help you if you just leave your problem in a review.
For support on most common issues please visit:
www.vectorunit.com/support
• • MORE INFORMATION • • 
Be the first to hear about updates, download custom images, and interact with the developers!
Like us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/VectorUnit
Follow us on X @vectorunit.
Visit our web page at www.vectorunit.com
We welcome comments and suggestions for future improvements. If you have a suggestion, or just want to say hi, email us at info@vectorunit.com.

bluejetty:00073736:ios.description:
Five best-selling nursing apps combine to form the premier, integrated clinical nursing solution. Use valuable tools to find and apply the information you need. Purchase includes iOS app, macOS app, and web access.
PLEASE NOTE: Current customers and institutional subscribers can use this app to download content to their iOS devices. 
ABOUT NURSING CENTRAL
Nursing Central helps nurses and students be more efficient by providing detailed information on diseases, tests, drugs, and procedures where and when it is needed. The moment a question arises you can consult the updating database of 5,000 drugs, find a definition in the dictionary with 75,000+ entries, interpret hundreds of laboratory and diagnostic tests, and consult the latest disease information. You can also search the entire PubMed database or study unfamiliar topics using the exclusive study system - Grasp™, all from your mobile device
Five best-selling nursing applications combine to form Nursing Central.
DAVIS’S DRUG GUIDE FOR NURSES
Refer to regularly updated information on dosing, contraindications, drug interactions, and patient education for more than 5,000 medications. 
TABER’S MEDICAL DICTIONARY 
Define over 75,000 medical terms and enhance learning with images, videos, and audio pronunciations. 
DAVIS’S LABORATORY AND DIAGNOSTIC TESTS 
Access rationale and results for tests as well as pretest requirements, intratest procedures, and post-test patient care. 
DISEASES AND DISORDERS 
Review complete coverage of more than 250 medical conditions. 
Prime PubMed
Connect to the full PubMed journal citations and abstracts database on your mobile device. Stay up to date with your favorite nursing and medical journals with Prime Journals, perform powerful searches, receive suggestions on relevant articles with Prime ForYou, link directly to the publisher’s full text, and share articles via email or social media. Visually explore the literature using Grapherence®, a unique way to find related and relevant articles. 
FEATURES
• Receive 1-year of drug updates
• Create custom notes and highlights within entries
• Consult trusted disease and test information 
• Jump quickly between resources using Cross Links 
• View thousands of colorful images, figures, and videos
• Learn on the go with our exclusive study system - Grasp™
• Access the full PubMed database
• Use the Full Text Search to help find topics across all resources
• Bookmark important entries with “Favorites” 
• Get access to Nursing Central website for one year
• Personalize your app by re-ordering resources to match your unique needs and preferences.
DRUG AND CONTENT UPDATE RENEWAL
• After initial Nursing Central purchase you will receive updates for one year
• After one year, you can purchase updates for an additional year, at the discounted rate of $99.99. If you do not choose to purchase, you can continue to use the product but will not receive updates.
• If you purchase updates, they will automatically renew annually at the renewal rate ($99.99) and charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase, unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours prior to the conclusion of the one-year subscription period.
• Account will be charged ($99.99) for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the yearly subscription term. 
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. 
Unbound Privacy Policy: www.unboundmedicine.com/privacy
Unbound Terms of Use: https://www.unboundmedicine.com/end_user_license_agreement

bluejetty:00126704:ios.description:
Get ready to pass your CFA Level 1 exam and take the first step toward becoming a Chartered Financial Analyst! 
The CFA Level 1 Practice Test app helps you master finance, investment, and analytical concepts through realistic tests, detailed explanations, and AI-powered study support. Designed for finance students, analysts, and professionals pursuing the CFA charter, this app covers every topic in the CFA Level 1 curriculum — helping you study smarter, understand deeper, and build the confidence to succeed. 
Our CFA Level 1 exam prep questions are categorized into various topics:
• Ethical and Professional Standards
• Quantitative Methods
• Economics
• Financial Statement Analysis
• Corporate Issuers
• Portfolio Management
• Equity Investments
• Fixed Income
• Derivatives
• Alternative Investments
**Why You’ll Love This App**
- Realistic CFA Level 1 Practice Tests: Simulate the actual CFA exam experience with timed tests and authentic-style multiple-choice questions covering Ethics, Economics, Quantitative Methods, Financial Reporting, Portfolio Management, and more.
- Study by Topic: Learn efficiently by focusing on specific subjects — from Corporate Finance to Equity Investments. Each question includes detailed rationales and CFA-style explanations.
- AI Mentor – Smart Study Assistant: Mentora, your AI-powered tutor, explains complex financial concepts and formulas in plain language, helping you retain knowledge and prepare smarter.
- Custom & Diagnostic Tests: Take a diagnostic test to identify your strengths and weaknesses, then build custom tests around weak areas to optimize your study time. 
- Detailed Explanations & References: Every question includes full explanations with topic references aligned to the CFA Institute Learning Outcomes Statements (LOS). 
- Progress Tracking & Analytic: Track your scores, passing probability, and mastery across CFA domains like Ethics, Quant, and Financial Reporting. Stay on top of your progress and focus your effort.
**Designed for Future CFAs**
Whether you’re starting your CFA journey or retaking Level 1, this app helps you study smarter, understand key finance principles, and pass with confidence.
Start Your CFA Journey Today! Download the CFA Level 1 Practice Test app now and take your first step toward earning your CFA charter.
Note: CFA Level 1 Exam Prep 2025 is an independent app and is not affiliated with any government entities.

bluejetty:00081027:ios.description:
Step into the ring and prepare for the ultimate fighting experience! MFC - Midnight Fight Club brings the raw intensity and excitement of professional mixed martial arts fighting right to your fingertips. With unparalleled graphics, a diverse roster of fighters, and realistic physics, this is the mobile fighting game you've been waiting for.
Features:
Dynamic Combat System
Choose from two types of attacks—weak and heavy—to outwit your opponents. Nail the timing, and you could land a devastating blow. But be careful, timing is everything!
Defensive Maneuvers
Tired of button mashing? Our game rewards strategic fighting. Block incoming attacks, dodge out of the way, or use your custom stats to outclass your opponent.
Stun Mechanism
Land a special combo to stun your opponent. A stunned enemy can't defend or counterattack, giving you a precious window to unleash your most powerful moves.
League Progression
Begin your career in the Rookie Rumble and fight your way through 10 challenging leagues, each more difficult than the last. Do you have what it takes to conquer the Ultimate Titan League?
Epic Boss Fights
Each league culminates in an epic boss battle. These bosses are not your typical fighters; they have unique abilities and patterns. Strategy is key!
Customizable Characters
Personalize your fighter's stats—Speed, Health, Stamina, Power, and Defense—to match your fighting style. Adapt and evolve to climb the ranks.
AI That Challenges You
Our AI learns from your fighting style. It dodges, blocks, and counterattacks like a pro. Adapt your strategy to conquer challenging opponents.
Why You'll Love MFC - Midnight Fight Club:
Realistic Physics: Experience lifelike combat with our state-of-the-art physics engine.
High-End Graphics: Our top-notch graphics make every punch, kick, and block feel incredibly real.
Player Rewards: Earn rewards as you progress through leagues and special events.
Regular Updates: Frequent updates add new characters, moves, and features to keep the action fresh.
Terms of use: https://midnight.games/terms/

• Mobile check deposit

• Manage alerts and secure messages

bluejetty:00125863:ios.summary: This is a real-time battle RPG focused around themes of "reconstruction and development" in a comical and fun pixel-art world. Explore a deteriorating island, gather materials, invest in industrial facilities, and build roads to revitalize
bluejetty:00125863:ios.description:
This is a real-time battle RPG focused around themes of "reconstruction and development" in a comical and fun pixel-art world. Explore a deteriorating island, gather materials, invest in industrial facilities, and build roads to revitalize the economy.
◆ Real-time battle that you can enjoy with easy controls!
Just trace the map with your finger and specify the route you want to explore, and the game will move and fight automatically.
If you are at a disadvantage in battle, activate the skills of your escort characters.
You can also damage enemies with the coin gun, which can only be used by the main character, the merchant.
◆Gather materials through exploration to develop the island!
You can get materials and gold by exploring each area and defeating enemies. Invest the gold you get in industrial facilities to develop the island's economy or craft materials to create equipment for your companions.
◆Invest in industrial facilities and build roads to encourage distribution! 
By building industrial facilities and roads with the materials and gold you acquire, the island's economy will be revitalized and the island's population will increase. By liberating the island within the amount of days set by the merchant guild, you will be able to explore new islands.
◆ Boost your escorts!
During battle, the player themselves has no means of attack. Your companions will automatically fight for you. There are various types of guards, so you can organize your party according to the route you choose to explore. You can even enhance the rarity of your guards by leveling them up or synthesizing them.

bluejetty:00132219:ios.description:
**Printer App: Your All-in-One Solution for Effortless Printing** 
Discover a revolutionary way to print with the Printer App. Seamlessly compatible with over 9,000 wireless printers, it empowers you to print documents and photos instantly. From intuitive file selection to advanced customization tools, the entire process is smooth and hassle-free. 
**Key Features of the Printer App** 
**Effortless Printing from iOS Devices** 
- Print documents, photos, web pages, contacts, and more with ease. 
- Directly print from Dropbox or Google Drive. 
- Supports over 20 file formats, including PDF, DOCX, PAGES, and TXT. 
**Seamless Document Scanning** 
- Scan documents effortlessly using the app’s built-in scanner. 
- Share or print your scanned files in just a few taps. 
**Advanced Printing Options** 
- Choose between portrait or landscape orientation. 
- Print single-sided or double-sided for convenience. 
- Adjust the number of pages per sheet. 
- Select black-and-white or full-color printing. 
- Support for a variety of paper sizes, including A3, A4, and B5. 
- Easily specify print range and number of copies for precision. 
**Comprehensive Document Editing** 
- Highlight, underline, or annotate your documents with ease. 
- Add custom text or notes as needed. 
- Access advanced editing tools for complete control. 
**Powerful Photo Enhancements** 
- Apply filters, blur effects, and adjust saturation. 
- Resize, crop, or modify proportions effortlessly. 
- Enhance image quality with contrast, sharpening, and masking tools. 
- A full suite of photo editing features for all your creative needs. 
The Printer App integrates seamlessly with any printer supporting wireless technology, offering a modern, streamlined printing experience. 
**Pro Tip:** For optimal performance, ensure your device and printer are connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/smart-air-printer-policy

bluejetty:00164820:ios.description:
Unleash your inner lion in the angry lion simulator game, the most realistic lion simulator game! In this game, you can experience the life of a lion in the wild jungle. You must hunt for food, raise a family, defend your territory from other predators, and become king of lion.
You can control your lion using the on-screen joystick and buttons. The joystick is used to move the lion around the environment, while the buttons are used to perform actions such as attacking, jumping, and roaring.
Hunt, explore and survive, you must track down your prey using a map and then attack it. You can use your lion's powerful jaws and claws to kill your prey. Once you have killed your prey, you can eat it to regain your health and energy.
To defend your territory, you must fight and you can use your lion's strength and skills to defeat your enemies.
* The game can teach players about the life of a lion in the wild jungle. Players can learn about lion-hunting behavior, social structure, and cub-raising.
* The game is fun and challenging to play. Players must use their skills and knowledge to survive in the jungle and raise a family.
* The game can be a relaxing way to escape from the stresses of everyday life. Players can enjoy the beautiful jungle scenery and the calming sounds of nature.
* The game features realistic graphics and sound effects that create an immersive jungle experience.
* The game features various animals that players can hunt or interact with.
* Players can unlock new abilities and skills for their lion as they progress through the game.
* The game features an online multiplayer mode where players can compete against each other or cooperate to complete challenges.
Are you ready to become the king of the jungle? Angry lion simulator game is the perfect game for you. With its realistic gameplay, variety of challenges, and stunning graphics, this game is the ultimate lion simulation experience.
So what are you waiting for? Start your hunting adventure right today!

bluejetty:00116137:ios.name: Spider Turbo - Solitaire Card
bluejetty:00116137:ios.summary: Enjoy the ultimate Spider Solitaire experience with Spider Turbo - Solitaire Card, a beautifully designed version of the classic card game. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the game, this version offers smooth gameplay and polished
bluejetty:00116137:ios.description:
Enjoy the ultimate Spider Solitaire experience with Spider Turbo - Solitaire Card, a beautifully designed version of the classic card game. Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the game, this version offers smooth gameplay and polished visuals that will keep you engaged for hours.
Features You'll Love:
* Classic Spider Solitaire gameplay
* Clean, easy-to-read cards
* 1, 2, and 4-suit difficulty levels
* Daily Challenges with rewarding crowns
* Smart hints and unlimited undos
* Customize card backs and backgrounds
* Play anytime—no internet required
* Portrait and Landscape modes supported
* Left-handed mode available
* Game auto-saves your progress
How to Play:
The goal is to remove all cards by assembling them in descending order from King to Ace in the same suit. Cards can be moved around the tableau as long as they follow descending order. Once a complete suit is assembled, it’s removed from the board. When you’re ready, deal a new row of cards—just make sure no column is empty!
Whether you're unwinding or training your brain, Spider Turbo - Solitaire Card is the perfect companion.
Start your Spider Solitaire journey today and enjoy the classic game reimagined.

bluejetty:00180784:ios.description:

Choose from a variety of body parts and clothes, and create your very own 3D character from an infinite combination of parts.
You can create your very own 3D character from a rich and wide variety of customization parts, such as hairstyle, clothes, skin color, face type and accessories.

The AR function is also available for iPhone X and later models to integrate the real world with your stream. Perhaps you can even become a virtual streamer in the real world...!?

bluejetty:00145440:ios.description:
Keeper of Secrets, congratulations on entering Mythag University.
This world is dying.
Hundreds of years ago, Dissolution came with no signs. Life, consciousness, memories...All the existence that humans once gave meaning to were erased by Dissolution.
Yet people were kept in the dark.
Confronted with this hidden and indescribable disaster, Mythag University, as one of the few who is well aware of this fact, is determined to fight against this vast crisis by waking up the power that shares the same source of the disaster and connecting the humanoid weapons that are on the edge of insanity.
If everything is bound to be forgotten, are you willing to testify that the world has once existed? Will you carry the secret on your back and walk on by?
In the witness of the gravestone, may the Silver Key guide your way.
Welcome aboard, Keeper of Secrets.
In this misty British-style world, you shall carry the secret of the times for the sake of all life.
In the crisis of Dissolution, grace and power will be with you everywhere you go.
Arrange your team, and wake the ones who share the same source of disasters.
Go through Rougelite game levels, and uncover the unspeakable truth with your strategy.
Experience this grand story with multiple chapters. You will find the trueness in this broken world.

bluejetty:00158082:ios.description:
■ About the game
"Laid-Back Camp All -in -one!! Chill Time" is a game that lets you spend your work or study time alongside Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others as you watch them camp.
Stoking the campfire, peering into the cooking pot, or lying down to gaze at the sky.
Whenever you glance over, you'll see them passing the time in their own unique ways.
The time you spend alone at your desk becomes time spent together with them.
■ The time spent with the Laid-Back Camp crew becomes a record of your day
Time accumulates in your diary each time you cycle between work and breaks using the Pomodoro timer.
List your tasks in the To-Do section and check them off as you complete them.
You can look back at your daily progress on the calendar at any time.
■ Create your own unique campsite with over 1,000 types of gear and outfit options
Freely dress up Nadeshiko, Rin, Chiaki, Aoi, and Ena in everything from their familiar outfits to original costumes.
Place tents, gear, and food wherever you like, crafting a scenic view you can gaze at all day long.
■ Compose your own soundscape to match your mood
Select background music and layer ambient sounds (campfire, rain, river, insects, wind, and sea) at your preferred balance.
A change in the sounds around you can transform the way you spend your time, even while sitting at the same desk.
■ The scenery keeps moving even while you pause your work
The camera shifts to different spots around the campsite every few seconds.
You can leave it running in the background while you work.
■ Main characters and cast
Nadeshiko Kagamihara: Yumiri Hanamori
Rin Shima: Nao Toyama
Chiaki Ogaki: Sayuri Hara
Aoi Inuyama: Aki Toyosaki
Ena Saito: Rie Takahashi
[Official Website]
https://yurucamp-game.enish.com/
[Official Twitter]

bluejetty:00120508:ios.name: PT Content Master
bluejetty:00120508:ios.summary: Make reviewing essential physical therapy academic content enjoyable! Physical Therapist Content Master is designed to assist physical therapists to possess full command of core academic content. Physical Therapist Content Master is an idea
bluejetty:00120508:ios.description:
Make reviewing essential physical therapy academic content enjoyable! Physical Therapist Content Master is designed to assist physical therapists to possess full command of core academic content. Physical Therapist Content Master is an ideal tool for physical therapist students, recent physical therapy graduates, and licensed physical therapists.
The academic content is organized into unique system and non-system categories. 
Musculoskeletal System
Neuromuscular System
Cardiopulmonary System
Other Systems
Equipment and Devices
Therapeutic Modalities
Safety and Protection
Professional Responsibilities
Research
Physical therapists can review selected content by scrolling through subcategories in each of the system and non-system areas. Our innovative design presents academic content in a user-friendly format that allows users to easily digest essential information. Users rate their competence in a variety of topics and create personalized Study Stacks. Study Stacks allow users to efficiently remediate identified academic deficiencies. Frequent review of essential academic content allows users to successfully convert the information to long-term memory. 
Physical Therapist Content Master includes an assessment mode that consists of 750 multiple-choice questions. Each multiple-choice question has four unique options and an explanation supporting the correct answer. The multiple-choice questions are designed to assess a user’s mastery of the information presented in the content review mode. The number of questions in each category varies from a minimum of 25 to a maximum of 175. Our Content Tag feature allows users to quickly review questions by topic area (i.e., special tests, cranial nerves, pulmonary function tests). 
A formal score report describes a physical therapist’s level of mastery cumulatively, by category, and by timeline. Each of the individual reports provides users with valuable performance data to assess their present level of academic mastery. Utilization of the app on a frequent basis considerably strengthens a physical therapist’s knowledge base and provides the necessary foundation to progress to higher level licensing-like questions. 
Company Information
Scorebuilders is a physical therapist owned company whose sole focus is to prepare students for the National Physical Therapy Examinations. We sell more review products and offer more review courses than any other company. Scorebuilders has experienced three decades of continuous growth and is the recognized leader in physical therapy licensing preparation. Scorebuilders offers candidates the knowledge and insight necessary to achieve their goal of becoming a licensed physical therapist on the first attempt.

bluejetty:00023953:ios.name: Vibration Meter, seismograph
bluejetty:00023953:ios.summary:
Vibration meter is an app called seismograph or seismometer, which measures the strength of vibration, quakes, earthquakes, vibrations of the human body or any other objects around you.
Our app allows for detecting and recording of seismic
bluejetty:00023953:ios.description:
Vibration meter is an app called seismograph or seismometer, which measures the strength of vibration, quakes, earthquakes, vibrations of the human body or any other objects around you.
Our app allows for detecting and recording of seismic waves generated by earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, avalanches and other sources of vibration and shocks. 
Accelerometer in your mobile phone is used for detection of vibrations and measurement analysis.
Graph presents a record of the ground motion at a measuring point. Ground movement or an object is presented as a function of time in the three Cartesian axes, with the z axis perpendicular to the Earth's surface and the x- and y- axes parallel to the surface.
Mercalli intensity scale is a seismic scale used for measuring the intensity of an earthquake. It measures the effects of an earthquake and it is distinct from the moment of magnitude.
Richter Scale assigns a magnitude number to quantify the energy released by an earthquake. Peak Ground Acceleration (PGA) is equal to the maximum ground acceleration that occurred during earthquake shaking at location. PGA is equal to the amplitude of the largest absolute acceleration recorded on an accelerogram at a site during a particular earthquake.
In this app we use Instrumental Intensity Scale (developed by The United States Geological Survey) which maps peak ground acceleration and peak ground velocity on an intensity scale similar to the felt Mercalli Scale. These values are used to create shake maps by seismologists on around the world.
Mercalli Intensity Scale distinguishes the following levels of vibration and impact damage:
I. Instrumental - Not felt. Recorded by seismographs.
II. Weak - Felt only on top floors of high buildings.
III. Slight - Felt indoors, like a passing light truck.
IV. Moderate - Windows, doors rattle. Like passing train.
V. Rather Strong - Felt by all. Small objects upset.
VI. Strong - Books off shelves. Trees shake. Damage.
VII. Very Strong - Difficult to stand. Buildings damaged.
VIII. Destructive - Significant damage. Trees broken.
IX. Violent - General panic. Serious damage. Cracks.
X. Intense - Most buildings destroyed. Rails bent.
XI. Extreme - Rails bent greatly. Pipelines destroyed.
XII. Catastrophic - Near total damage.
This app allows you monitor and share the results of your measurements with other users.
Measure and monitor all vibration and shocks using smartphone or tablet!

bluejetty:00069092:ios.description:
The official app of Empire, the world’s biggest movie magazine. Packed with in-depth interviews, exclusive images and expert commentary. It’s the ultimate read for film fans, bringing everything from Hollywood to independent cinema into your home. 
- The latest edition delivered to your pocket as soon as it arrives in shops. 
- Access incredible imagery. 
- Search for your favourite films, actors and directors. 
- Bookmark articles to read again later 
We have brought all of the above into one place: the must-have app for any film lover. It's an all-access pass to the biggest and most exciting movies from around the world, waiting on your phone whenever you want it. 
Every article in the magazine is written by genuine film lovers. Our impassioned movie journalists care about creating the seminal cinematic journal that we release every month. When we are in the office together, we love nothing more than to debate the merits of each Marvel character or the detailed Star Wars trivia that only a true fan would know. 
But we don’t just spend our lives obsessing over classics. Empire is at the forefront of the film industry. Whether it is reviewing the next big-screen masterpiece or conducting a world-first exclusive interview with Hollywood stars and directors, our journalists will bring you closer to the action. 
Since our first issue in July 1989, we have transported film fans across the world onto the sets and into the director’s chair of the world’s greatest films. We look forward to welcoming you. 
Download the app today! 
Please Note: This app is optimised for iOS 14 and higher. If you're using an iPad 1 or 2, iPad Mini 1 or iPhone 5 (or before) you may struggle to run this app smoothly.

You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings up until 24-hours before the end of the current period, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. Please visit our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information:

bluejetty:00165426:ios.description:
With Jodel, you can stay connected with the people around you and discover what’s happening in your local area in real time. Whether it’s news, questions, events, confessions, or just a good laugh – you'll never miss out on what's happening around you again! A community app where what you say matters.
[Stay informed & enjoy real moments]
Get the latest local news and updates instantly in your real time feed – Jodel is full of creativity, humor, and unexpected fun. Unlike traditional social media, Jodel keeps things real and focused on your local life and interests.
[Join the conversation]
Ask people near you questions, share insights, and get real answers while exploring channels and communities based on your interests. Whether you’re a student at university or college, new to a neighbourhood or just looking to make friends and meet like-minded people – Jodel and its hyperlocal community is the place for you. With your vote on a Jodel post you can decide what's trending in your connected community.
[Connect with locals]
Interact with others around you through your Jodel posts. Whether you're discussing campus life & college experiences, upcoming events, local news, or general life situations, Jodel helps you stay engaged in your community.
With Jodel you can...
*be yourself without social pressure
*share posts, pictures and videos with everyone around you
*add multiple replies to your post while creating it to write stories without interruptions
*vote and react on posts and decide what is relevant in your area
*pin content you want to follow
*join channels with content that interests you
*collect Karma by spreading good vibes
Share your personal stories with your Jodel friends! Be your original and unique self, share your own amazing thoughts, connect, and make friends. And by the way...Jodel is pronounced "YODEL"!
Jodel is not just your basic social media. Jodel is...
HYPERLOCAL – Stay updated on everything happening near you.
DIVERSE & ENGAGING – Meet new people and share your thoughts.
SUPPORTIVE & FRIENDLY – A positive community with space for everyone.
Download Jodel now and become part of the most vibrant social hub in your city. Discover the latest news, and engage with your community like never before.
https://jodel.com/

bluejetty:00169999:ios.summary:

FREE TO PLAY ON MOBILE
Pixel quality g
bluejetty:00169999:ios.description:
Wander the harsh wasteland as one of the last remaining survivors searching for supplies and battling any unwanted visitors in this Fallout inspired pocket based post-apocalyptic RPG survival game.
FREE TO PLAY ON MOBILE
Pixel quality gaming on your phone with customizable characters and upgradeable stats and items. Experience the thrill of this Fallout inspired action/adventure game with no forced adverts and no pay wall, now on your phone for easy on-the-go fun.
VARIOUS LOCATIONS
Traverse through different towns that have unique places to search from random houses -> medical shops -> police stations, all with lots of places to search for supplies.
RANDOMISED MAP
With each playthrough, the map changes and locations scatter to give a different playthrough as you plan for expeditions.
FIND YOUR FELLOW COMPANION
Be on the lookout for a beloved pet that could help you gather supplies or help fend off attackers. Level their stats up and have a powerful companion.
DIFFICULTY SELECTION & REPLAYABILITY
With a selection of difficulties to customise, the player can manually choose how hard they want their experience to be. This will add to the replayability and will allow players to try out different playthroughs that can really change up how events turn out.
TRAVERSING THE MAP
Find all new parts to build the broken down camper van and be able to travel across the wasteland faster along with extra storage space. Get out of radiated areas quicker and be able to head back to your campsite before you become mutated.
SURVIVAL OF THE FITTEST
Use skill and strategy to battle any unwanted attackers and be rewarded with their loot which will help you survive longer in this harsh wasteland.
CHOICE AND COMPLEXITY
While exploring the player will have the chance to engage with various interactions that can affect your karma as well as trade supplies with another fellow survivor.
Have what it takes to survive the wasteland? Download The Wanderer now!
_________________________________________________________
NOTE: We welcome any feedback during your experience to improve the game. To give feedback, in-game go to > Options > Discord or use this link https://discord.gg/97av7Nf
_________________________________________________________
Visit the Wiki for tips and detailed information - https://the-wanderer-game.fandom.com/wiki/The_Wanderer
_________________________________________________________
Please note this app contains social features that allow you to compete for the high scores in the leaderboards and push notifications to inform you when free supplies are ready to be given. You can choose whether or not to utilize these features.

Music track - Zachfitzgeraldmusic.com
TERMS OF USE

PRIVACY POLICY

4. Repeat up to infinity!

- You’ll love the fun, colorful, playful design
- Easy to play, fast-paced and challenging merge puzzle gameplay
- You’ve got the option to pause the game at any time

bluejetty:00065413:ios.description:
United Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with United Banking:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the United Banking app, you must be enrolled as a United Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00127257:ios.description:
Explore the final frontier with T-Minus – Space Launch Tracker. Keep up-to-date with every space agency's launches and events, including SpaceX, NASA, ULA, Rocket Lab, Roscosmos, Blue Origin, Arianespace, ISRO and more. With live streams and real-time information, you'll never miss a moment of the action.
T-Minus is your one-stop destination for all things space launches and events. Download now and join the community of space enthusiasts.
Key Features:
‣ Discover over 7000 past launches from SpaceX, ULA, Rocket Lab, Roscosmos, Blue Origin and more.
‣ Watch high definition videos and live streams right within the app, now with Picture-in-Picture.*
‣ Apple Watch app allows for an even more surreal experience with tracking and experiencing launches, with a compass that points you towards launch pads.
‣ Push Notifications 24 hours, 1 hour and 10 minutes before every launch so you'll never miss them ever again now with custom controls.
‣ Choose from a variety Widgets to see upcoming launches right on the Home Screen.*
‣ iOS 16 Lock Screen widgets now with a countdown timer.*
‣ Collect over 1500 Mission Patch Trading Cards, check-in daily to redeem yours and share them to Instagram, Facebook or Twitter.
‣ Booster & Dragon capsule reuse information for SpaceX missions.
‣ Follow the ISS with live tracking, rewatch all the missions all the way back to 1998, meet the Expedition Crew and more.
‣ Follow the Starbase activity in Boca Chica with up to date information and live streams.
‣ A catalog with hundreds of astronauts, launch vehicles, spacecrafts, space agencies and more.
‣ Smart searching and filters for accurate results to make sure you find exactly what you are looking for.
‣ "Launch Calendar" allows you to easily and quickly jump back and forth in time to discover launches.
‣ "On this day" section displays launches that happened on this day in the past 65 years.
‣ "Image of the Day" display the Astronomy Picture of the Day provided by NASA.
‣ Satellite maps of launch pads and locations.
‣ Upcoming Events.
‣ Up to 300 Upcoming Launches.
‣ Latest News, Blogs and Reports.
‣ Share News Articles to Instagram and Facebook Stories now with Templates.
‣ Bookmark articles and blog posts for future reference.
‣ Custom App Icons, Tint Colors, Map Styles, app-wide Themes & More.
‣ Midnight, Light and Dark themes.
‣ Quick access to a curated list of space documentaries and TV series.
‣ Much more.
NOTE:
This app is in no way affiliated with SpaceX, NASA or any other space company.
If you enjoy the app please leave a review and share it with your friends!
Feel free to send feedback in the Settings section of the app.
* Picture-in-Picture is only available on iOS 14 and later.
* Widgets are only available on iOS 14 and later.
* Lock Screen widgets are only available on iOS 16 and later.
* Some features require a Premium membership.
T-Minus Premium subscriptions, either monthly or yearly, will automatically renew unless cancelled at least one day before the end of the current period. Payments will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. You can manage and cancel your subscription by going to your account settings in the App Store.
Privacy Policy –
https://tminusapp.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Service –
https://tminusapp.com/terms-of-service.html
Thanks for using T-Minus! I'd love to hear your feedback. 
Email me at apptminus@gmail.com or reach out on Twitter at @t_minus_app!

bluejetty:00131316:ios.name: athenaPatient
bluejetty:00131316:ios.summary:
athenaPatient is only available for patients whose healthcare providers have instructed them to download and use the app.
Access your health information and communicate with your care team anywhere, anytime.* athenaPatient is a convenient
bluejetty:00131316:ios.description:
athenaPatient is only available for patients whose healthcare providers have instructed them to download and use the app.
Access your health information and communicate with your care team anywhere, anytime.* athenaPatient is a convenient, mobile resource that allows you to: 
- Log in quickly – Facial recognition and touch ID make log in easy while keeping your data safe.
- View test results – Access lab, imaging, and other medical test results as soon as they become available.
- Message your care team – Contact your care team whenever you have questions through quick, secure direct messages. 
- Self-schedule appointments – Book appointments with your care team and view upcoming visits beyond regular office hours. Your provider(s) must support Self-Scheduling to use this feature. 
- Check in before your visit – Easily check in for appointments and save time by completing any necessary documentation before your arrival. Your provider(s) must support Self Check-In to use this feature. 
- Attend virtual visits – Easily initiate and attend telehealth visits with members of your care team. (Your provider(s) must support virtual visits through athenaTelehealth to use this feature) 
- Get directions to appointments – Driving directions show you how to get to your next medical appointment. 
Please note that you must have an existing athenahealth Patient Portal account to use athenaPatient. 
Once you’ve downloaded and launched athenaPatient, you must log in using the same email address and password you use to access your provider’s athenahealth Patient Portal to begin using the app. It will ask if you want to enable Face ID or Touch ID. Enabling either of these features will save you from having to enter your login information every time you want to use the app.
If you do not have your Patient Portal account information, your healthcare provider(s) may offer Patient Portal access through their website. 
If you’re having issues finding your healthcare provider’s Patient Portal, you can contact their office for the correct URL, or to request an email invitation to their Patient Portal. 
* The athenaPatient app is only available for download and viewing information in the United States for patients of healthcare providers on the athenahealth network.

bluejetty:00126229:ios.summary: Step inside your mind. Foggy mornings, wired midnights, the 3 PM crash in between, your brainwaves are stuck out of sync, and sound can shift them back. Science-backed binaural beats guide your brain into deep sleep, sharp focus, calm, reco
bluejetty:00126229:ios.description:
Step inside your mind. Foggy mornings, wired midnights, the 3 PM crash in between, your brainwaves are stuck out of sync, and sound can shift them back. Science-backed binaural beats guide your brain into deep sleep, sharp focus, calm, recovery, or states beyond ordinary awareness. No meditation. No pills. Just headphones and 15 to 60 minutes.
Stanford neuroscientist Dr. Andrew Huberman has publicly discussed 40 Hz gamma binaural beats as a tool for focus and concentration. That is the science Brainwaves is built on.
7 BRAINWAVE BANDS, DELTA TO EPSILON
Delta for deep sleep. Theta for dreaming. Alpha for calm. Beta for focus. Gamma for peak cognition. Epsilon for deep transcendence.
SIGNATURE SESSIONS
Deep Gamma Focus (40 Hz Gamma): sharp attention and working memory.
Deep Sleep Night (Theta): drift into deep sleep faster.
Ultra Sleep System (Delta 2 Hz): slow-wave sleep for physical restoration.
Nervous System Reset (Alpha 10 Hz): calm stress, restore balance.
Flow State Engine (Alpha 11 Hz): peak flow for deep work.
Serotonin Release (Alpha 10 Hz): lift mood, ease tension.
SLEEP AID AND INSOMNIA RELIEF
Fall asleep faster and stay asleep. Delta journeys (0.5 to 4 Hz) for racing thoughts, 3am wake-ups, stress, late-night screens, and jet lag. A drug-free sleep aid for people who have tried everything.
FOCUS AID AND BRAIN FOG
Cut through fog with beta and gamma sessions (13 to 40 Hz). Sharpen clarity for deep work, study, and mental fitness.
ANXIETY CALM AND STRESS RELIEF
Alpha and theta soundscapes (4 to 12 Hz) ease tension and rebalance your nervous system. No meditation experience needed.
HEALTH AND RECOVERY
Solfeggio frequencies layered with brainwave audio for whole-body reset and recovery from burnout.
CONSCIOUSNESS EXPERIENCE, EXCLUSIVE TO BRAINWAVES
Beyond sleep and focus, Brainwaves is built for altered states of consciousness you will not find in other brainwave apps.
Astral Projection: guided exploration beyond the limits of the physical.
Remote Viewing: expand perception beyond ordinary sight and strengthen intuition.
Lucid Dreaming: become aware inside your dreams and learn to steer them.
Fifth Dimension: transcend ordinary perception.
Gamma and Epsilon Journeys: expanded awareness and deep transcendence.
963 Hz Pineal Gland Activation: the God Frequency, for deep meditation, whole-brain coherence, and higher states of awareness.
WHY BRAINWAVES
500+ precision sessions across sleep, focus, relaxation, spiritual exploration, and health.
EEG-mapped frequencies: science-informed design, not random tones.
Personalized journeys: tell us your goals, we guide your first session.
Offline listening and Family Sharing: download favorites and share with your family.
Free trial: try it before you commit, cancel anytime.
WHAT TO EXPECT
Night 1 to 3: the beat gives your attention somewhere to go, so it is easier to switch off. By day 4 to 7 you reach sleep, focus, or calm faster, and from week 2 the state holds longer. Individual results vary.
WHO IT IS FOR
You have tried meditation apps and they did not stick. You want a drug-free sleep, focus, or recovery aid. Brainwaves was made for you.
SAFETY
Headphones or earbuds are required. Do not listen while driving or operating machinery.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Begin with a free trial. Your subscription automatically renews 24 hours before the end of each billing period and is charged through your iTunes account. Cancel anytime before the trial ends and you will not be charged. Turn off automatic renewal anytime in your account settings. No refund for unused portions.
Privacy Policy: http://www.imoblife.net/PrivacyPolicy/
Terms of Service: http://www.imoblife.net/PrivacyPolicy/Terms_of_Use.html
Disclaimer: Brainwaves is a wellness tool supported by neuroscience research. Not a medical device. Consult your physician for clinical conditions.

Hydra Video AI Bring Your Avatar to Life!
Hydra Video AI turns a static image or any avatar into a lifelike talking video. Simply upload your AI-generated photo, choose a voice from our character library, and watch your AI Avator speak in a personalized podcast-style video.
Our advanced AI analyzes facial features and syncs them with the chosen audio’s tone, emotion, and rhythm—creating natural micro-expressions and mouth movements that match the speech perfectly.
Coming soon: Support for custom audio uploads—let your AI Baby say anything you want!
To support us you can choose to subscribe to our auto-renewing subscriptions.

- Hydra Video AI Pro Monthly:$13.99

bluejetty:00037049:ios.name: Hunting Simulator: Hunter Game
bluejetty:00037049:ios.summary:
The hunting season has begun, and you are about to experience a true 3D hunting and shooting game where every shot demands strategy and precision. 
This hunting simulator puts you in the role of a professional hunter across wild environment
bluejetty:00037049:ios.description:
The hunting season has begun, and you are about to experience a true 3D hunting and shooting game where every shot demands strategy and precision. 
This hunting simulator puts you in the role of a professional hunter across wild environments from all over the world.
Get ready to explore realistic and diverse maps. Travel through the forests of Canada, cross the snowy fields of Finland, and face the heat of the African savanna in an authentic hunting safari. Each environment is designed to deliver an authentic hunting simulation with animals in their natural habitats. 
You can also take part in a night hunting map, where night vision and stealth tactics make the challenge even more intense.
This kind of experience is a true hunting clash, a fusion of action, strategy, and survival. For those who seek the thrill of a wild hunt, the game offers intense and realistic chases. Fans of the deer hunter style will find landscapes full of deer, moose, and other majestic animals to test their skills.
Animals available in the hunting game
Mammals: moose, deer, boar, bear, fox, wolf, hare
Birds: duck, goose, pheasant, pigeon, wild turkey
Africa: lion, leopard, rhino, elephant, buffalo, crocodile, zebra, giraffe, cheetah
Vehicles in the hunting simulator
ATV for hard-to-reach hunting areas, especially during African safari hunts.
Snowmobile for winter maps.
Available hunting and shooting weapons
Shotguns: 8/16, 12g, 12v, 12 semi-auto, .410 gauge
Rifles: .223, .308, .338, .50 with precision scopes
Different bullet types for each hunting situation
The game’s mechanics combine the strategy of a simulator with the adrenaline of a shooting game. 
Choose your target, aim carefully, and shoot at the right moment. Keep in mind the wind direction, as ballistics are implemented in the game. Every successful hunt brings rewards, progress, and a true sense of victory.
This level of realism places you in the role of a true American marksman, able to calculate distance, wind, and position before firing. The tracking system lets you follow footprints and animal traces, giving you the feeling of being in a way of the hunter journey of survival where every detail matters.
Animal tracking system
In addition to hunting by sight, you can track animals by following footprints and environmental clues. This tracking feature adds even more realism and immersion, making you feel part of a true wild hunting expedition worthy of the best hunting games.
Hunting companion
Train your loyal hunting dog, who grants special bonuses and improves your hunting performance.
Additional game features
Decoy calls to attract animals
Binoculars with zoom and distance calculation
Thermal and night vision
Special camouflage for stealth hunting
This is a free hunting game that can be played offline up to level 5, perfect for both beginners and elite virtual hunters. 
The simulator adapts to your playstyle — practice at the shooting range, explore open maps, take part in night hunts, or challenge yourself in wild hunting adventures.
Feel the call of the wild and live the ultimate experience of a hunting and shooting game. 
Download this 3D hunting simulator now on your mobile device and begin your journey to become a true master hunter.

This kind of experience is a true hunting clash, a fusion of action, strategy, and survival. For those who seek the thrill of a wild hunt, the game offers intense and realistic chases. Fans of the deer hunter style will find landscapes full of deer, moose, and other majestic animals to test their skills.



Animals available in the hunting game

Mammals: moose, deer, boar, bear, fox, wolf, hare

Birds: duck, goose, pheasant, pigeon, wild turkey

Africa: lion, leopard, rhino, elephant, buffalo, crocodile, zebra, giraffe, cheetah



Vehicles in the hunting simulator
ATV for hard-to-reach hunting areas, especially during African safari hunts.
Snowmobile for winter maps.



Available hunting and shooting weapons
Shotguns: 8/16, 12g, 12v, 12 semi-auto, .410 gauge
Rifles: .223, .308, .338, .50 with precision scopes
Different bullet types for each hunting situation



The game’s mechanics combine the strategy of a simulator with the adrenaline of a shooting game. 
Choose your target, aim carefully, and shoot at the right moment. Keep in mind the wind direction, as ballistics are implemented in the game. Every successful hunt brings rewards, progress, and a true sense of victory.


This level of realism places you in the role of a true American marksman, able to calculate distance, wind, and position before firing. The tracking system lets you follow footprints and animal traces, giving you the feeling of being in a way of the hunter journey of survival where every detail matters.



Animal tracking system
In addition to hunting by sight, you can track animals by following footprints and environmental clues. This tracking feature adds even more realism and immersion, making you feel part of a true wild hunting expedition worthy of the best hunting games.



Hunting companion
Train your loyal hunting dog, who grants special bonuses and improves your hunting performance.



Additional game features

Decoy calls to attract animals

Binoculars with zoom and distance calculation

Thermal and night vision

Special camouflage for stealth hunting


This is a free hunting game that can be played offline up to level 5, perfect for both beginners and elite virtual hunters. 
The simulator adapts to your playstyle — practice at the shooting range, explore open maps, take part in night hunts, or challenge yourself in wild hunting adventures.

Feel the call of the wild and live the ultimate experience of a hunting and shooting game. 

Download this 3D hunting simulator now on your mobile device and begin your journey to become a true master hunter.

- Learn what techniques work best to grow their vocabulary
- Find patterns in the words that your learner is using
- Share progress with family, friends, and the community
- Contribute to the global research study on closing the interspecies communication gap!

Captiono is a powerful tool for generating automatic video subtitles using artificial intelligence. With Captiono, you can create synchronized subtitles for any language with just a
bluejetty:00165739:ios.description:
Captiono: The Ultimate AI-Powered Automatic Subtitle Tool
Captiono is a powerful tool for generating automatic video subtitles using artificial intelligence. With Captiono, you can create synchronized subtitles for any language with just a few taps.
Creating subtitles for videos has always been a difficult and time-consuming task. But now, with the Captiono app, you can create subtitles for your videos in less than 20 seconds with a few simple steps and share your videos with subtitles on social media.
Why should all videos have subtitles?
1. Social Responsibility for the Disabled and Hearing Impaired: By using subtitles for videos, you can fulfill your social responsibility towards the disabled and hearing impaired. Respecting the disabled, having videos with subtitles is becoming a necessity on social media.
2. Significantly Increase Video Views: Many people watch videos in public places. If your video does not have subtitles, people in these places will skip your video, reducing your watch time, and eventually, your posts on various networks like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc., will drop out of the algorithm, causing your page to suffer a significant drop.
Captiono, developed according to the needs of bloggers on social networks, with the slogan: Customized for Every Blogger's Needs! Everything you need for Instagram Reels or Posts, TikTok, YouTube, and YouTube Shorts is included in this app. Without needing technical knowledge in editing and content creation, you can edit your videos.
Besides creating subtitles, Captiono is also a powerful video editor. It includes all the essential editing tools a blogger and content creator needs.
Captiono also features other AI tools such as noise removal and sound quality enhancement. Using this AI, you can improve your sound quality without buying expensive microphones. Record videos in noisy environments and use this AI capability to enhance your video’s sound and remove noise.
Who should use Captiono?
* Bloggers and content creators
* Journalists from various networks
* Singers for sharing music videos and clips
* Educational institutions
* Marketing and advertising teams
Key Features of Captiono:
* Create subtitles in all living languages
* Real-time subtitle translation for all living languages
* Very simple and user-friendly interface
* AI features such as sound quality enhancement and noise removal
* Customized for bloggers' needs without complexity
Captiono is an essential tool for content creation on social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Snapchat, and more. With its key features, you can easily make your videos viral and reach millions.

bluejetty:00031497:ios.description:
