La comunidad latino-americana no cuenta con una plataforma de videos que provea de un producto exclusivo enfocado a sus particularidades. PRONYR plantea ocupar ese espacio y brindarle a sus usuarios un contenido único de sus artistas favoritos.
La membresía a la plataforma es auto-renovada mes a mes o cada año según decida el usuario. Se requiere membresía para poder disfrutar de todos los contenidos producidos por PRONYR. Los usuarios podrán cancelarla en cualquier momento.
Por otra parte los usuarios mediante un pago único, podrán convertirse en miembros del Club de Fans de cada uno de los espacios, donde tendrán acceso a funcionalidades y videos exclusivos relacionados al mismo. 
Dentro de la plataforma cada usuario posee su propia bolsa de monedas que podrá intercambiar solo por funcionalidades especiales como el envío de sticker en los comentarios.

bluejetty:00136552:ios.description:
“Clue on Fire” is the next episode of a great detective story of the “Unsolved Case” Domini Games series! Put all the puzzles together as you travel along with the characters, find the hidden objects, make decisions that affect the plot of the investigation and find out how the next episode ends! Not only will detective games delight you with a great story, but they're also completely free!
A massive explosion ripped through a steel mill, killing and injuring hundreds of people. The enterprise never got over this blow and was forced to shut down, leaving people jobless. There was no thorough investigation; the media deemed it an “unfortunate accident”. Is it really the case? You, a successful detective, are to find the answer. The deeper you delve into the secrets of the steel mill, the more you realize the firefighters doused the blaze in the building, but not in the hearts of some former workers. There's only one thing that can put out that type of flame...
· SAVOR THE ENTICING STORY FULL OF UNEXPECTED PLOT TWISTS!
Spend your time with pleasure playing crime games. Dynamically developing plot with detective investigations certainly will not leave you indifferent!
· PLAY THIS EPISODE OF THE SERIES TO BE FULLY PREPARED FOR THE NEXT ONE!
Each game is an episode of one crime scene investigation. Make your way through this series, solving riddles and looking for hidden objects to move on to the next episode and find out what came next. 
· MAKE YOUR OWN CHOICES AND SEE WHERE THEY LEAD. BETTER THINK TWICE!
The player has the ability to choose a character's phrases for an action, the player makes a choice on which his or her investigation depends. Influence the plot of the adventure quest and find out which of several endings your choice leads to!
· CONDUCT YOUR OWN INVESTIGATION!
Solve a challenging criminal case, find the objects, look for suspects and earn multiple achievements to highlight your success!
As you progress through the episodes, you'll uncover all the secrets and solve a multitude of mysterious cases! Finish one series and move on to the next and play for free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!
-----

Idle Networks: a minimalist idle tycoon game!
Build network towers, hire engineers and hackers, and grow your own tech empire in this relaxing idle clicker game. Your towers keep earning gold even while you're offline, so you come back richer every time.
4 UNIQUE NETWORKS TO CONQUER
- Terra: Start your tech empire on solid ground and build your first network towers.
- Luna: Take your towers to the moon. Low gravity, high profits!
- Aqua: Expand deep underwater and survive floods to rule the deep network.
- Aero: Build high-altitude towers above the clouds and master wild sky weather.
GAME FEATURES
- Idle Tycoon Simulator: Automate engineers, manage resources and watch your business grow on its own. Every upgrade multiplies your income in true incremental style.
- Build & Upgrade Towers: Build, upgrade and expand towers across all four networks.
- Diamond Mining: Assign towers to mine Diamonds for prestige boosts and exclusive tower skins.
- Hack Your Way to the Top: Buy rival towers or hire skilled hackers to take them over.
- Cyber Ops: Send your hackers on jobs to earn extra rewards.
- Contracts: Complete timed tasks before the clock runs out for bonus rewards.
- Weather Challenges: Face floods, heatwaves, earthquakes and more. Research defenses to protect your towers and keep the money flowing.
- Get Rich: Go from Millionaire to Billionaire to Trillionaire to GAZILLIONAIRE! Build a true monopoly of networks and become the wealthiest tycoon in the world.
- Boosts & Rewards: Use Coffee Boosts and Miner Overclocks for big production surges, and complete tasks for epic rewards.
- Offline Earnings: Your towers earn money while you sleep. Wake up richer every time.
- Fast-Forward: Earn hours of income in seconds.
SEASONAL EVENTS & WEEKLY MINI GAMES
Celebrate holidays all year round with special event levels, exclusive rewards and limited-time discounts!
- Halloween
- Thanksgiving
- Christmas & New Year
- Lunar New Year
- Valentine's Day
- St. Patrick's Day
- Easter
Weekly Mini Games: A new limited-time mini game every week! Jump in, play and earn exciting rewards before it's gone.
There's always something new to play and celebrate!
WHY PLAYERS LOVE IDLE NETWORKS
Minimalist & Relaxing: Calm visuals and soothing music make it a peaceful break, not another noisy idle game.
A Fresh Theme: Classic idle clicker gameplay in a tech-network setting you won't find anywhere else.
Real Strategy: Balance research, upgrades and prestige to build the most profitable network empire.
Play Your Way: Tap actively for fast progress, or let your towers run idle and check in whenever you like.
Join the richest network tycoons. Download Idle Networks and start building your tech empire today!

bluejetty:00180742:ios.description:
From open BCA account online, transfer money online, paying bills, to managing investments — everything is accessible from just one app. myBCA is here to simplify your digital banking needs all in one place. With just one BCA ID, your financial transactions can be done anytime, anywhere.
Main Features:
1. Domestic & International Transfers
Send money to fellow BCA users, other banks, virtual accounts, or top up e-wallets like OVO, DANA, and more. Easily transfer foreign currencies with competitive exchange rates. Perfect for personal or business transfers — a powerful foreign exchange app.
2. Complete Bill & Daily Payment Services
Pay electricity, water, internet, vehicle tax, education fees, and even credit card installments — all from within the app.
3. Practical QRIS Payments
Make payments by scanning QRIS codes. Works across Indonesia, Thailand, Singapore, and Malaysia.
4. Cardless Cash Withdrawals
Forgot your wallet? No problem. Use the cardless feature in myBCA to deposit or withdraw cash at any BCA ATM.
5. Fast & Secure Login Anywhere
Access the app quickly and securely using fingerprint or Face ID — no need to enter your PIN repeatedly.
6. Online Foreign Currency Savings
Buy and save in foreign currencies with the Poket Valas feature. Choose from up to 17 currencies, available 24/7 with great exchange rates. Ideal for business, travel, or long-term investing. Use your BCA Mastercard debit card abroad with no conversion hassle.
7. Curated Investments from Rp10,000
Start investing from just Rp10,000 with access to mutual funds and bonds. Safe, curated, and built around your investment goals — all accessible via mobile. It’s your digital account opening app for investing.
8. Financial Diary & Transaction History
Track your daily expenses using Financial Diary and view your transaction history all the way back to 2016 — across all accounts in one dashboard.
9. Multi-Platform Access
Access myBCA via the mobile app or web browser. Flexible and secure across devices.
10. Exclusive Features for Priority Customers
Enjoy exclusive offers and services for Priority and Solitaire customers — including lifestyle, health, and travel benefits.
Download myBCA Now!
Download myBCA and enjoy seamless banking right from your fingertips
Perfect for those looking to open BCA account online, save in foreign currencies, invest, or just pay electricity bills from home
All your transactions — one app. Faster, safer, and hassle-free!

bluejetty:00096587:ios.description:
Smash blocks. Clear your mind. No pressure, just pure puzzle satisfaction!
Welcome to Smash Block, a uniquely calming block puzzle game where there are no time limits, no stressful mechanics — just you, your moves, and the thrill of creating the perfect combo.
In Smash Block, your goal is simple yet addictive:
Drag, drop, and smash colorful blocks to clear the board and make space for more. Think ahead, plan smart, and relax while solving increasingly satisfying puzzles.
There’s no countdown, no rush — just the joy of smart moves and clear progress.
Why You'll Love Smash Block:
No time limits – move at your own pace, no stress ever
Engaging gameplay – easy to start, hard to master
Clean, minimalist visuals – pure design meets smooth interaction
Satisfying effects & feedback – every smash feels great
Great for relaxing moments – before sleep, during breaks, or on the go
Offline-friendly – play anytime, no internet needed
Perfect for fans of block games, tile puzzles, logic challenges, and brain teasers
Smash Block is ideal for:
Players who love calm puzzle games
Fans of match and merge mechanics
People looking to unwind without pressure
Those who enjoy strategic yet casual gameplay
Gamers wanting a clean, ad-free focus experience
Whether you're commuting, winding down at night, or taking a mindful break during the day, Smash Block is the perfect match.
What Players Are Saying:
“It’s like meditation, but with blocks.”
“I love that I can play without feeling rushed.”
“So simple, yet so satisfying!”
Smash the blocks. Clear your mind. Relax and win.
Ready to master the art of calm strategy?
Download Smash Block now and start your stress-free puzzle journey!
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

Terms of Use: https://unicostudio.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00153811:ios.description:
Diet AI – AI Powered Calorie & Macro Tracker, Counter, and Food Assistant
Take full control of your nutrition with Diet AI – calorie tracker, macro tracker, and food counter powered by AI. Whether your goal is to lose weight, gain muscle, or eat better, Diet AI is your all-in-one calorie and macro tracker to help you stay on track.
HOW TO USE DIET AI:
Answer quick lifestyle questions get your personalized diet AI plan.
Snap a photo of your meal to get calorie, protein, carb, and macro details using advanced AI.
Use the built-in calorie tracker and calorie counter to scan or search any food and easily track your meals.
Get custom meal plans and delicious food recipes tailored to your calorie, protein, carb, and macro needs.
Diet AI makes it simple to track food, count calories, and manage your macro balance. It’s more than just a calorie counter — it’s your full macro tracker, smart meal planner, and AI powered nutrition coach.
Recipe AI – Smart Meal & Food Ideas Tailored to Your Goals
Discover delicious, AI-generated meal ideas and food recipes based on your exact calorie, protein, carb, and macro needs. Recipe AI uses your goals and preferences to suggest personalized food combinations, custom cooking instructions, and balanced meal plans. Whether you're looking to increase your protein intake, reduce carbs, or follow a specific diet, Diet AI creates recipes that make healthy eating easy and enjoyable. Say bye-bye to boring meals and get inspired with every dish you make using Recipe AI.
Fasting Tracker – AI Based Intermittent Fasting Assistant
Boost your health and manage your weight with the built-in Fasting Tracker. Diet AI helps you schedule, start, and stay consistent with popular intermittent fasting methods. Easily track your fasting windows, meals, and calorie intake before and after fasts. The Fasting Tracker also provides insights into your macro breakdown. Combine fasting with our smart calorie counter, macro tracker, and meal planner for the best results.
WHY USERS LOVE DIET AI:
Track meals and log every food item using AI
Use the calorie counter to search any food in seconds
Get real time insights into your protein, carb, and fat intake with the macro tracker
Personalize your meal plans to match your fitness goals from fat loss to muscle gain
Discover new food options and stay motivated with smart recommendations from Diet AI
Get personalized meal ideas and healthy food recipes with Recipe AI tailored to your calorie and macro goals
Use the Fasting Tracker to schedule, monitor, and stay consistent with intermittent fasting while keeping track of your calories, meals, and macros.
Whether you’re focused on calorie tracking, hitting your macro goals, or exploring healthier food, Diet AI is the only app you need. With every meal, track your progress and get closer to your dream body with AI.
Start using Diet AI today:
Smarter eating, faster results. Let Diet AI be your daily calorie tracker, macro tracker, and intelligent food counter. Take control of your nutrition with powerful AI tools designed to help you succeed.
We love your feedback! Send questions or suggestions to hello@aiapps.dev
Terms of Use: https://www.trydietai.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.trydietai.app/privacy
Disclaimer: Diet AI does not offer medical advice. Always consult a healthcare provider before making major dietary changes.
Some features, including smart meal analysis and recipe generation, require a subscription.

bluejetty:00083364:ios.description:
Introducing AI Songs – Your Personalized Music Maker
AI Songs offers an innovative way to create entire tracks, not just instrumentals, with the power of AI. Whether you have a melody in mind, a set of lyrics, or simply a vibe, AI Songs can turn your vision into a full-length, professional-quality song in just minutes. Seamlessly blending technology with creativity, this app gives you the tools to bring your music to life effortlessly.
 Why Choose AI Songs?
- AI-Powered Music Creation: With advanced AI capabilities, AI Songs can compose melodies, generate lyrics, and produce songs in multiple genres. Describe your idea, and in minutes, you’ll have a complete track with vocals and instrumentals tailored to your specifications.
- Endless Genre Possibilities: Whether you’re into pop, rap, country, or even experimental music, AI Songs offers the flexibility to mix and match genres, helping you craft songs that stand out and break the mold.
- User-Friendly Design: You don’t need to be a professional musician or have any music theory knowledge. Our intuitive interface lets you jump right in and start creating—just give us your ideas, and we’ll handle the rest.
 Key Features:
- Custom Music Creation: Input your lyrics or let our AI generate them for you. Then, sit back as AI Songs crafts a unique melody and arrangement tailored to your vision.
- Realistic Vocals: Choose from a variety of vocal styles, and our AI will produce studio-quality vocal tracks that fit perfectly with your song's theme and genre.
- Genre Fusion: Break boundaries by blending multiple genres in a single song, allowing for limitless creativity and unique soundscapes.
- Song Length Customization: Need a longer track? Effortlessly extend your song’s length to match your artistic vision.
Whether you’re a seasoned artist or just looking to have some fun creating music, AI Songs is here to help turn your musical ideas into reality. Start your creative journey today and see where AI can take your sound!

bluejetty:00040022:ios.developer: DIIJAM TECHNOLOGY AND ENTERTAINMENT JOINT STOCK COMPANY
bluejetty:00040022:ios.summary: Diijam là điểm đến âm nhạc điện tử số một tại Việt Nam và là ngôi nhà của cộng đồng những người yêu âm nhạc, nơi chúng tôi cùng nhau chia sẻ và tôn vinh niềm đam mê mix và remix. đỉnh cao. Tại Diijam, việc thưởng thức âm nhạc không chỉ dừng
bluejetty:00040022:ios.description:
Diijam là điểm đến âm nhạc điện tử số một tại Việt Nam và là ngôi nhà của cộng đồng những người yêu âm nhạc, nơi chúng tôi cùng nhau chia sẻ và tôn vinh niềm đam mê mix và remix. đỉnh cao. Tại Diijam, việc thưởng thức âm nhạc không chỉ dừng lại ở việc nghe; Đó là một cuộc phiêu lưu mở rộng vào thế giới âm nhạc rộng lớn, với những bản phối chất lượng mà bạn có thể tự hào gọi là "âm nhạc của tôi". Hãy tham gia cùng chúng tôi và biến mỗi bài hát thành một phần trong hành trình âm nhạc độc đáo của bạn!
Diijam là một start-up công nghệ thuần Việt với mong muốn mang âm nhạc điện tử Việt đến với người nghe trong nước và toàn cầu.
Chúng tôi cung cấp rất nhiều tính năng cho những người yêu thích nhạc dance:
- Kho nhạc điện tử phong phú (320 kb/s) được cập nhật hàng ngày
- Tạo danh sách nhạc của riêng bạn và nghe bất cứ khi nào bạn muốn
- Những bản phối lại tuyệt vời để nghe và chia sẻ
- Kho nhạc điện tử với hàng nghìn bản remix nonstop và độc quyền, được cập nhật hàng ngày.
- Cùng nhiều tính năng đặc biệt khác đang chờ bạn khám phá.
Với Diijam bạn có thể,
- Giúp DJ/Producer của Vina House music nói riêng và nhạc điện tử nói chung tiếp cận được đông đảo khán giả.
- Khám phá các DJ/Producer trẻ tài năng trong số hơn 550 DJ
- Hãy là một phần của sân chơi âm nhạc lành mạnh, văn minh, góp phần thay đổi suy nghĩ, cảm xúc của Vina House trong cộng đồng yêu nhạc điện tử tại Việt Nam.
Đến với Diijam bạn sẽ được thưởng thức những bản nhạc điện tử đỉnh cao, độc quyền từ những DJ hàng đầu Việt Nam! Chúng tôi đã lựa chọn cẩn thận mọi thứ một cách tỉ mỉ để đảm bảo rằng bạn sẽ chỉ nhận được những hỗn hợp tinh tế và độc đáo nhất. Hợp tác với các nghệ sĩ uy tín, chúng tôi cam kết đảm bảo mỗi bài hát đều được kiểm tra chất lượng, mang đến cho bạn trải nghiệm âm nhạc đích thực và đáng tin cậy. Thưởng thức Diijam trên điện thoại, máy tính hoặc bất kỳ loa bluetooth nào bạn có và chuẩn bị khuấy động không ngừng nghỉ!
Những bản phối dài, thường kéo dài hơn một giờ, là một phần không thể thiếu trong trải nghiệm âm nhạc của Diijam. Mỗi bản nhạc và mọi danh sách phát bạn phát không chỉ là một bản phối đơn giản; Đó là những câu chuyện âm nhạc, những hành trình đầy cảm xúc, nơi bạn có thể cảm nhận được sự hòa hợp trong từng giai điệu.
Từ các phiên kéo dài hàng giờ cho đến các bản nhạc chất lượng cực cao (320 kb/s) - nhịp điệu chất lượng mà bạn sẽ không tìm thấy ở bất kỳ nơi nào khác, đặc biệt là khi mọi người khác đang chơi trên các bản nhạc 128 kb/s. Khám phá Diijam và khiến mỗi người nghe không chỉ là một bài hát - đó là một câu chuyện, một sự rung cảm, nơi mỗi nốt nhạc nhảy theo nhịp điệu độc đáo của riêng nó!
Đưa âm nhạc của bạn lên một tầm cao mới với Diijam:
- Tại Diijam, chúng tôi mang đến cho bạn âm nhạc siêu chất lượng (320 kb/s) - bữa tiệc cho đôi tai của bạn.
- Hợp tác với những DJ và nghệ sĩ xuất sắc nhất, từ những bài hát hay nhất của Vinahouse Việt Nam đến EDM quốc tế, mỗi bài hát đều có phong cách riêng, độc đáo.
Khám phá âm nhạc mỗi ngày:
- Đối với Diijam, mỗi ngày là một cuộc phiêu lưu âm nhạc mới. Chúng tôi liên tục cập nhật âm nhạc độc quyền, các bản phối lại thú vị và các bản phối dài thú vị, đảm bảo bạn luôn tìm thấy điều gì đó mới mẻ trong kho âm nhạc đa dạng của mình.
Trải nghiệm VIP đỉnh cao:
- Đắm chìm trong những bản nhạc mới nhất dành riêng cho VIP. 
- Âm thanh siêu cao cấp.
- Tải xuống nhạc không giới hạn và nghe mọi lúc, mọi nơi, thậm chí ngoại tuyến.
- Nghe nhạc không quảng cáo.
- Chuyển bài không giới hạn, theo sở thích của bạn.
Hãy để Diijam đưa trải nghiệm âm nhạc của bạn lên một tầm cao mới!
Người dùng tài khoản miễn phí vẫn có thể nghe nhạc.
Khi đăng ký tài khoản, bạn đồng ý với Chính sách bảo mật và Điều khoản sử dụng của Diijam, cụ thể xem: https://diijam.vn/policy.html
Nếu có ý kiến đóng góp xin vui lòng gửi email: support@diijam.vn

Diijam là một start-up công nghệ thuần Việt với mong muốn mang âm nhạc điện tử Việt đến với người nghe trong nước và toàn cầu.

Chúng tôi cung cấp rất nhiều tính năng cho những người yêu thích nhạc dance:
- Kho nhạc điện tử phong phú (320 kb/s) được cập nhật hàng ngày
- Tạo danh sách nhạc của riêng bạn và nghe bất cứ khi nào bạn muốn
- Những bản phối lại tuyệt vời để nghe và chia sẻ
- Kho nhạc điện tử với hàng nghìn bản remix nonstop và độc quyền, được cập nhật hàng ngày.
- Cùng nhiều tính năng đặc biệt khác đang chờ bạn khám phá.

Với Diijam bạn có thể,
- Giúp DJ/Producer của Vina House music nói riêng và nhạc điện tử nói chung tiếp cận được đông đảo khán giả.
- Khám phá các DJ/Producer trẻ tài năng trong số hơn 550 DJ
- Hãy là một phần của sân chơi âm nhạc lành mạnh, văn minh, góp phần thay đổi suy nghĩ, cảm xúc của Vina House trong cộng đồng yêu nhạc điện tử tại Việt Nam.

Đến với Diijam bạn sẽ được thưởng thức những bản nhạc điện tử đỉnh cao, độc quyền từ những DJ hàng đầu Việt Nam! Chúng tôi đã lựa chọn cẩn thận mọi thứ một cách tỉ mỉ để đảm bảo rằng bạn sẽ chỉ nhận được những hỗn hợp tinh tế và độc đáo nhất. Hợp tác với các nghệ sĩ uy tín, chúng tôi cam kết đảm bảo mỗi bài hát đều được kiểm tra chất lượng, mang đến cho bạn trải nghiệm âm nhạc đích thực và đáng tin cậy. Thưởng thức Diijam trên điện thoại, máy tính hoặc bất kỳ loa bluetooth nào bạn có và chuẩn bị khuấy động không ngừng nghỉ!

Những bản phối dài, thường kéo dài hơn một giờ, là một phần không thể thiếu trong trải nghiệm âm nhạc của Diijam. Mỗi bản nhạc và mọi danh sách phát bạn phát không chỉ là một bản phối đơn giản; Đó là những câu chuyện âm nhạc, những hành trình đầy cảm xúc, nơi bạn có thể cảm nhận được sự hòa hợp trong từng giai điệu.

Từ các phiên kéo dài hàng giờ cho đến các bản nhạc chất lượng cực cao (320 kb/s) - nhịp điệu chất lượng mà bạn sẽ không tìm thấy ở bất kỳ nơi nào khác, đặc biệt là khi mọi người khác đang chơi trên các bản nhạc 128 kb/s. Khám phá Diijam và khiến mỗi người nghe không chỉ là một bài hát - đó là một câu chuyện, một sự rung cảm, nơi mỗi nốt nhạc nhảy theo nhịp điệu độc đáo của riêng nó!

Đưa âm nhạc của bạn lên một tầm cao mới với Diijam:
- Tại Diijam, chúng tôi mang đến cho bạn âm nhạc siêu chất lượng (320 kb/s) - bữa tiệc cho đôi tai của bạn.
- Hợp tác với những DJ và nghệ sĩ xuất sắc nhất, từ những bài hát hay nhất của Vinahouse Việt Nam đến EDM quốc tế, mỗi bài hát đều có phong cách riêng, độc đáo.

Khám phá âm nhạc mỗi ngày:
- Đối với Diijam, mỗi ngày là một cuộc phiêu lưu âm nhạc mới. Chúng tôi liên tục cập nhật âm nhạc độc quyền, các bản phối lại thú vị và các bản phối dài thú vị, đảm bảo bạn luôn tìm thấy điều gì đó mới mẻ trong kho âm nhạc đa dạng của mình.

- Nghe nhạc không quảng cáo.
- Chuyển bài không giới hạn, theo sở thích của bạn.
Hãy để Diijam đưa trải nghiệm âm nhạc của bạn lên một tầm cao mới!

bluejetty:00024192:ios.description:
Qibla Finder - Kaaba Compass application will help you to find the Kaaba (Qibla) direction quick and accurately where ever you are in the world.
If you change your location for a vacation or for a business trip, you can easily find Qibla with our application.
Using the application is really easy,
Make your device parallel to the ground and turn your device until arrow becomes green. When the arrow becomes green, your device's top side will be pointing Qibla.
To find Qibla direction, we use GPS and Compass in your device. Our application fist determines your position and direction. These values are then used in trigonmetric calculations to find the direction of Kaaba accurately.
Note : To find Qibla direction accurately, you need to give appropriate permissions to the application as the application asks at first use. And also application needs active Internet connection.
To avoid wrong results and to get most accurate results, please be sure not to use your phone near metalic or magnetic objects during measurement.

bluejetty:00019583:ios.description:
Welcome to Whispers, the ultimate interactive stories and immersive romance experience! 
Experience captivating storytelling, shaping your destiny through emotional chapters and romance. Choose between vampires or a mysterious bond with a fierce werewolf, or become the lead in character-driven romance stories with meaningful choices. Your choices in chapters truly matter, influencing your unique narrative. Start relationships, uncover deep secrets, and find true connection! This romance story app offers unlimited interactive choices, putting you in control of your own adventure in chapters. Let Whispers take you on a journey filled with thrilling chapters and exciting choices. Immerse yourself in this captivating story world where YOUR decisions shape the path of your destiny!
Features:
- Customise your outfit and meet your ideal partner.
- Make choices between a mysterious leader, billionaire, dragon, or werewolf for a captivating romantic story.
- Shape your journey through chapters of discovery, making meaningful choices that influence the story. Each decision leads to heartfelt connections, farewells, or adventures with dragons, wolves, and dynamic leaders.
- Daily release romantic book adaptations. Meet your charming leads in animated books and immerse yourself in exquisite scenes in animated romance books. Experience the magic of Whispers, where your choices define an extraordinary legend!
The Nocturnal Billionaire 
Get swept away by a compelling tale of power and mystery in this electrifying billionaire romance story! With every choice you make, you'll determine the fate of your relationship with a charismatic lead who is equal parts handsome billionaire and fierce werewolf. Will you embrace the story's journey and build a meaningful connection, or will you chart your own path and assert your independence?
Mafia: Dangerously Sweet 
Experience a thrilling romantic story in this interactive story. Play as the main character navigating a complex relationship with a mysterious figure in a world of power and loyalty. Your choices determine the outcome and happiness of your couple in each chapter.
Nanny to the Dragon King
You never expect to work with the Dragon King, a charismatic and enigmatic ruler with a fiery temper. What happens when you get closer to the mystery? Will you embrace the challenge or find another way? The choice is in your hands!
Experience love and relationships in interactive stories with thrilling chapters. Create your own story, enjoy romance and immersive narrative adventures. New chapters daily for endless adventures. Download Whispers and become the author of your own love story! Dive into drama, comedy, fantasy, sci-fi, young adult, and romance, where your choices matter. Uncover excitement in each chapter. The more you play, the more exciting chapters you will uncover. Trust us, the choices will keep you on the edge of your seat! The adventure awaits at Whispers: Interactive Stories!

bluejetty:00185931:ios.name: Astraware Kriss Kross
bluejetty:00185931:ios.summary: Kriss Kross, also known as Word Fit or Fill Ins, is a popular word puzzle that puts your deductive skills to the test! In each puzzle you are given a grid and a list of words, and it's up to you to find the right place to fill in the words!
bluejetty:00185931:ios.description:
Kriss Kross, also known as Word Fit or Fill Ins, is a popular word puzzle that puts your deductive skills to the test! In each puzzle you are given a grid and a list of words, and it's up to you to find the right place to fill in the words! It starts simply enough until you find words that could fit in multiple places and you realize you need to think ahead.
Astraware Kriss Kross gives you access to play our four Daily puzzles - top the global leaderboard by completing the puzzle in the fastest time! For more of a challenge there is a Weekender puzzle available each Friday with an even bigger grid. The game also includes 60 built-in puzzles in various sizes and difficulties.
Great features include:
- Unlimited access to our Daily and Weekender puzzles
- A collection of 60 free built-in puzzles in various sizes and difficulties, with many more to purchase
- New endless puzzle streams - watch ads (or take short surveys) then play the puzzles you like!
- Intuitive interface, works in landscape on iPad
- Save slots available so you can have several puzzles on the go at once, or you can stop for a break and come back to puzzle later
- Puzzles Plus subscription for unlimited puzzles
Get Astraware Kriss Kross and improve your logical reasoning - and your vocabulary too! If you love this game, we have Astraware CodeWords, Crosswords and Number Cross also available in this range, with more to come!
Puzzles Plus Subscription Terms and Details
Puzzles Plus is our optional subscription for Astraware Kriss Kross which entitles you to play all of the available Daily, Weekender and Stream puzzles as soon as they are available, without in-game adverts or any requirement to earn tokens. Subscribers can also choose to highlight their high scores with a choice of badges.
Subscriptions are available with renewal periods of either monthly, quarterly (every 3 months), or yearly. The price shown is the cost of the renewal, with the saving value for longer subscription periods as a comparison to the monthly option.
After you confirm a subscription, you will have a free trial period of seven days. Your iTunes Account will be charged as soon as the free trial is over. If you cancel the subscription at any time before the free trial is over, you will not be billed.
The subscriptions are automatically renewing, and you will be charged again at the end of your current subscription period. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn this off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
The renewal cost will be the same for each subscription period, and will be charged within the 24 hours before the end of your current subscription.
You can manage the subscriptions at any time by going to the Account Settings in the Settings App after purchase. There are options to either change to a different renewal period (which will be at a different price) or to cancel your subscription completely.
If you cancel the renewal you will still have access to the Puzzles Plus features until the full subscription period is complete. If you confirm the purchase of a subscription before the free trial is complete, any unused portion of the free trial will be lost.
These terms are available at : http://www.astraware.com/about/puzzlesplus/
For more information on Data and Privacy, please view the Astraware Privacy page at http://www.astraware.com/privacy

Your Essential Tool for Signing & Managing Documents
Make paperwork easy and efficient with a smart e-signature app designed to help you fill out, sign, and send documents in seconds — anytime, anywhere.
Whether you’re handling contracts, forms, or official PDFs, this app gives you the tools to stay productive without printers or scanners.
Key Features:
--- Autofill Docs with eSign
Quickly complete forms and documents with saved information and instantly apply your signature where it’s needed.
--- Scan and Sign PDF Documents
Turn paper into digital: scan printed documents, convert them to PDF, and sign them directly on your device.
--- Design Custom e-Signature
Create a personal, legally binding signature using your finger or stylus — save multiple styles for quick use.
--- Instant Form Filler
Skip the printer: fill out forms directly from your phone with a tap-friendly, easy-to-use interface.
--- Print Signed Documents
Need a hard copy? Easily print your signed documents or export them as ready-to-send PDFs.
--- Import & Organize
Bring in files from email, cloud services, or your device — keep your paperwork organized and accessible.
--- Paperless & Secure
Reduce clutter and stay eco-friendly with a secure, fully digital workflow.
Whether you’re a student, freelancer, business owner, or just tired of chasing down printers, this app helps you sign smarter and manage documents faster.
Download now and experience stress-free signing — right from your iPhone or iPad.

bluejetty:00119743:ios.description:
With Evolia, managers set their custom scheduling rules and assign work shifts to employees who create optimal schedules that meet everyone's needs. Let time be on everyone's side by assigning shifts and replacing workers on cruise-control.
WHY MANAGERS LOVE IT
- Define your staffing needs and create the required work shifts.
- Stop wasting time by creating recurring work shifts.
- Stay in control using advanced metrics and simple employee scheduling dashboards.
- Gain precious time back by letting employees fill in work shifts based on their availability.
- Prioritize which employees get to pick work shifts first using 100% customizable business rules scores and seniority.
- Fill open work shifts faster by alerting employees through email, SMS or push notifications.
- Set your custom rules and decide what you need to approve.
WHY EMPLOYEES LOVE IT
- Create a work schedule that fits your needs and constraints.
- View and manage your work shift calendar from anywhere on any device.
- Get notified about new work opportunities in the way you want: via email, SMS or push notifications.
- Whenever unavailable, request replacements on the go.
- Swap work shifts with coworkers.
- Request your vacations online for faster approval.
- Message coworkers from Evolia via email, push notifications or SMS.
WHY DOES IT WORK SO WELL?
Evolia manages which employees are qualified for requested positions and work shifts, invites them to use their manager's preferred system and then makes sure their total work hours comply with the businesses staff management policy.
DESIGNED BY A SEASONED TEAM OF HR TECH ENTREPRENEURS
Evolia keeps pushing the boundaries of staff management technologies and empowers managers to stay in control of their business most efficiently.
---

Join Evolia today and stop struggling with employee scheduling and start growing your business.

Whether it’s finding a hidden exit or sliding past obstacles, there’s always a new twist to discover as you work through each traffic escape. About GoMining
GoMining helps people unlock Bitcoin's full potential. Built on real-world mining infrastructure, it combines digital mining and other products into one simple crypto ecosystem. From earning daily rewards* to spending them with ease, GoMining turns Bitcoin from a distant cryptocurrency into part of everyday life.
What are Digital Miners?
Digital Miners are GoMining's core innovation: digital assets backed by real Bitcoin mining power hosted in GoMining's data centers. Each miner generates daily rewards*, while GoMining handles the hardware and operations (electricity and service fees apply**), making crypto mining simple and accessible. Unlike cloud mining, there is no expiring contract: users own their Digital Miners. 
Users can start small with flexible options like Mine Now Pay Later**, then trade or upgrade their miners as they go. Digital Miners also power Miner Wars, a clan-based mining competition where players put their miners to work in weekly rounds (prize terms apply**). It brings real BTC mining, gameplay and the wider crypto economy together in one dynamic experience.

bluejetty:00024143:ios.description:
OnSkin is your science-backed ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household products—trusted by over 8 million users.
Not sure what's actually in the products you use every day? OnSkin decodes ingredient labels, so you know which products are made with clean ingredients—whether you're checking what you already own or scanning before you buy. It's backed by a curated database of 2 million products, from viral K-beauty finds to everyday drugstore staples.
INGREDIENT CHECKER
Wondering what’s inside that face cream? Scan it and find out. OnSkin is your cosmetic checker for skincare, makeup, hair care, and more, giving you a clear verdict—Excellent, Good, Not Great, or Bad—plus plain-language notes on every ingredient. If it scores low, OnSkin suggests safer alternatives.
SKINCARE FINDER
Overwhelmed by choice in the skincare aisle? Answer a short questionnaire about your skin type and goals—think moisturizing, calming, or anti-acne—and OnSkin curates matching beauty products, from face cleansers to sunscreen. Less guessing in the store.
SKINCARE ROUTINE
Want a routine that actually fits your skin? Complete your Skin Profile, and OnSkin builds a personalized morning and evening skincare routine around your skin type and goals, so every step makes sense.
SHELF SCAN
Tired of scanning products one at a time? Shelf Scan reads your entire bathroom cabinet in one go and delivers safety and quality scores on the spot.
SKIN MATCH
Wondering if a product's right for you? OnSkin skips generic "clean beauty" labels and checks it against your skin type, sensitivities, concerns, and goals—then gives you a clear verdict on whether the product is a match.
ONSKIN COMMUNITY
Curious how other people handle the same skin or hair concerns? Join the OnSkin Community to swap tips, ask questions, and get inspired by real skincare journeys.
HAIR LAB
Not sure if your shampoo or conditioner suits your hair type? OnSkin goes beyond the skincare scanner, checking any hair product against your hair type and goals. Your Hair Match score shows how well it fits, so you can build a hair care routine that works for you.
AI SKIN HELPER
Need quick advice on your skin type or the latest beauty trend? Ask your own question or pick a popular one and get personalized guidance from the AI Skin Helper in seconds.
MORE TO EXPLORE
Check your local UV Index, browse trending Popular Scans, or test your instincts with the daily Guess the Score game.
WHY TRUST ONSKIN
– Independent safety ratings for skincare, hair care, makeup, and household products—no brand deals, no sponsored reviews.
– Grounded in toxicology and dermatology research, with 15,000+ ingredients analyzed for safety, quality, and toxicity.
– Recommendations and scoring criteria reviewed by our in-house team of certified dermatologists.
– No vague "non-toxic" claims—just clear, honest ingredient explanations.
– Proud partner of the Skin Cancer Foundation.
RECOGNITION
Featured in Forbes, CNN, Vogue, and The Independent. Double winner of a 2024 Webby Award and a New York Product Design Award.
FAQ
Q: Is OnSkin good for acne-prone skin?
A: Yes—Skin Match flags acne-safe products based on your skin profile.
Q: What if a product isn't in the database yet?
A: Request an On-Demand Analysis and get its safety score in just a few hours.
Q: Can I check household and cleaning products too?
A: Yes—OnSkin analyzes household and cleaning products with the same expert-reviewed safety ratings.
Download OnSkin—your all-in-one ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household essentials—and stop guessing what’s in your products.
PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
– You can subscribe to get unlimited access to certain app features.
– Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the selected subscription plan.

bluejetty:00062095:ios.name: Connect the Dots - Animals
bluejetty:00062095:ios.summary: A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted bird
bluejetty:00062095:ios.description:
A rich and diverse animal world is very interesting for young children. First we get acquainted with domestic animals, like for example, fluffy kittens and playful dogs. On the street, we come across small insects and chirping, spotted birds. In the zoo we can view wild animals, such as rabbits, a fox, and a bear. Every time we learn more and more about these co-habitants of our Earth! Some of them creep along, while others run on their paws; still others soar through the air! Some prefer to live in burrows, some in nests, while others just live in the trees or sleep in meadows. You'll see huge elephants and hippopotamuses, small chameleons and frogs, fast lions and slow turtles - herbivores and predators alike. We invite you to get acquainted with these marvelous representatives of the animal kingdom on the pages of our game! 
Features: 
◦ Connect points by numbers or letters 
◦ When points are connected, you will see the silhouette of a hidden picture 
◦ Once all the points have been connected, you can color the picture 
◦ Choosing a wrong symbol three times in a row will bring up a tip 
◦ Blue, orange, green or pink stars make the game even more exciting 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
Connect points is a learning puzzle for small children. It helps develop thinking, improve memory and attention. The application has three game modes: by numbers, letters and coloring. Game modes with letters and numbers will be useful for kindergarten and pre-K kids. 
Connecting by numbers will help to easily memorize the order of numbers and learn to count. To do this, you need to consecutively connect circles with numbers starting from 1. As you connect circles in the right order, the silhouette of a hidden picture will become more and more visible. If three points are chosen incorrectly, a tip will pop up. Once all the points are fully connected, the picture will become fully visible and you’ll be able to color it.
Those studying the alphabet can choose to connect points by letters. It is important that children know letters as early as possible, since it is essential for learning to read and write. But knowing the order of letters in the alphabet is also very important! This can be achieved by connecting circles with letters in the right sequence.
The coloring mode will be especially appreciated by young artists. In this mode, you can proceed to coloring pictures without connecting points. To make the process even more exciting, you can change any predefined color. To do this, press and hold the paint bucket and choose the necessary color from the palette.

bluejetty:00061235:ios.name: FormConnect Pro
bluejetty:00061235:ios.summary: Stop drowning in paperwork! The FormConnect Pro app transforms your iPad and iPhone into a powerful mobile form solution eliminating the need for messy paper forms and tedious data entry. Design custom forms tailored to your exact needs, co
bluejetty:00061235:ios.description:
Stop drowning in paperwork! The FormConnect Pro app transforms your iPad and iPhone into a powerful mobile form solution eliminating the need for messy paper forms and tedious data entry. Design custom forms tailored to your exact needs, collect data offline, and seamlessly share information with your team. Boost productivity, reduce errors, and go green with the FormConnect Pro app! Designed for individuals and small businesses that need a versatile and efficient solution for data collection and organization.
Key Features:
• Customizable Form Templates: Create forms from scratch or use pre-built templates.
• Multiple Field Types: (text, dates checkboxes, drop-down lists, radio buttons, signatures, photos, GPS).
• Multiple Themes: (folder, clipboard, binders etc.) to change the look of the form (iPad Only).
• Touch Input: Data input via touch or an external keyboard.
• Signature Capture: Use your finger or a stylus.
• Photo Capture: Take photos with your iPhone or iPad’s camera.
• Photo Annotation: Annotate on top of photos.
• Form Sharing: Share forms with other FormConnect Pro users.
• Export Options: Email forms or upload them to Dropbox, Box, Google Drive or Microsoft OneDrive.
• File Formats: Forms can be saved and exported in one or more of the following file formats: (PDF, CSV, XML, HTML, FMC).
• Form Printing: Print forms to any printer that supports Apple’s AirPrint wireless protocol.
• Pre-populate Fields: Auto populate data into fields when you open the form.
• Auto increment: Auto generate a sequential number in a text field.
• Text Formatting: (bolding, italicizing and coloring).
• Field Alignment: (left, right and center).
• Field Calculation: A spreadsheet type function for summing rows and columns.
• Field Linking: Link fields together so that data entered into one field automatically populates another field.
• Form Locking: Lock a filled out form from being altered.
• Required Field: Specify fields on the form that must be filled out before the form can be saved.
• Kiosk Mode: Locks the user interface to a specific set of functions.
• GPS Data Capture: Display latitude and longitude coordinates.
WHICH FORMCONNECT APP IS RIGHT FOR YOU?
• FormConnect Pro: Best for individual contractors, field workers, and businesses needing a powerful, local, offline form builder on their iPad and iPhone.
• FormConnect Pro+: Best for power users and small teams. Adds enhanced form design and form syncing capabilities across iPad, iPhone, and Mac.
• FormConnect ProMax: Best for organizations and enterprises. Adds a dedicated central server database with administrative user permissions. Allows you to design custom forms on your iPad, Mac, or PC using a web browser and fill them out and sync them across all your devices.
Terms of Use: https://www.formconnections.com/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://www.formconnections.com/about-2/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00063496:ios.description:
• #1 word game in 32 countries
• Played over 10 million times
• Four game modes, from frantic 30-second games to relaxed, untimed play
• 12 languages, each with its own full dictionary
Hexiled is an original word game played on a hexagon grid. Trace words through neighboring tiles: each word must touch an empty space on the board and be at least as long as the number shown on its tiles. The tutorial gets you started in a minute.
FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• ESCAPE - timing adapts to how well you play, so it's a frantic challenge at any level. A game takes a couple of minutes, or 15-30 seconds if you're really good.
• SURVIVE - every word earns you more time. A test of quick thinking, vocabulary and endurance that fits a 1-5 minute break.
• EXPLORE - no time limit. Relax and rack up a high score, or hunt for the longest words.
• DISCOVER - reach the edge of the board in as few words as possible. It gets harder as you get better.
PLAY IN 12 LANGUAGES
English, Français, Deutsch, Nederlands, Español, Português, Italiano, Svenska, Norsk, Dansk, Русский, Ελληνικά
Switch language any time. It's a great way to build vocabulary in a language you're learning.
ALSO INCLUDES
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• Detailed post-game stats and all-time records
• Color themes
• A killer original soundtrack
• Play offline, no account needed
• iPhone, iPad and Mac
Hexiled is free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes ads and adds your Best Words list.
WHAT PLAYERS SAY
"The best word game I have ever played" - sboyce_tw
"One of the best games on the App Store - great word based game" - tcfairfax
"A very satisfying hexagonal word search maze-like. Highly recommend!" - BookishMatt
"This game is so amazing! I'm addicted to it" - jotap_rios
"Spellbinding new wordplay app" - Evaluapp

bluejetty:00168035:ios.name: Lyra Health
bluejetty:00168035:ios.summary: Whether you're coping with sadness or anxiety, a loss in your family, stress at work, living in a new country or raising your kids, Lyra can get you back on your feet. Lyra Health is a mental health and well-being benefit. You can use the L
bluejetty:00168035:ios.description:
Whether you're coping with sadness or anxiety, a loss in your family, stress at work, living in a new country or raising your kids, Lyra can get you back on your feet. Lyra Health is a mental health and well-being benefit. You can use the Lyra Health app if your organization or health plan offers Lyra and has enabled the app.
Easily find confidential care for your emotional and mental health how, when, and where you need it. Access self-care resources or schedule an appointment with a provider personalized to your needs and preferences right from the app.
With the Lyra Health app, you can:
‣ Access well-being resources through the Lyra mobile app anytime, anywhere
‣ Meet with providers personalized to you and share how you are feeling
‣ Complete video lessons, exercises, and meditations to reinforce new skills and behaviors
‣ Message your provider to ask questions or get support
‣ Track your symptoms and progress over time if you’re seeing a provider
-- HOW TO GET STARTED--
1. Download the Lyra Health app and register to get started.
2. Start using the on-demand well-being resources.
3. If you’re interested in meeting with a licensed provider, share more about what you’re experiencing and find providers with the right expertise.
4. Schedule your first appointment.
5. Attend your first session on the app or on your computer. 
6. If your provider offers messaging and digital activities, use the Lyra Health app to access these features on the go.
-- DOES MY LYRA PROVIDER OFFER MESSAGING AND DIGITAL ACTIVITIES? --
Yes! Many Lyra providers support messaging and will offer guided mental health activities like videos and exercises between sessions. It’s important to note, however, that not all providers support these features. Features can vary based on the Lyra program you are enrolled in. If you’re not sure, ask your Lyra provider if 1:1 provider messaging and digital activities are part of your care plan.
-- WHAT IS LYRA ESSENTIALS? --
Ready to stress less, sleep more, and build healthy habits? Explore Lyra Essentials, a library of well-being resources available within the Lyra app. Access content personalized to your interests, developed by Lyra clinicians, and based on science. Each video, article, strategy, and meditation is designed to bring more joy to your life. 
-- ABOUT LYRA HEALTH--
Lyra provides care for your emotional and mental health, whenever and wherever you need it. Whether you’re feeling stuck, stressed, on edge, or down, support from Lyra’s well-being programs, coaches, therapists, and physicians can set you on a path to feeling better. 
-- WHO CAN USE LYRA SERVICES? --
Lyra Health is a mental health care benefit offered to individuals and their families. If you’re not sure whether your organization or health plan provides you and/or your dependents with access to Lyra, please contact your HR team or customer support team. 
-- IS LYRA SECURE? --
Safety, security, and confidentiality are #1 priorities at Lyra. Our technology is HITRUST certified and compliant with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). For more information, find our complete Privacy Policy at https://www.lyrahealth.com/privacy-policy

KEY FEATURES
• Real-time Push Notifications

Quickly check the current status of all your monitors at a glance.
• Uptime Widgets
Add customizable home screen widgets to stay informed about your overall uptime without opening the app.

• Website (HTTP/S)

Trusted by millions, UptimeRobot helps individuals, teams, and businesses around the world keep their online services running smoothly.
GET STARTED FREE
Sign up for free and get 50 monitors - no credit card required.

bluejetty:00123806:ios.name: Road Rush - Street Bikes Race
bluejetty:00123806:ios.summary: Ride your motorcycles on busy highways while you fight, punch, slap, and kick racing rivals on the track. Dodge traffic on your dirt bike with blazing fast speed. Be a highway drifter and zoom down a busy highway passing by cars. Hustle you
bluejetty:00123806:ios.description:
Ride your motorcycles on busy highways while you fight, punch, slap, and kick racing rivals on the track. Dodge traffic on your dirt bike with blazing fast speed. Be a highway drifter and zoom down a busy highway passing by cars. Hustle your way through the ranks of a bandit motorbike gang in this racing game.
This racing game is suitable for players who prefer a tactical strategy to race the traffic with simple speed. You will need to analyze your racer dirt bike’s resistance to terrains and attacks, as well as your capabilities in knocking your enemies. Altogether, the street bike race games magnify the fun of racing for both random players and expert motocross gamers.
Now it is time to hit the roads with Xtreme motorbike, traffic rider, enjoy the racing fever in these dirt bike games, and do whatever it takes to be the top road rush!
OPEN-WORLD EXPLORATION
Joyride on your racer dirt bike around a huge city and explore an extensive variety of missions and objectives throughout its distinctive neighborhoods. For a more practical experience, you may play the street bike race games from your road rush perspective or increase your control of the dirtbike using various camera angles.
ONE LIFE TO LIVE
Driving a bike at 100 mph while trying to hit someone is dangerous, and death can happen quickly. There are no extra lives nor continues for the motocross. Luckily, every time you die, all the experience you've accumulated can be used in the street bike race games to upgrade your character and your bike. You will never get tired while playing these motorcycle racing games!
ENDLESS GAMEPLAY WHILE RACING THE TRAFFIC
Head out and race as quickly as you can to become the best road rush in the world! Race the traffic and finish the challenges to get authentic among the racing game competition. Board on your racer dirt bike and ride in the endless busy roadways and highways! Never forget that moto bike racing can be fun, but it can also be deadly! Roads and highways are full of highway riders on speeding vehicles – they can bother you!
SELECTION OF HIGH-PERFORMANCE XTREME MOTORBIKE
Have you ever wanted to ride a motorcycle in real life to suit your style? Great! It's about time to test your abilities and pick on the motorcycle category you would prefer – remarkably fast superbike, historic chopper motorcycles, or transformed high-performance versions of motorcycles racing games! Whether you choose a new or upgraded bike, it’s necessary to keep it resistant to damage.
DIFFERENT CONTROL OPTIONS
We know that no two racers are alike! We included a controller option to comfort you all. Control your dirt bike by tilting your phone or by touching the screen. You have no excuse left for you to win the race!
CLIMB TO THE TOP OF THE LEADERBOARDS OF THE RACING GAME
Take part in a selection of hardcore missions and become the most active Street bike race on the streets. Millions of other contestants will compete for the top rank in the motorcycle racing games. Join them and work your way up the weekly tournament rankings. Race the traffic and finish the challenges to get real among the race game competition.
FEATURES
- Choose from the 10+ fastest high-performance extreme motorbikes from your favorite category: chopper, cross, or superbike.
- Enjoy 10+ characters with their style in the motorcycle game.
- Detailed environments with extreme 3D visuals for dirt track racing.
- A deep motorcycle combat mode with kicks, counters, critical strikes, and more.
- Dart and dodge traffic while trying to get a high score with close-calls/near-misses between cars and trucks.
- Traffic riders have a career mode with 30+ hardcore challenges for the road rush.
- Use boosts to go faster and increase your scores on highways.
- All new first-person mode for realistic driving.
- Dominate online leaderboards and unlock 12 achievements in moto bike racing.

listings.name: Road Rush - Street Bikes Race
listings.description:
Ride your motorcycles on busy highways while you fight, punch, slap, and kick racing rivals on the track. Dodge traffic on your dirt bike with blazing fast speed. Be a highway drifter and zoom down a busy highway passing by cars. Hustle your way through the ranks of a bandit motorbike gang in this racing game.

This racing game is suitable for players who prefer a tactical strategy to race the traffic with simple speed. You will need to analyze your racer dirt bike’s resistance to terrains and attacks, as well as your capabilities in knocking your enemies. Altogether, the street bike race games magnify the fun of racing for both random players and expert motocross gamers.

Now it is time to hit the roads with Xtreme motorbike, traffic rider, enjoy the racing fever in these dirt bike games, and do whatever it takes to be the top road rush!

OPEN-WORLD EXPLORATION
Joyride on your racer dirt bike around a huge city and explore an extensive variety of missions and objectives throughout its distinctive neighborhoods. For a more practical experience, you may play the street bike race games from your road rush perspective or increase your control of the dirtbike using various camera angles.

ONE LIFE TO LIVE
Driving a bike at 100 mph while trying to hit someone is dangerous, and death can happen quickly. There are no extra lives nor continues for the motocross. Luckily, every time you die, all the experience you've accumulated can be used in the street bike race games to upgrade your character and your bike. You will never get tired while playing these motorcycle racing games!

ENDLESS GAMEPLAY WHILE RACING THE TRAFFIC
Head out and race as quickly as you can to become the best road rush in the world! Race the traffic and finish the challenges to get authentic among the racing game competition. Board on your racer dirt bike and ride in the endless busy roadways and highways! Never forget that moto bike racing can be fun, but it can also be deadly! Roads and highways are full of highway riders on speeding vehicles – they can bother you!

SELECTION OF HIGH-PERFORMANCE  XTREME MOTORBIKE
Have you ever wanted to ride a motorcycle in real life to suit your style? Great! It's about time to test your abilities and pick on the motorcycle category you would prefer – remarkably fast superbike, historic chopper motorcycles, or transformed high-performance versions of motorcycles racing games! Whether you choose a new or upgraded bike, it’s necessary to keep it resistant to damage.

DIFFERENT CONTROL OPTIONS
We know that no two racers are alike! We included a controller option to comfort you all. Control your dirt bike by tilting your phone or by touching the screen. You have no excuse left for you to win the race!

CLIMB TO THE TOP OF THE LEADERBOARDS OF THE RACING GAME
Take part in a selection of hardcore missions and become the most active Street bike race on the streets. Millions of other contestants will compete for the top rank in the motorcycle racing games. Join them and work your way up the weekly tournament rankings. Race the traffic and finish the challenges to get real among the race game competition.

FEATURES
- Choose from the 10+ fastest high-performance extreme motorbikes from your favorite category: chopper, cross, or superbike.
- Enjoy 10+ characters with their style in the motorcycle game.
- Detailed environments with extreme 3D visuals for dirt track racing.
- A deep motorcycle combat mode with kicks, counters, critical strikes, and more.
- Dart and dodge traffic while trying to get a high score with close-calls/near-misses between cars and trucks.
- Traffic riders have a career mode with 30+ hardcore challenges for the road rush.
- Use boosts to go faster and increase your scores on highways.
- All new first-person mode for realistic driving.
- Dominate online leaderboards and unlock 12 achievements in moto bike racing.

bluejetty:00029266:ios.developer: Skyalert de Mexico SAPI de CV
bluejetty:00029266:ios.summary:
La app #1 de alertamiento sísmico y meteorológico en México. Recibe alertas con hasta 190 segundos de anticipación* ante un sismo y otros eventos, gracias a la mayor red de sensores con IA del país.
Descarga la app gratis y elige el nivel
bluejetty:00029266:ios.description:
La app #1 de alertamiento sísmico y meteorológico en México. Recibe alertas con hasta 190 segundos de anticipación* ante un sismo y otros eventos, gracias a la mayor red de sensores con IA del país.
Descarga la app gratis y elige el nivel de protección que necesitas.
• Conoce el tiempo estimado de arribo
• Identifica la intensidad esperada en tu ubicación
• Recibe alertas meteorológicas relevantes para tu zona
• Comunícate sin necesidad de internet o saldo mediante Mesh
• Extiende la protección a tu computadora o familia
Al contar con nuestra propia REDSkyAlert te ayudamos a actuar con mayor confianza antes, durante y después de una emergencia. Nuestra REDSkyAlert es la red privada de sensores sísmicos más grande de México. Distribuida a lo largo de la costa del Pacífico, la REDSkyAlert tiene cobertura en las zonas de mayor peligro sismico. NO dependemos del sistema de detección sísmica del gobierno de México; con un algoritmo propio, nuestro sistema te enviará alertas basados en la intensidad con la que percibirás el sismo en tu ubicación, de acuerdo a nuestra Escala de Intensidades: débil, leve, moderado, fuerte, violento y severo.
INFORMACIÓN RELEVANTE PARA TU UBICACIÓN
• Un mismo sismo puede sentirse de forma diferente según el lugar donde estés.
• SkyAlert personaliza la información para mostrarte el tiempo estimado de arribo, la intensidad esperada y los avisos relevantes para tu localidad.
• Las alertas se procesan con tecnología propia y datos de REDSkyAlert, nuestra red privada de 143 sensores sísmicos distribuida en zonas de alto peligro sísmico de México.
CARACTERÍSTICAS DE SKYALERT
Alertas sísmicas personalizadas
• Recibe información según tu ubicación y elige las intensidades sobre las que deseas recibir avisos, sin desactivar las alertas más críticas.
Microsismos en CDMX
• Recibe avisos en tiempo real sobre sismos locales detectados en la Ciudad de México por REDSkyAlert.
SkyAlert Mesh
• Cuando no tienes saldo, datos móviles o Wi-Fi, o cuando la red está saturada, Mesh te permite comunicarte mediante dispositivos cercanos.
• Puedes enviar mensajes, compartir tu ubicación y mantener el contacto en emergencias, conciertos, festivales o zonas con poca cobertura.
Simulacros programados
• Practica tus protocolos de seguridad desde la aplicación antes de necesitarlos.
Otros fenómenos naturales
• Consulta información sobre sismos, huracanes, lluvias y otros riesgos naturales en México.
MÁS QUE FUNCIONES PREMIUM
Cuando te suscribes a SkyAlert te conviertes en parte de una misión que busca salvar vidas y llevar protección a más personas.
Tu suscripción impulsa el desarrollo de tecnología innovadora, fortalece REDSkyAlert y ayuda a extender la protección a millones de personas en México.
Cada suscripción hace posible que más personas puedan actuar a tiempo cuando cada segundo cuenta. Gracias por ser parte de esta misión.
Con tu ayuda, seguimos fortaleciendo la cultura de la prevención en México.
¿QUÉ PLAN ELEGIR?
• Elige Premium si quieres alertas adaptadas al lugar donde estés.
• Elige Premium+ si también deseas recibir alertas en tu PC o Mac con más segundos de anticipación.
• Elige Premium Familiar si quieres extender la protección a tres personas adicionales.
PREGUNTAS FRECUENTES
¿La descarga es gratuita?
• Sí. Puedes descargar SkyAlert gratis y elegir el plan que mejor se adapte a tus necesidades.
¿SkyAlert predice los sismos?
• No. SkyAlert procesa información de eventos detectados para proporcionar alertas, tiempos estimados de arribo e intensidad esperada según tu ubicación.
¿Mesh funciona sin internet?
• Mesh permite comunicarte mediante dispositivos cercanos cuando no tienes datos móviles, saldo o Wi-Fi, o cuando la red está saturada.
-----------
*Con base en la distancia entre nuestro sensor más lejano y la Ciudad de México.

bluejetty:00035198:ios.description:
Construct your robotic truck from scratch for an epic robot battle in Truck Wars, awesome robot truck building games! Ruin your enemy robot in your epic robot car fighting games. Take advantage of robot truck-making games and play your best robot battle games in this robot-fighting truck arcade! 
A robot truck arcade that brings you all the enjoyment of robot-building games. Here, you need to find a robot construction and engineering solution that will enable you to build a powerful robot truck capable of defeating your robotic enemy.
Engineer and build a robotic truck of your design. Then, start fighting and navigate your truck in this robot battle. Get new parts and weapons as you reach higher levels in these robot truck building games.
Main features:
- Engaging truck-making games that develop your engineering talent. Build your robot truck from available tools and create an ultimate machine of death.
- Various modules to build your robot truck: blocks, wheels and tracks, fire gun, shield, saws, etc.
- Endless enemy robots. Plenty of robot car fighting games. Endless fun!
- Does not require the Internet, so you can play your epic robot fighting games offline! Your exciting robot truck free games.
Experiment with your robot truck! Dominate and survive in the most severe robot battle games! Have fun!
Engineer your robot truck and play your best robot car fighting games! Play robot fighting games offline! Complete special daily quests and get hefty rewards. 
Unlike many other robot-building games, Truck Wars truck free games allow you not only to construct your robot truck but also to control your robot battle!

bluejetty:00132255:ios.summary: GZI TV provides a new and exciting way to connect with Glory of Zion International. Most live broadcasts and time-limited “replays” are free - but GZI TV has more to offer you! Now you can get access to our entire ever-expanding library of
bluejetty:00132255:ios.description:
GZI TV provides a new and exciting way to connect with Glory of Zion International. Most live broadcasts and time-limited “replays” are free - but GZI TV has more to offer you! Now you can get access to our entire ever-expanding library of content! This includes access to teaching series, Firstfruits revelation, GZI Israel content, Arts & Worship, conferences, courses, and original programming.
We also have a free trial available, where you can see everything at no cost for 7 days. GZI TV is your opportunity to access revelatory content and entertainment for you and your family anytime, anywhere!
Remember, most live broadcasts and time-limited “replays” remain free!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to GZI TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
*All payments will be paid through your iTunes account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Privacy policy – https://tv.gloryofzion.org/privacy
Terms of Service – https://tv.gloryofzion.org/tos

bluejetty:00069880:ios.name: Read Out Loud Reader: Speechy
bluejetty:00069880:ios.summary:
Introducing Speechy: The Ultimate Book Reader and Read Aloud Reader for Everyone
Experience the power of Speechy, the advanced book reader and read aloud reader app designed to cater to everyone's needs. With its cutting-edge T2S technolog
bluejetty:00069880:ios.description:
Introducing Speechy: The Ultimate Book Reader and Read Aloud Reader for Everyone
Experience the power of Speechy, the advanced book reader and read aloud reader app designed to cater to everyone's needs. With its cutting-edge T2S technology and AI TTS capabilities, Speechy empowers users to effortlessly convert text into high-quality audio, making reading accessible to all. Whether you prefer to read out loud, use it as a screen reader, or have text read to you, Speechy is the perfect companion for an enhanced reading experience.
Book Reader for Everyone:
With Speechy's intuitive book reader feature, everyone can dive into an immersive reading experience tailored to their preferences. Whether you're a student, a professional, or an avid reader, Speechy's book reader adapts to you.
Read Aloud Reader:
Speechy serves as your personal read aloud reader, transforming written text into captivating audio for everyone to enjoy. With Speechy, every word comes to life with expressive voices that make the content engaging and accessible.
T2S Text to Voice:
Experience the magic of Speechy's T2S technology, which seamlessly converts written text into lifelike and expressive voices. The T2S capability of Speechy opens up a world of possibilities for readers of all backgrounds.
AI TTS (Artificial Intelligence Text-to-Speech):
Thanks to Speechy's advanced AI algorithms, the AI TTS feature delivers natural and engaging voices that make reading a delightful experience for everyone. The AI TTS technology ensures high-quality audio output.
Read Out Loud:
Sit back, relax, and let Speechy read out loud for you. Whether you're multitasking or simply prefer listening to text, Speechy's read out loud feature provides an immersive and convenient way to consume written content.
Screen Reader:
Speechy's integrated screen reader functionality is a game-changer for users with reading disabilities or visual impairments. The screen reader feature ensures that everyone can access and enjoy written content effortlessly.
Read to Me:
Whether you're on the move or engaged in other activities, Speechy can read text to you, transforming any moment into a delightful listening experience. The read to me feature allows you to enjoy your favorite books or articles hands-free.
Discover More Features Tailored for Everyone:
- Scan physical book pages with your device camera, enabling Speechy to convert them into accessible audio content. This feature is particularly useful for those who prefer physical books or need assistance with reading.
- Enjoy Speechy's wide language support, offering over 27 languages and 174 natural voice accents. The diverse language options ensure that Speechy can cater to users from different regions and cultures.
- Customize the reading speed to meet individual preferences, adjusting it up to 900 words per minute. Speechy allows you to find the optimal reading speed that suits your comfort and pace.
- Import online articles, PDFs, clipboard-copied text, or even photos of physical book pages, and let Speechy read them aloud using its powerful T2S text to voice technology. This functionality ensures that all types of content can be consumed through Speechy.
- With Speechy's file organization feature, you can effortlessly manage your reading materials and locate them whenever needed.
- Experience Speechy's read aloud reader functionality offline, without the need for an internet connection. This allows you to enjoy uninterrupted reading sessions wherever you are.
Download Speechy now and embark on a transformative audio reading journey. Explore the inclusive features of our book reader, read aloud reader, T2S text to voice, AI TTS, read out loud, screen reader, and read to me functionalities. Let Speechy revolutionize your reading experience, making it accessible and enjoyable for everyone.
Privacy Policy: https://adappssoftware.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://adappssoftware.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00030444:ios.description:
Pump Club: Your all-in-one fitness app
Stop jumping between multiple fitness apps, meal trackers, and workout programs. Pump Club is your complete fitness transformation toolkit that brings together everything you need to build a stronger, healthier you - all in one place.
Access personalized workouts, nutrition tracking, expert articles, QAs, live meetups, AI coach, and supportive community. Whether you're a complete beginner or seasoned athlete, our comprehensive platform adapts to your unique goals and lifestyle.
What Makes The Pump Club Different
Complete Fitness Solution—Our app includes everything you need for weight loss, muscle building, and overall wellbeing.
Arnold Schwarzenegger’s Direct Involvement—The Pump Club is 100% owned and operated by Arnold and his team.
No Upsells—Get full access to all features and benefits for one simple price – everything included, no extra costs.
Key Features
* Personalized workout programs - Whether you're working out in the gym or at home, our workout programs adapt to your goals, fitness level and available equipment.
* Simple nutrition tracker - Track your meals without complicated math or calorie counting. Includes various progress tracking methods helping you reach your goals!
* Live Meetups - Join regular live community meetups around the world (even in Arnold’s hometown Thal, Austria!). Meet like-minded people, get expert advice and have fun.
* Live coaching sessions - Group video calls with certified fitness trainers for form checks, motivation and knowledge sharing.
* Expert articles & QAs - Workout and nutrition tips, motivational insights and life wisdom from Arnold and his team.
* Arnold AI - Arnold’s 60+ years of experience at your fingertips - Instant exercise advice, nutrition tips, and life wisdom available 24/7.
* Health and wellness habit building - Habit tracker for developing lasting healthy routines using proven behavioural techniques.
* Fitness community support - Connect and check-in with other app members to stay accountable and motivate each other.
Meet The Team
Arnold Schwarzenegger: The Pump Club Founder, Bodybuilder, Conan, Terminator, and former Governor of California
Daniel Ketchell: The Pump Club Founder, Customer Service Rep, Village Guinea Pig, Chief of Staff to Arnold Schwarzenegger
Adam Bornstein: The Pump Club Founder, NYT Bestselling Author, Dad of 3
Jen Widerstrom: The Pump Coach, Weight Loss & Wellness Educator, Biggest Loser Coach, Bestselling Author
Nicolai Myers (Uncle Nic): The Pump Coach, 21’ & 22’ Worlds Strongest Man, America’s Strongest Veteran
Pump Club is perfect for:
* Beginners starting their fitness journey
* Experienced lifters aiming for the next level
* Busy parents needing flexibility
* Anyone tired of juggling multiple fitness apps
* People seeking a supportive, positive fitness community
* Those wanting expert guidance without the high cost of personal training
Don’t Just Take Our Word For It, Try It Out Yourself!
Download now and try 7 days for free! Discover what thousands of members already know—The Pump Club delivers real results.

bluejetty:00145920:ios.name: ivie – Official Vienna Guide
bluejetty:00145920:ios.summary: The official City Guide app can tell you everything about Vienna’s sights, from the Schönbrunn palace through the Prater to St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Ringstrasse boulevard. And not only does ivie know the way, it knows Vienna from the
bluejetty:00145920:ios.description:
The official City Guide app can tell you everything about Vienna’s sights, from the Schönbrunn palace through the Prater to St. Stephen's Cathedral and the Ringstrasse boulevard. And not only does ivie know the way, it knows Vienna from the inside out. Insider tips, curious anecdotes and lots of stories about special places all over Vienna are waiting for you. As a digital travel guide and city guide, ivie offers you tours, city walks with audio support and important information about urban infrastructure such as toilets, city bikes and drinking fountains.
ivie will show you Vienna as you’ve never seen it before. 
So are you curious? Vienna is full of surprises. Let’s go! 
ivie will join you through Vienna with the following features:
- Discover Venues
Become a Vienna expert. Whether sightseeing or curious insider tips: ivie will take you around, bring you closer to things you know and let you discover the yet unknown.
- Walk & Listen
ivie's Walks & Guides show you exciting places, collected by theme. Discover' Beethoven's Vienna, the Viennese Modernism and much more.
- Orientate yourself on the Map
Keep the big picture. ivie knows exactly where the museums, sights and concert halls are, as well as the drinking fountains, city bikes and toilets.
- Find all Events
Search & find all events that take place in Vienna during your stay and filter them by category and type.
- Plan your trip with favorites places
Plan your trip to Vienna. With ivie, you can save locations to your Favorites list for easy retrieval. 
- Don't forget your own discovered places
Hold on to your own discoveries. Did you find a place that ivie doesn't know? Mark it by tapping the map. 
- ivie's tips
Stay up to date. ivie’s tips keep you informed at the right time in the right place, whenever you’re near something special.
- Two cards that complete your Vienna experience
Full mobility combined with numerous benfits or access to unique Vienna experiences. With our 2 different City Cards there is something for everyone!

bluejetty:00080634:ios.description:

bluejetty:00069732:ios.name: لعبة وصلة
bluejetty:00069732:ios.summary: لعبة وصلة معلومات عامة هي لعبة عربية مسلية لتنشيط الذاكرة و تنمية الذكاء و الإستفادة من عدة معلومات متنوعة في شتى المجالات . معلومات عن أنواع السيارات و أسئلة دينية كرة القدم ألغار Alghaz لغز صعب مع الحل لعبة wasla ألعاب أولاد و ألعاب بنات
bluejetty:00069732:ios.description:
لعبة وصلة معلومات عامة هي لعبة عربية مسلية لتنشيط الذاكرة و تنمية الذكاء و الإستفادة من عدة معلومات متنوعة في شتى المجالات . معلومات عن أنواع السيارات و أسئلة دينية كرة القدم ألغار Alghaz لغز صعب مع الحل لعبة wasla ألعاب أولاد و ألعاب بنات للكبار و حتى الصغار مما يمكنهم من تنمية ذكاء و تنشيط العقل ..
لعبة وصلة كرة القدم الأولى عربيا في مجال الرياضة المبنية على فكرة لعبة وصلة - كلمات متقاطعة لكنها مختصة فقط في أسئلة رياضية متنوعة تخص تاريخ الأندية و المنتخبات العالمية و التعرف على أسماء اللاعبين المشهورين و كذلك بعض اللاعبين المحترفين العرب و المزيد ... بطريقة مسلية و ممتعة .
لعبة علم أي دولة ؟ لعبة مسلية لتعرف على جميع أعلام الدول الإفريقية و الأسيوية و الأروبية و الأمريكية ، أعلام الدول العربية و الأجنبية . ربما تعرف أسماء دول قليلة في ذاكرتك هذه اللعبة سوف تساعد في حفظ و تذكر جميع أسماء أعلام الدول و التعرف على أعلام جديدة لم تسمع بها .
تمنحك لعبة من سيربح الملايين او لعبة المليونير العربي باللغة العربية المزيد من المعلومات في مختلف مجالات مثل الاسئلة الثقافية والاسئلة الدينية و العلوم والادب لتقوية معلوماتك واختبارها لديك بالاضافة الى تثقيف نفسكمن خلال هذا التطبيق سوف تجمع بين الترفيه واكتساب العديد من المعلومات 
هذا التطبيق يحتوي على مجموعة كبيرة من الأسئلة في مختلف المجالات أختبر ثقافتك ماعليك سوى تحميل التطبيق لتبدا رحلة المليون وتختبر مستوى ثقافتك وتعززها 
في اللعبة يجب عليك تجاوز عدة مراحل صعبة كل مرحلة تتكون من 10 أسئلة متنوعة كـ :
- حل الألغاز
- صور مكبرة
- معاني الكلمات
- أسئلة دينية رمضان
- أكمل الجملة , الأية , المثل
- اشخصيات تاريخية
- التعرف على أعلام و عواصم دول
- أسماء مشاهير الأفلام و كرة القدم
- أسماء سيارات و شعارات الشركات
- أسئلة رياضية كورة
توفر لك اللعبة عدة مساعدات لحل الأسئلة الصعبة من خلال :
إضهار الحرف الأول 
أو إخفاء ثلات حروف 
أو طلب مساعدة من صديق 
أو تخطي السؤال .
للبحث عن اللعبة باللغة العربية :
- لعبة وصلة الثقافية
- لغز و كلمة
- من سيربح المليون
- كلمات متقاطعة
- أربع صور كلمة واحدة
- وصلة كرة القدم
