تمنحك لعبة من سيربح الملايين او لعبة المليونير العربي باللغة العربية المزيد من المعلومات في مختلف مجالات مثل الاسئلة الثقافية والاسئلة الدينية و العلوم والادب لتقوية معلوماتك واختبارها لديك بالاضافة الى تثقيف نفسكمن خلال هذا التطبيق سوف تجمع بين الترفيه واكتساب العديد من المعلومات 

هذا التطبيق يحتوي على مجموعة كبيرة من الأسئلة في مختلف المجالات أختبر ثقافتك ماعليك سوى تحميل التطبيق لتبدا رحلة المليون وتختبر مستوى ثقافتك وتعززها 

في اللعبة يجب عليك تجاوز عدة مراحل صعبة كل مرحلة تتكون من 10 أسئلة متنوعة كـ :

- حل الألغاز
- صور مكبرة
- معاني الكلمات
- أسئلة دينية رمضان
- أكمل الجملة , الأية , المثل
- اشخصيات تاريخية
- التعرف على أعلام و عواصم دول
- أسماء مشاهير الأفلام و كرة القدم
- أسماء سيارات و شعارات الشركات
- أسئلة رياضية كورة


توفر لك اللعبة عدة مساعدات لحل الأسئلة الصعبة من خلال :

إضهار الحرف الأول 
أو إخفاء ثلات حروف 
أو طلب مساعدة من صديق 
أو تخطي السؤال .

للبحث عن اللعبة باللغة العربية :

- لعبة وصلة الثقافية
- لغز و كلمة
- من سيربح المليون
- كلمات متقاطعة
- أربع صور كلمة واحدة
- وصلة كرة القدم

bluejetty:00076301:ios.description:
Hear the time without stopping to look at your screen.
TalkingTime gives you spoken time announcements, chimes and personal voice reminders on iPhone and iPad. Use a regular time cue to notice the passing hours while you work, study or move through your day.
START WITH EASY
• Use the included Easy schedule.
• Choose spoken time or chimes, a voice, and 12- or 24-hour speech.
• Add your own text to an enabled Easy announcement time.
PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Edit Easy announcement times.
• Use the separate Custom schedule at any minute, on specific dates or on selected weekdays.
LEGACY PRO
Your original lifetime access continues to include Easy editing and messages. The separate Custom schedule requires a Pro subscription.
SET UP ANNOUNCEMENTS
Keep Master Enable on and allow Notifications and Sounds for TalkingTime. Then return to the Home Screen with a normal swipe up or Home button, giving the app time to prepare your schedule. Prepared announcements use iOS local notifications and can sound when the screen is locked. Keep the device powered on. Silent mode, ringer volume, Focus and audio routing can affect what you hear.
GET HELP
Open It’s not working and tap Get support. Diagnostic information is sent automatically. You can also contact support@fortuisoft.com.
The app and Apple purchase sheet show the current Pro price, billing period and any eligible trial. Pro is an automatically renewing subscription unless cancelled. Manage or cancel subscriptions through your Apple account.
Privacy: https://www.fortuisoft.com/talkingtime/Privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00025461:ios.description:
Dive into a soothing world of creativity and calm with color jigsaw, color puzzle, and beautifully crafted art jigsaw puzzles. Enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where every completed image becomes a masterpiece. This game combines jigsaw puzzles, artistic design, and peaceful gameplay to help you unwind at any time.
Discover hundreds of stunning artworks designed especially for fans of color jigsaw puzzle challenges. Each puzzle blends visual harmony with satisfying progression, turning every session into a moment of joy. Explore mesmerizing themes, detailed illustrations, and seasonal collections, including our enchanting winter puzzle series, perfect for cozy evenings.
If you enjoy artistic experiences, you’ll love our selection of jigsaw art puzzle games. They merge classic puzzle jigsaw mechanics with vibrant drawings and painting-style images. The result is a relaxing blend of creativity and logic that appeals to both beginners and experienced players. Build your focus, enhance your mood, and express your love for the art of puzzles.
Our game offers a rich variety of puzzle art jigsaw challenges and delightful picture puzzles that bring every image to life, piece by piece. From soft pastels to bold color palettes, every jigsaw art design has been handcrafted to inspire. Try themed sets, limited collections, and unique levels in our evolving library of art puzzle games.
With easy controls and comforting music, assembling each puzzle picture becomes a calming ritual. Whether you prefer small grids or large, detailed jigsaw art puzzle layouts, the game adapts to your style. Let your mind relax, sharpen your attention, and enjoy the meditative flow of creating art from scattered pieces.
Fans of art puzzles, puzzle art, and jigsaw art games will find endless inspiration here. Embrace the beauty of puzzle art jigsaw challenges, explore charming scenes, and bring colorful images to life with every move. This relaxing world of creativity is perfect for unwinding, focusing, or simply enjoying a moment of peace.
Start your journey into artistic relaxation with the best collection of jigsaw puzzles, color jigsaw puzzles, and art jigsaw puzzle games. Reconnect with your creative side, solve gorgeous picture challenges, and experience the joy of completing beautiful jigsaw puzzles one piece at a time.

Dive into a soothing world of creativity and calm with color jigsaw, color puzzle, and beautifully crafted art jigsaw puzzles. Enjoy a relaxing puzzle journey where every completed image becomes a masterpiece. This game combines jigsaw puzzles, artistic design, and peaceful gameplay to help you unwind at any time.

Discover hundreds of stunning artworks designed especially for fans of color jigsaw puzzle challenges. Each puzzle blends visual harmony with satisfying progression, turning every session into a moment of joy. Explore mesmerizing themes, detailed illustrations, and seasonal collections, including our enchanting winter puzzle series, perfect for cozy evenings.

If you enjoy artistic experiences, you’ll love our selection of jigsaw art puzzle games. They merge classic puzzle jigsaw mechanics with vibrant drawings and painting-style images. The result is a relaxing blend of creativity and logic that appeals to both beginners and experienced players. Build your focus, enhance your mood, and express your love for the art of puzzles.

Our game offers a rich variety of puzzle art jigsaw challenges and delightful picture puzzles that bring every image to life, piece by piece. From soft pastels to bold color palettes, every jigsaw art design has been handcrafted to inspire. Try themed sets, limited collections, and unique levels in our evolving library of art puzzle games.

With easy controls and comforting music, assembling each puzzle picture becomes a calming ritual. Whether you prefer small grids or large, detailed jigsaw art puzzle layouts, the game adapts to your style. Let your mind relax, sharpen your attention, and enjoy the meditative flow of creating art from scattered pieces.

Fans of art puzzles, puzzle art, and jigsaw art games will find endless inspiration here. Embrace the beauty of puzzle art jigsaw challenges, explore charming scenes, and bring colorful images to life with every move. This relaxing world of creativity is perfect for unwinding, focusing, or simply enjoying a moment of peace.

Start your journey into artistic relaxation with the best collection of jigsaw puzzles, color jigsaw puzzles, and art jigsaw puzzle games. Reconnect with your creative side, solve gorgeous picture challenges, and experience the joy of completing beautiful jigsaw puzzles one piece at a time.

The community-driven My Movies online service holds detailed data for mo
bluejetty:00022713:ios.description:
My Movies is the #1 app for managing your Movie & TV Series collection! Just scan the barcodes of your 4K Ultra HD, Blu-ray and DVDs, and never double-purchase again.
The community-driven My Movies online service holds detailed data for more than 1,500,000 disc-based titles worldwide, across more than 150,000 movies and 125,000 TV series, allowing you to track both your disc-based collection and your collection of digital copies across any online service.
• Keep track of your collection of both physical media and digital copies, as well as your wish list.
• Our exclusive service lets you report titles missing from the app in the rare situation where you have something in your collection which we do not have. Our staff will rapidly create the titles.
• Should you find any incorrect data, report this to our staff within the app and we make sure that it gets corrected.
Attention Upgraders! Users of a prior My Movies version, or users transferring from another platform, simply log into the same user account that you previously used and your existing collection will synchronise to the new application. You can find your username at the bottom of the settings page. Contact us at support@mymovies.dk if you need help.
The application lets you evaluate using your full collection by starting a subscription trial. The subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled before the end of the trial period. You can keep the subscription, cancel it at any time and revert to being limited to 50 titles, or alternatively choose to purchase an unlimited 24-month service plan as a one-time purchase.
• Be sure to try our unmatched speed of batch barcode scanning combined with by far the best data coverage, and quickly enter even huge collections.
• Import existing collections from other apps, such as CLZ Movies, DVD Profiler, Delicious Library, Sort It! Apps, iCollect and many more, when you as others conclude that this is the app for you.
By using a required user account, your collection will synchronise through our online servers, allowing you to switch between different clients, also acting as a backup if a device gets lost or stolen, ensuring that you will never lose your data. We have clients available for all popular platforms. If you log in to an existing account, your current collection will automatically be synchronised to your device.
• Share your login with household members and keep your collection synchronised between all household devices.
• Connect with friends and view each other’s collections, watches, and similar within the app.
• Create an online collection to share with family and friends (https://oc.mymovies.dk/demonstration).
• Loan titles to friends and family to keep track, and never lose a title again.
• Parental control functionality.
• Comprehensive filtering options.
Notice! If you have a problem or a suggestion, please contact us at support@mymovies.dk. The quality and stability of the application is our top priority, and we will happily help you with any problems or concerns.
• Personalise titles with location, tags, notes, rating, purchase details and more.
• Watch trailers for titles in your collection, or in sections for cinema releases or upcoming physical media releases.
• Movie collections feature to see which titles you are missing from a specific movie sequel.
Our detailed data on the titles in your collection gives you many advanced options for browsing your collection, with extensive sort options, filter functionality, advanced search options, different views with many configuration options, a choice between a black or white interface, and much more.
• Create detailed PDF reports.
• E-mail collection as TXT or CSV.
The list of features is much longer. You may open the “Help & Support” section in the left side menu within the app to see presentations of many more features.
Terms of Use:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00121213:ios.description:
What makes Partyopoly the ultimate pre-party game?
Unlike other party apps, it's packed with mini-games that challenge your friends while turning up the energy and getting the party started! Whether you're spicing up a night in, getting hyped for a big night out, or just looking to stir up some chaos, Partyopoly is your go-to party essential. Think you can survive this hilarious showdown?
12 original modes, 12 party games: 
• Getting Dirty
• No Limits
• Bro Code
• Hot Mess
• Girls Night
• Warm Up
• Date Night
• Weekend Mode
• 5 Spicy Seconds
• Turn Up
• Say What?!
• Spicy Duo
These 12 modes come with 6 mini-games to take your party to the next level.
Here’s a sneak peek at two of them:
“The Right Color” - Tap the word that matches its color. Sounds easy… until it isn't!
“Super Reflexopoly” - A fast-paced reflex challenge. Let’s see how sharp you are after a few rounds!
Who’s ready to take on the wildest party game? Grab your friends and let the party begin!
_____________________
* This party game contains in-app purchases for even more madness.
* Play responsibly and know your limits.
* Feel free to skip any challenges that make you uncomfortable.
Premium pack & features subscription:
Partyopoly offers an auto-renewing subscription option: $6.99 per week. Once you've confirmed your order, the payment will be charged to your account, with the right price for your country. The subscription will automatically renew at its end date. You can stop the automatic renewal any time. To avoid the renewal, cancel it at least 24h before the end date of your subscription. No refund is available for unused time.
Terms & Conditions: https://gtmapp.com/privacy/terms-conditions/partyopoly/
Privacy Policy: https://gtmapp.com/privacy/privacy-policy/partyopoly/

bluejetty:00045889:ios.name: Exile Companion: PoE 1 & 2
bluejetty:00045889:ios.summary: Exile Companion is the Path of Exile app for your phone. Scan an item to see what it's worth, plan a complete build with its passive tree, gear and skills, follow live currency prices, and play the campaign without missing a reward — for Pa
bluejetty:00045889:ios.description:
Exile Companion is the Path of Exile app for your phone. Scan an item to see what it's worth, plan a complete build with its passive tree, gear and skills, follow live currency prices, and play the campaign without missing a reward — for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2.
What's Inside
• Item price check — point your camera at any item and see trade prices in the app
• Build Planner — import from Path of Building, or build from scratch in PoE 1 and PoE 2
• Live economy — currency prices, trend charts, top movers and a converter
• Currency flips — spot buy-low, sell-high spreads on the currency exchange
• Campaign guide — a step-by-step walkthrough with every quest reward marked
• Waystone Checker — see dangerous map mods before you run them (PoE 2)
Item Price Check
• Scan items straight off your TV or monitor — weapons, armour, jewellery, jewels, gems, waystones and more
• Add, remove or edit stats before you search
• See listings in the app, or open the official trade site with every filter already filled in
• Bulk Value Scan: price all the currency, fragments, essences and runes on a loot or reward screen in one go
• My Listings: see the items you have for sale and find similar ones
Build Planner
• Paste a Path of Building code or a pobb.in link and your build is saved on your phone
• The real passive tree in the game's own art — zoom in and tap any passive to read it
• Spend passive points, pick your ascendancy, equip and craft gear and set up your gems — your stats update as you go, in Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2
• Socket runes in PoE 2; pick mastery effects in PoE 1
Live Economy
• Buy and sell rates for currency and every exchange category, including divination cards in PoE 1
• 7-day trend charts and weekly change
• Top Movers: the biggest price swings over 24 hours and 7 days
• Watchlist: star the currencies you follow
• Built-in currency converter
Campaign Guide
• Step-by-step walkthrough for every act
• Boss tips and quest rewards highlighted — never miss a passive point
• Check off steps and pick up where you left off
Made for Console and PC
• Works next to the game on Xbox, PlayStation and PC — no overlay or PC add-on needed
• 8 languages — English, Portuguese, German, French, Spanish, Korean, Russian and Japanese — down to item mods and stat names
• No login needed; linking your PoE account is optional
• Text recognition runs on your device by default
Free to use. An optional subscription removes ads.
This is an unofficial companion app for Path of Exile 1 and Path of Exile 2 and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Grinding Gear Games in any way.
This app uses Apple's standard Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00022974:ios.description:
Stronger Training, Smarter Progress
One Rep Max helps you safely and accurately determine your maximum lift potential for bench press, deadlift, squat, and any other strength exercise - without risking injury.
Key Features:
• Precise Calculations - 7 scientific formulas for accurate strength predictions: Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi, Mayhew, McGlothin, O'Conner, Wathan
• RPE Integration - Factor in Rate of Perceived Exertion to fine-tune your max estimates based on how difficult sets feel
• Custom Exercise Tracking - Create and monitor any lift that matters to you
• Visual Progress - Beautiful graphs show your strength journey over time
• Percentage Charts - Quick reference guide for training percentages
• Goal Setting - Set targets and track your path to reaching them
Perfect for:
• Powerlifters optimizing their training cycles
• CrossFit athletes tracking multiple movement patterns
• Olympic weightlifters monitoring progress
• Strength enthusiasts at any level
Advanced Features:
• Choose between multiple calculation formulas for different lift types
• Track unlimited exercises with custom notes
• Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE) - Fine-tune your 1RM estimates based on how difficult sets feel
• Analyze detailed statistics including volume and frequency
• Set and monitor progress toward specific strength goals
The Science Behind The Numbers:
Our app employs multiple validated formulas to estimate your one-rep maximum based on your performance with submaximal weights. This provides you with safe strength targets before attempting potentially risky maximal lifts.
Safety Note:
Heavy weightlifting should always be performed with proper technique and appropriate spotting. This app provides estimates based on scientific formulas, but individual performance may vary based on experience level and training history.

bluejetty:00146284:ios.summary:

The PCOS Tracker is for you, if you
bluejetty:00146284:ios.description:
The PCOS Tracker helps you track your PCOS & PMS symptoms and also your periods on a calendar. You can download & share your tracked data as and when needed. Visit https://pcostracker.app to learn more.
The PCOS Tracker is for you, if you are a woman diagnosed with PCOS or if you think you may have PCOS, or if you are looking for PCOS support. It is your PCOS diary to keep track of your PCOS symptoms that may fluctuate every month around your periods, such as hair loss, acne, periods pain, extra hair growth and PCOS weight gain including daily diet, daily exercise. We use Healthkit to keep track of your steps and sleep. You can monitor your motor function and cognition by performing ‘active tasks’ integrated into the app. You may also get data insights and new health information on women’s health focusing on PCOS health, in blogs & articles updated in the Insights/References section of this PCOS app.
DAILY - MONTHLY PCOS SYMPTOMS TRACKING 
The daily log helps you note down your PCOD symptoms that you experienced throughout a particular day. The monthly log helps you note & track symptoms, specifically around your menstrual cycles. 
PREMENSTRUAL SYNDROME (PMS) TRACKING
Many of us experience physical discomfort or mood changes during the days before menstruation. When these symptoms happen month after month and affect normal life, they are known as PMS. You can track your premenstrual syndrome symptoms via the app. 
DOWNLOAD YOUR DATA 
You can download your data at will, if you need to see how you were doing all these days and months. For example, you can track what effects the new diet, or the new workout you started a few weeks back will have on your daily and monthly PCOS symptoms. Moreover, you can share the data with your health advisors, so as to have a clear communication, that may help plan your treatment and management of your condition better.
INSIGHTS VIA GRAPHS & CHARTS
The graphs and charts section of the app gives insights on how your PCOS buddies are doing, showing aggregate insights on responses filled in by PCOS Tracker users. 
LEADERBOARD 
Leaderboard keeps track of the number of steps you walked and keeps you motivated to do more.
REFERENCES & LINKS SECTION 
Find PCOS related news, research updates, and PCOS Tracker app related information in the references and links section. You can also get your queries answered & discussed by

bluejetty:00162890:ios.description:
What’s your face score?
FaceChecker is an AI-powered face analysis app that helps you discover your face score, facial balance, celebrity lookalike, face type, and personalized style tips.
Whether you want to understand your facial features, find your celebrity match, or get ideas for makeup, hairstyle, and overall style, FaceChecker gives you fun and easy-to-understand insights.
Discover your facial strengths, unique features, and beauty tips to help you enhance your personal style.
◎ Key Features
• Face Score analysis
• AI face analysis
• Detailed facial parts analysis
• Celebrity lookalike finder
• Face type analysis
• Face shape analysis
• Facial impression analysis
• Facial symmetry check
• Personal color analysis
• Beauty, makeup, and hairstyle tips
◎ Analyze your facial features with AI
FaceChecker analyzes your facial balance, proportions, and individual facial features to help you better understand your appearance.
The app checks elements such as your eyes, nose, mouth, face shape, and overall balance to show your face score, key strengths, and personalized style tips.
◎ Find your celebrity lookalike
Upload a photo and discover which celebrities you resemble.
You can check your facial similarity, compare your features, and enjoy the results as a fun way to learn more about your face or share with friends.
◎ Beauty, makeup, and hairstyle tips
Based on your face analysis, FaceChecker helps you understand what kind of style may suit you.
Use your results as a reference for makeup, hairstyles, fashion, and self-improvement. It’s a simple way to discover new ideas for enhancing your look.
◎ How to use
1. Take a photo or choose one from your gallery
2. Adjust your face to the guide
3. Let the AI analyze your face
4. Check your results
That’s it. You can easily discover your face score, celebrity lookalike, face type, and personalized style tips.
Discover your facial features and beauty insights with FaceChecker.
◎ Disclaimer
• Analysis results may vary depending on photo angle, lighting, facial expression, and settings.
• This app is designed to analyze facial proportions and features for reference and entertainment purposes.
• The results do not define a person’s value, beauty, or attractiveness.
• Do not use other people’s photos without permission or for harmful purposes.
• For details about photo processing and data handling, please check the app’s privacy policy.
• Performance may vary depending on your device and OS version.
◎ Contact
support@catos.jp
Privacy Policy:
https://catosjp.github.io/Web/PrivacyPolicy/FaceCheckerPrivacyPolicy
Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00065182:ios.name: Optum Bank
bluejetty:00065182:ios.summary: The Optum Bank app helps you get more out of your health account benefits. You’ll get clear tips on stretching every dollar. Plus, we’ll help you understand how to make your health savings account, flexible spending account or other spendin
bluejetty:00065182:ios.description:
The Optum Bank app helps you get more out of your health account benefits. You’ll get clear tips on stretching every dollar. Plus, we’ll help you understand how to make your health savings account, flexible spending account or other spending accounts work harder for you. 
WITH THE APP UPDATE, YOU CAN NOW EASILY: 
Keep track of all your account balances 
Unlock more ways to use your health account dollars 
Use your account to pay for health costs 
Find answers if you have questions 
Store your health care receipts all in one place 
Understand what may qualify as an eligible health expense 
VIEW YOUR HEALTH ACCOUNTS FROM ANYWHERE 
See your health account balances and contributions and view health spending and saving transactions all in one place. 
DID SOMEONE SAY SHOPPING? YES, WE DID. 
Get more out of your health dollars and understand what health costs are eligible (think allergy meds, acupuncture and thousands more). Then shop and pay with your Optum card or digital wallet. 
PAY BILLS, PAY EASILY, PAY YOURSELF 
Pay for health-related expenses, check and submit claims for reimbursement and easily capture receipts, all with a few taps. 
AND IF YOU HAVE QUESTIONS, WE HAVE ANSWERS 
Easily find out what you need or type away and send us an email. 
ACCESS INSTRUCTIONS: 
You will need to have an Optum Bank health account to use this app. Please visit optumbank.com if you’re an Optum Bank customer and need to update your account credentials. 
ABOUT OPTUM BANK: 
Optum Bank is advancing care, connecting the worlds of health and finance in ways that no one else can. Optum Bank is a leading health accounts administrator with over $19.8B in customer assets under management. By developing proprietary technology and applying advanced analytics in new ways, Optum Bank helps reduce costs while helping people make better health decisions — creating a better health care experience for our customers.

bluejetty:00142595:ios.description:
Introducing Aquaguard Genuine Service by Eureka Forbes - your one-stop solution for water purifier care! With our enhanced app, effortlessly book Genuine Service Plans (starting at just 599/-*), unlock personalized AMC discounts, schedule unlimited repair visits, request filter replacements, track service status, manage rentals, and stay informed - all in one user-friendly platform.
Here's everything you can do on the Aquaguard Genuine Service app:
Book Aquaguard Service Plan for your device(s) in seconds.
Buy or renew your Genuine AMC with custom plans tailored to your device.
Get amazing discounts on Genuine AMC Plans, with plans starting at just 599/-*
Request filters and spare replacement.
Access certified professional technicians in over 700 cities across India.
Schedule or reschedule service, repair and maintenance visits at your convenience.
Track your service request, Aquaguard service plan and AMC status.
Manage rental devices: Monthly payment, book and schedule service and renew subscription.
Stay informed on AMC plan expiry, maintenance due dates and payment history.
Receive digital invoices for your purchases and discover the benefits of Genuine AMC Plans.
Contact Genuine Eureka Forbes Customer Care
Also, get notified via push notification/SMS/WhatsApp/E-mail on payment invoices, service requests, AMC details and entitlements.
CHOOSE FROM WIDE RANGE OF GENUINE SERVICE PLANS - STARTING AT JUST 599/-*
Aquaguard offers a wide range of Genuine AMC plans - Base, Silver, Gold, and Platinum, tailored to match the needs and requirements of customers. These plans include unlimited repair visits, up to four free maintenance visits, free annual filter replacement, and free functional spare part replacement as per the AMC plan.
WHY GET AN AQUAGUARD GENUINE AMC?
With an Aquaguard Genuine AMC, your water purifier gets the care it needs to keep running smoothly. It includes regular visits by trained technicians, product and filter inspections, timely repairs, and free unlimited repair visits. 
*T&C apply. Visit www.eurekaforbes.com for details.

bluejetty:00153067:ios.name: Finger Chooser - Party Games
bluejetty:00153067:ios.summary: Finger Chooser - Party Games is the ultimate finger picker and party entertainment app! Enjoy fair, random selections with Finger Chooser, plus exciting group games like Truth or Dare, Most Likely To, Would You Rather, and 5 Sec Challenge.
bluejetty:00153067:ios.description:
Finger Chooser - Party Games is the ultimate finger picker and party entertainment app! Enjoy fair, random selections with Finger Chooser, plus exciting group games like Truth or Dare, Most Likely To, Would You Rather, and 5 Sec Challenge. Turn every decision into fun and laughter at your parties, game nights, and everyday gatherings!
Core Feature 1: Finger Chooser
• Finger Picker: Everyone places a finger on the screen. Get an instant, random winner with an exciting countdown, animations, sound effects, and haptic feedback. Fast, fair, and super fun!
• Finger Group Divider: Randomly splits people into balanced teams or groups. Perfect for team sports, parties, and board games.
• Finger Ranking: Instantly generates a playing order or numeric ranking. No more arguments about who goes first!
Core Feature 2: Party Mode Games
After picking a winner with Finger Chooser, seamlessly launch Party Mode for non-stop group entertainment:
• Would You Rather: Hilarious “this or that” questions that spark laughter and lively conversations.
• Most Likely To: Vote on who is most likely to do funny things — the ultimate icebreaker for any crowd.
• Truth or Dare: Classic truths and dares with versatile options ranging from family-friendly to wild challenges.
• 5 Sec Challenge: Fast-paced, high-energy timed questions to test your quick thinking.
Additional Fun Tools
• Coin Flip, Lucky Wheel, Random Number Generator, Rock Paper Scissors, and more.
• Customizable backgrounds, sound effects, and vibration feedback.
• Clean, modern interface — start playing in seconds with intuitive touch controls.
Ideal for Everyday Scenarios
• Deciding who pays for the next round of snacks or coffee.
• Choosing who goes first in board games, video games, or party challenges.
• Randomly dividing teams for sports, work activities, or classroom groups.
• Icebreakers for parties, school events, family reunions, and team building.
• Settling daily debates like “what to eat” or “what movie to watch.”
Subscription Information
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store Account Settings (Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions) after purchase. 
Privacy & Terms
We take user privacy seriously and do not collect unnecessary personal data.
• Privacy Policy:https://fingerchooser.mobiunity.com/legal/privacy
• Terms of Use:https://fingerchooser.mobiunity.com/legal/terms
Feedback & Support
Have suggestions or questions? Contact us at julianghuitong@gmail.com. We value your feedback!
Download Finger Chooser today to make every party and group decision quick, fair, and full of fun!

bluejetty:00171440:ios.description:
Want the latest local weather forecast on your mobile device? For any town in the USA, Forecast Now provides:
- the daily local weather forecast for the next 7 days
- the hourly forecast for the next 24 hours
- animated radar and satellite views
- hazardous weather warnings
- predicted snowfall totals (winter months)
- the air quality index
- the ultraviolet index

Weather and climate information comes directly from the US National Weather Service, NOAA, and the EPA.
Development of Forecast Now is funded in part by ads, which can be removed by selecting the monthly auto-renewing subscription option "Remove Ads" from the app's settings menu. Subscribing will also give you access all the GOES satellite imagery.
The subscription price of 0.99 USD (in your local currency) will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and, for each renewal, within 24 hours prior to the end of the current month.

Wondering what to talk about on your next date night, road trip, or after dinner conversation that's not focused on work, kids, or finances? 
Find out everything there is to know about each other and have fun at the same time with this Ques
bluejetty:00171655:ios.description:
Wondering what to talk about on your next date night, road trip, or after dinner conversation that's not focused on work, kids, or finances? 
Find out everything there is to know about each other and have fun at the same time with this Questions for Couples app.
With our Question of the day feature you can ask your partner a new question daily as a simple way to reconnect.
Or you can select one of the sixteen categories to get a deeper understanding of each other.
Finally, why not put on play mode and see who really does know each other best?
FEATURES:
• 16 categories of questions including topics such as fun questions, deep questions, and intimate questions so you can pick the perfect category for the occasion
• Over 1400 questions
• Questions to reconnect so you can get closer to one another again and give your marriage that booster
• Play mode option where questions are generated randomly for you in each category
• Surprise Me mode so you don’t know exactly what you’re getting
• Turn date night into game night with How Well Do You Know Me or Would You Rather?
• Ability to mark questions you’ve asked so you don’t repeat the same questions over and over
• Play anywhere, on a road trip, camping, date night or just at home
A great way for you and your partner to reconnect in your relationship.
Create better date nights and closer connections with this couples questions app.
Please note that Questions for Couples is intended for entertainment purposes only.
Questions or suggestions? Let us know at https://geardapps.com

bluejetty:00149154:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of organizing and matching goods in the delightful game Matching Master: Triple Goods! Are you a fan of relaxing sorting games that offer a perfect blend of leisure and challenge? Then you will definitely like this game!
In this captivating game of organization and triple matching, Matching Master: Triple Goods invites you to explore the exciting realm of sorting games where you can match and combine products in a fun and engaging way. Sort snacks, beverages, and fruits in triple-matching puzzles, unlock new products, and become a master of organizing cabinets in this addictive game!
How to play Matching Master: Triple Goods:
- Match the same items on the shelves to fill the and complete pairs or triple matches.
- Combine products with a triple match in the cabinets to progress through the levels.
- Enjoy the satisfaction of tidying up products and uncovering secret items in this triple-matching game!
Features of Matching Master: Triple Goods:
- Hundreds of well-designed levels for a truly immersive experience.
- Challenging puzzles that require concentration and strategic thinking.
- Handy power-ups to help you overcome difficult levels.
- Unique sorting styles to match the tiles in your own way.
If you're a fan of organizing games and matching challenges, give Matching Master: Triple Goods a try and immerse yourself in the world of sorting games.

bluejetty:00114178:ios.name: Brickify: Collection Tracker
bluejetty:00114178:ios.summary:
Brickify lets you scan your collectibles, see what they’re worth and track them over time. Trusted by more than 1M+ collectors.
Built by YouTubers and trusted by creators with more than 14 million combined subscribers to manage their colle
bluejetty:00114178:ios.description:
Brickify lets you scan your collectibles, see what they’re worth and track them over time. Trusted by more than 1M+ collectors.
Built by YouTubers and trusted by creators with more than 14 million combined subscribers to manage their collections.
Point your camera at a minifig or set, a Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Disney Lorcana or One Piece card, or a Funko Pop, and Brickify identifies it in seconds.
Scan one item at a time with the live scanner, or photograph a whole pile and identify everything in it at once. Brickify recognizes minifigs, sets and cards down to the set, variant and printing.
Every scan comes with a current market value and its price history. Compare raw and graded card prices, check a card’s condition before you send it for grading, and see how values have moved over time, so you know what you have before you decide to keep, trade or sell it.
Everything you scan goes straight into your collection, with a separate collection for each hobby. Brickify tracks what each one is worth today, along with what you paid, quantities, conditions and your gains or losses. Organize cards into binders and follow your progress toward completing each set.
When you want to look something up without scanning, search the full catalogs of sets, minifigs and cards, with prices for each.
Brickify is free to download. Some scanning and advanced collection features require Brickify Pro, an auto-renewing subscription that you can manage or cancel at any time in your App Store account settings.
LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group, which does not sponsor, authorize or endorse this app. Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Disney Lorcana, One Piece, Funko and their related names and marks belong to their respective owners. Brickify is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by these trademark owners.
Privacy Policy: https://brickify.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://brickify.com/terms

AI resume builder does the heavy lifting so you don't have to. Add information or import LinkedIn portfolio, and intelligent AI model instantly transforms your experience into a professional resume ready for real job applications in minutes. Every resume is an ATS friendly resume, engineered to clear the automated filters standing between you and job interviews. AI CV Maker is not just about building resumes, its a complete resume editor, ATS score checker and cover letter writer. Track your resume score and see exactly how ready your resume for ATS systems really is before you apply. With mobile AI resume builder, get polished cover letters, professional resignation letters or compelling CVs for modern job interviews. 
Struggling with what to write? Let AI do it and once it’s ready, take it further with a cover letter that makes recruiters stop scrolling. bluejetty:00072994:ios.description:
Pizza Maker is a fun and creative pizza game where players can enjoy the full pizza cooking experience from start to finish.
Designed as an engaging cooking game, it lets you create delicious pizzas step by step in a playful and easy way.
Start your pizza adventure by preparing everything from scratch. Mix flour, water, oil, and other ingredients to make your dough. Then roll it out, choose a fun pizza shape, and get ready to cook. This pizza game encourages creativity — your pizza doesn’t have to be round! Pick different shapes, spread tasty sauce, and add a variety of toppings to make your perfect pizza.
Once your pizza is ready, place it into a special oven and bake it until it’s hot and delicious. Watch the cooking process and enjoy the result of your work. With many ingredients and combinations available, you can create new pizza recipes again and again.
Key features:
• Make pizzas from scratch
• Mix ingredients and prepare dough
• Choose fun pizza shapes
• Add sauce and toppings
• Bake pizzas in the oven
• Creative and easy pizza cooking gameplay
• Perfect pizza game for kids
Pizza Maker is easy to play and suitable for kids, while still being fun for everyone who loves cooking games. Simple controls, bright visuals, and clear steps make it a relaxing and enjoyable experience. Kids can safely explore cooking, practice creativity, and have fun making food in this interactive pizza game.
If you enjoy pizza games, and casual cooking games, Pizza Maker is the perfect choice. Create, cook, and bake your own pizzas anytime and have fun in the kitchen!

bluejetty:00187197:ios.summary: The Square for Restaurants Point of Sale app helps you manage front- and back-of-house operations for your full-service restaurant, quick-service restaurant, fast-casual restaurant, bar, or brewery. Get the powerful point-of-sale system des
bluejetty:00187197:ios.description:
The Square for Restaurants Point of Sale app helps you manage front- and back-of-house operations for your full-service restaurant, quick-service restaurant, fast-casual restaurant, bar, or brewery. Get the powerful point-of-sale system designed to serve guests who are dining in, getting takeout, or ordering online. Handle orders, set up menus, manage table layouts, accept payments, enable coursing, get insights from real-time sales reports, and more.
ORDERS & PAYMENTS
* Turn tables faster and keep lines moving. Increase staff efficiency with an easy-to-use, intuitive interface.
* Empower servers to get every order right with the ability to enter orders the way people talk.
* Take orders even when you’re short-staffed with QR codes.
ONLINE ORDERING
* Create a free, customizable online ordering site.
* Manage all orders from your POS, including in-person, online, and third-party delivery orders.
* Reach more diners with Google, Instagram, and Facebook selling integrations.
MENU MANAGEMENT
* Create and customize your menus from the office, remotely, or directly from your POS.
* Keep service running smoothly with your staff always in the know of what’s selling and what’s about to sell out.
FLEXIBLE PAYMENTS
* Accept all major credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay so you never have to turn a diner away.
* Set up automatic tipping, move or assign checks to your staff, reopen closed checks, and manage voids with just a few taps.
* Never miss a sale with offline payments. Learn more at https://squareup.com/us/en/payments/offline-payments-guide. 
* Square handles all PCI compliance fees or chargebacks on your behalf.
* Get deposits in your bank account as fast as the next business day or access your sales instantly with a Square Checking account. Learn more at squareup.com/us/en/banking. 
FLOOR MANAGEMENT
* Customize your floor plan with intuitive click-and-drag layouts.
* Tip out staff, close out the cash drawer, manage comps and voids, and run close-of-day reports all from the POS.
* Keep tables turning by monitoring their real-time status.
* Stay on pace with coursing — letting the kitchen know when to hold or start firing dishes.
SUPPORT
* Customer support available to guide you through any questions.
Learn more about Square for Restaurants and set yourself up from Square Dashboard before activating this app on an iOS device: https://squareup.com/us/en/point-of-sale/restaurants

CSB Digital Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CSB Digital Banking:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CSB Digital Banking app, you must be enrolled as a CSB Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00060409:ios.description:
Share and connect with friends without worrying about hate, spam, or ads on the world's first toxicity-free social network, Wildr. 
[COMING SOON] MONETIZATION
Don’t have a huge following? No problem. At Wildr, we want to empower all users to become content creators and allow everyone to seamlessly monetize their content. Users will also be able to support each other directly through tips on the platform. NFTs and Wildr coins coming soon. 
AI-ENABLED FILTERING
We detect toxicity in any content our users put out, whether that be photos, captions, or comments. Scroll stress-free knowing that you won’t come across any triggering content on your feed. 
THE PROFILE RING

Here’s what else you can do with CSB4U:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CSB4U app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens Online Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00119955:ios.name: Calligraphy Handbook
bluejetty:00119955:ios.summary: It's proven that practicing calligraphy can quickly improve bad handwriting by a better understanding of letters' structure and proportion. Writing bigger letters helps to make curves and lines correctly. The beauty of the letters will make
bluejetty:00119955:ios.description:
It's proven that practicing calligraphy can quickly improve bad handwriting by a better understanding of letters' structure and proportion. Writing bigger letters helps to make curves and lines correctly. The beauty of the letters will make the task of writing more pleasant.
Calligraphy is also a very constructive leisure. It develops virtues such as patience, attention to detail, perfection, willingness to learn, and the sense of beauty.
Calligraphy is a full art form using letters, words and illuminations. It’s also a meditation process when your mind focuses on the strokes, beautifully draw lines and curves, following your intuition and inspiration. 
The only pre-requirement to this art is the knowledge of writing, which everyone is proficient. Calligraphy has a high potential of discoveries, it’s one of the rare art form that you can start from a basis you already know: writing letters and words.
1/ CALLIGRAPHY HANDBOOK is a perfect tool for learning and improving your calligraphy skill. As a beginner, the app will provide the best digital pens and papers for your learning. Don’t waste paper and ink now, digital tools are endlessly renewable. As a confirmed calligrapher, you will find pen and color effects that are impossible to create in real life: 6 small parallel lines, 4 size-lines, light effect pen, shaded line, rainbow effect, mixed colors in one stroke, alternated colors in one letter…
2/ CHALLENGE your friends in different writing styles, or simply evaluate your skill with the incredible calligraphy game. Reproduce a model inside a limited space, with a limited number of strokes, and see how many stars you can gain. Avoid actions as: undo, exceeding strokes or using tracing image. Otherwise your score will be heavily cut down.
3/ WRITING TOOLS:
- 11 calligraphic pens
- 1 pointed pen
- 12 mixed colors effects
- 12 alternated colors effects
- 1 eraser
- Smoothed strokes for all pens, let you draw perfect curves and lines.
NOTE: we have intentionally made the strokes slower and smoother, because drawing beautiful letters has to be done in a slower speed compared to handwriting or painting. Calligraphy is a highly relaxing activity, a slow motion is the best for it.
Writing features and supplies:
- 19 calligraphic hands in a large choice of styles (more hands are coming with future updates)
- Old papers
- Guiding lines
- Shadowed letters for tracing
- 24 preset pen angles
- 63 premixed colors
- Export your writing to the camera roll or by email.
- Palm rejection
- Pen offset
4 / ARTISTIC CREATION. Calligraphy Handbook is a truly comprehensive tool for creating calligraphic works (greeting card, invitation, letterhead, logo, brochure, magazine cover, etc ...
- Users can create true works of art with all the calligraphic tools.
- An entire page is provided with layers management.
- A gallery to save works in progress.
- The gallery is organized by blocks, each block contains an unlimited number of pages.
- The works and the blocks can be exported and shared in png or pdf formats.
- Shadows and texture can be added to your lettering.
5/ TIPS:
- Draw your letters very very SLOWLY.
- Take a long breathe before a long stroke, then expire slowly and regularly while drawing.
- Take a comfortable sitting position.
- Clean up your screen frequently. 
- When following the lessons in this app, don’t pressure yourself to immediately draw perfect letters, but simply follow your intuition and focus on the movement of the strokes. It’s not so important to get completely correct letters, don’t forget, it’s not typography.
- Relax yourself before starting a calligraphy session, you will have better strokes. Stretch and simply shake your hands and shoulders. Take a comfortable sitting position.

bluejetty:00141016:ios.description:
Unwrap the Magic in "Christmas Fables: The Magic Snowflake" - an enchanting hidden objects Christmas game! Are you ready for a magical journey filled with Christmas stories and puzzles that will leave you spellbound? Follow the jingle of the bells and fuel your Christmas spirit. The fate of the world may rest in the hands of a young boy, but it's your puzzle-solving skills and determination that will keep the sky from crashing down. Are you up for the challenge? Join our fun Christmas games to find hidden objects and discover collectible items crafted by Santa Claus and his magical helpers!
Santa's Toy Factory is on holiday overload (happens every year, get used to it). In an effort not to let his co-workers down, one of the elves has refused to take a sick day (elves getting colds, imagine that), and now there's a vexed 10-year-old kid walking the streets of the city with a very (very!) dangerous artifact in his tiny sweet hands. Now what do a common cold and an impending catastrophe have to do with each other, you may ask? That is something to be kept just between you and the aforementioned elf! Above all, please-please-please don't tell Santa!
Uncover hidden objects!
Explore the enchanting nooks and crannies of Santa's bustling toy factory as you search for hidden objects and gather essential clues. Your sharp eye will be your greatest asset as you piece together the puzzle of saving Christmas!
Explore a whimsical wonderland!
Venture into a breathtaking snow-covered landscape, complete with ice castles, twinkling stars, and a mesmerizing snowfield. Discover collectible items crafted by Santa Claus and his friends, uncover the secrets hidden within this Merry Christmas game!
Game-changing choices!
It's not just about finding objects, but about making important decisions that will shape the outcome of the Christmas stories. Will you have the courage and wisdom to influence people's fates and bring back the joy of the holiday season?
Christmas puzzles!
Experience the thrill of solving intricate puzzles, elf games and enjoy an array of object finding games that will test your cognitive skills and keep you entertained throughout your adventure. Earn a variety of achievements that showcase your problem-solving prowess!
Download the free trial of "Christmas Fables: The Magic Snowflake" now and experience the celebration of Christmas like never before!

bluejetty:00123645:ios.description:
WELCOME ALL WINE LOVERS! 
Whether you’re on a journey to discover the wines you like or have a full cellar at home, WineRatings+ is here to help you drink great wine, every time.
Trying to decide what to uncork with dinner? Picking out a special gift? With industry leading scores and tasting notes from the world renowned blind-tasters of Wine Spectator, WineRatings+ has recommendations you can trust. Browse hundreds of thousands of top-quality wines at your fingertips, and quickly save your favorites so you’re never hunting for something good to drink. 
WE ONLY RECOMMEND THE BEST
Our Senior wine tasters blind-taste every bottle to ensure an unbiased score and a lusciously descriptive tasting note. With over 40 years as industry leaders, Wine Spectator is the trusted name in wine ratings and reviews. 
TIMING IS EVERYTHING
Our expertly-assembled vintage charts will help you know exactly when your wines are ready to drink, past their peak, or should be held onto for a bit longer to achieve perfection.
SAVOR THE EXPERIENCE
Build a gift list, track bottles you want to try, and quickly add wines to your favorites. Add your own ratings, tasting notes, and photos. Have the perfect recommendation? Share wines and your personal lists with friends and family.
GET MORE OF A GOOD THING
We add over 1,000 wines every month so you have the most up-to-date wine ratings & reviews. What can we say? We love wine!
TRY US OUT
- Enjoy a 30 day free trial on us! 
- 1,000+ new wines added every month 
- 400,000+ expert wine ratings and tasting notes
- Seamlessly create wine lists and choose favorites
Please note that WineRatings+ is a separate subscription from Wine Spectator Magazine and WineSpectator.com. With a powerful mobile-optimized search engine and a bevy of features unique to the app, think of WineRatings+ as your wine guide on-the-go. Try it free and see for yourself! As always, our vintage charts and a wide selection of the latest news from the world of wine are freely available at WineSpectator.com.
Try WineRatings+ for free for 30 days. The all-access version of WineRatings+ requires a monthly subscription of $2.99(USD), which is auto-renewed. Payment will be charged to your iTunes/App Store account at confirmation of purchase. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes/App Store account settings; you must do so at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period to avoid being billed for the next cycle. Any unused portion of the free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.winespectator.com/pages/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00120634:ios.description:
A Stress-free Game You Can Enjoy While Relaxing Comfortably.
'Tap Tap Fish - Abyssrium' is an idle relaxing game that will relieve your stress and help calm your mind. Invite cute fish friends who seek comfort and relaxation in the aquarium. Relax and watch your aquarium grow bigger without trying hard. Fill your peaceful aquarium with a bunch of playful cute fish friends. Take a break from your busy daily lives and relax. Expand your aquarium and meet lots and lots of cute fish. The idle relaxing game 'Abyssrium' is a stress-relief game which you are definitely going to love!
Aquarium Full of Adorable Fish
In the idle relaxing game 'Abyssrium,' you can make friends with charming fish which you only came across on TV, in books, or aquariums. Meet magnificent and adorable whale friends including dolphins, killer whales, blue whales, humpback whales, and sperm whales in the game. Not to mention there are so many kinds of interesting friends awaiting you in the aquarium such as sharks, tunas, rays, lampreys, and even cats and cute dogs!
Recommended for People Looking for Relaxing Game
Leave everything behind for a moment and play the idle relaxing game 'Abyssrium.' Take a deep breath, play this beautiful game, and let your mind be stress-free. The beautiful and calming music, a variety of sceneries in the deep sea, and adorable fish friends will keep you entertained and stress-free. Just watching fish friends swim in the aquarium will help you feel relaxed and keep you calm. You will also be satisfied seeing the sea creatures grow throughout the gameplay.
Grow Your Aquarium with a Tap
The Lonely Corallite in the aquarium is eagerly wanting to make new friends. Invite adorable fish to be friends with the Corallite. Just go with the flow and tap to progress in the game. The Corallite will find comfort and keep growing. Cute fish and large whales will come to your aquarium in search of new friends. Create your own relaxing aquarium with the beautiful scenery of the abyss.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Subscription options
We have the following subscription periods in our game:
1. Weekly Diamond Membership offers weekly subscription for $7.99 after 3-day free trial which provides 200 Rubies , 1 Prop on a daily basis and Removes ADS.
2. Monthly Diamond Membership offers monthly subscription for $12.99 which provides 200 Rubies , 1 Prop on a daily basis and Removes ADS.
3. Yearly Diamond Membership offers yearly subscription for $64.99 which provides 200 Rubies , 1 Prop on a daily basis and Removes ADS.
End of trial and subscription renewal
This price is established for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Canceling trial or subscription
You can turn off the auto-renew for the subscription whenever you want to through iTunes. Check https://support.apple.com/HT202039 . When your current trial/subscription period expires, you will be unsubscribed. The current active subscription period can not be canceled. When your subscription expires, you will no longer be able to use elements included in Subscription option.
If you have any questions or comments, feel free to contact us at abyssrium_EN@wemadeconnect.com

bluejetty:00016286:ios.description:
Once upon a time, planet Earth was dominated by the dinosaurs, a species far more advanced than mankind: towering, powerful beings, and some of them could even fly!
Then a tiny rock fell from the sky and wiped them all out...but you can help them turn this dinoSOUR tale around!
Combine the different dinosaurs to create new mutations and bring an entire species back from the darkness of extinction!
After you’re done with that, you can even put your miraculous dino-creations on display on a jurassic era themed park built on a remote island. No one has ever tried that!
What could possibly go wrong, right?
JURASSIC FEATURES
• Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
• Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the dinosaurs
HOW TO PLAY
• Drag and drop similar dinosaurs to create new mysterious creatures
• Use dinosaur eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
• Alternatively, fiercely tap a dinosaur to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
• Different stages and many dino species to discover
• A mind-blowing story with paleolithic twists!
• The unexpected mix of alpaca-like evolution and incremental clicker games
• Doodle-like illustrations
• Various possible endings: find your destiny
• No dinosaurs were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
Just don’t forget to say the magic word. Ah, ah, ah!
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

bluejetty:00162448:ios.summary: ZEN.COM is a multicurrency account with a card and a digital wallet that make shopping and travel better. Pay at home and abroad, get more from every purchase and travel with peace of mind – all in one app. No need to switch banks – just sw
bluejetty:00162448:ios.description:
ZEN.COM is a multicurrency account with a card and a digital wallet that make shopping and travel better. Pay at home and abroad, get more from every purchase and travel with peace of mind – all in one app. No need to switch banks – just switch cards.
Pay better, get more, worry less
Pay with your ZEN Card in shops and online, cover your subscriptions and book your trips – by card, phone or watch. Hold up to 35 currencies in one account, exchange them at the best rates and see what you’ve spent the moment you pay. Shop like always and earn cashback at 1,000+ partner stores, straight to your account. And if an order arrives faulty, wrong or not at all, ZEN Care Shopping Protection deals with the seller for you. Higher plans add more: Reward Zone, unlimited Shopping Protection and help claiming compensation when your flight is disrupted.
Save money with cashback deals
With ZEN.COM, you earn cashback on online shopping at hundreds of popular stores. Cashback rewards work with well-known brands such as AliExpress and Temu, along with many other shops. Choose the best and latest deals, enjoy special cashback offers and get real money back – no points, no coupons. Saving on everyday online shopping becomes effortless.
Pay digitally and contactless
Use your phone or smartwatch to pay quickly and securely. Add your card to Apple Pay or Google Pay to pay contactless wherever you shop. Whether shopping online or in store, payments are fast and easy.
Multi-currency account with fair exchange rates
Hold and manage multiple currencies in one mobile wallet. Pay in local payment methods at competitive foreign exchange rates with no hidden currency exchange fees. ZEN.COM is ideal for online shopping, exchanging travel money, calculating currencies and international spending – helping you avoid unnecessary conversion costs as you track and plan your personal finances.
Send money simply
Send digital money locally or internationally with transparent rules and no surprises. Use ZEN Buddies to send money instantly to other ZEN users. All transfers and payments are visible in one place, so you always know where your money goes.
Secure payments and purchase protection
Your payments are protected with ZEN Care. If something goes wrong with a purchase, you can request support directly in the app. 
How people in the UK use ZEN.COM
• Emma shops online to find the latest hot deals at the best prices, and uses cashback rewards to save money on everyday purchases.
• Fleur pays her subscriptions and does her online shopping using the ZEN virtual card.
• James sends money, manages his personal finances and tracks monthly expenses in one app.
Why choose ZEN.COM
• Real-money cashback offers and fair exchange rates
• Secure digital and contactless payments in store and online
• One wallet for cards, transfers and spending
• Secure payments with purchase protection
• Clear pricing and full control over money management and expenses
Download the ZEN.COM app and simplify how you pay, send, track and save money every day.

Feed the animals, Gather the eggs, Grow the bees and harvest the fields. My Town : Farm is all about you having fun in the countryside. With all new characters you’ll get to play in the Farmers House and Fields, discover the different activities at the barn and visit the farmers market. 
FEATURES
- 6 different locations to play around in at the farm.
- New characters to add to your My Town collection
- Save state, no matter what you do, when you come back your setup will remain
- New clothing, New foods, A Cat with an attitude And lots of fun items to interact with
- Endless playability options and extremely long playing time
- Mix N Match machine that creates new items from the farm products you collected.
- Multi-touch feature - You can play together on the same screen.
* WHAT DOES CONNECTED GAMES MEAN?
 Connected games allow you to move items and character seamlessly between them as if it was one big dollhouse game made out of smaller locations. Want to bring the witch of a quick visit at the farm? How about bringing the old farmer to your home at My Town : Home? 
Connected games are: My Town : Home ( Free to download ), My Town : Pets, My Town Museum, My Town Haunted house. 
We are working hard connecting all of my town games, and we shall release monthly updates for older games as they get connected.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. Younger kids will enjoy playing together with their parents while the older kids can play alone or with a friend using our new multitouch feature!
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com or visit us on the MY TOWN Facebook page and twitter!

bluejetty:00036054:ios.description:
Quick Message - Click To Chat
Quickly message any number without saving contacts
Quick Message helps you start a conversation with any phone number without saving it to your contacts first.
Paste or type a phone number, choose how you want to message, and continue in your installed messaging app. It’s useful for replying to unknown callers, contacting one-time numbers, sending quick replies, or reusing messages you send often.
Key Features
Start a message without saving the number
Paste or type a phone number and continue quickly
Use your supported messaging apps installed on your device
Save quick replies for messages you send often
Create message templates for faster communication
Share numbers into the app from other apps when supported
Send messages to yourself for notes, links, or reminders
Supports local and international phone numbers
Why use Quick Message?
No need to save one-time numbers
Faster replies with saved messages and templates
Keeps your contacts list clean and organized
Simple, lightweight, and easy to use
Who is it for?
Professionals who frequently contact new numbers
People who want to reply quickly without saving contacts
Anyone who often sends messages to numbers they do not need to save
Disclaimer: Quick Message is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by WhatsApp LLC, Meta Platforms, Inc., or any other messaging service. WhatsApp is a trademark of WhatsApp LLC.

bluejetty:00118958:ios.description:
BILL Spend & Expense, formerly Divvy, is a free automated expense management solution that combines corporate cards with easy-to-use software to provide a seamless experience for managing your business spending and expenses. Track company expenses and get real-time budget insight so you can proactively make smart spending decisions.
AUTOMATE YOUR EXPENSES
Purchases are instantly recorded in the app, reducing manual input and allowing for greater efficiency.
GAIN REAL-TIME VISIBILITY
Live expense reporting and insights enables you to keep track of your company's expenditures as they occur.
PHYSICAL CORPORATE CARDS
BILL Divvy Corporate Cards can be issued to all of your employees for easy in-person spending.
VIRTUAL CARDS
Create as many free virtual cards as you need, providing a safe and convenient alternative for employees to handle business expenses.
STAY WITHIN BUDGET
Put proactive spend controls in place to prevent unapproved purchases and ensure that all spending aligns with company policies.
LET YOUR TEAM MANAGE APPROVALS
Customize transaction approval flows according to your org chart to stay on top of spending.
TRACK OUT-OF-POCKET EXPENSES
Easily manage reimbursements for spend that happens on personal cards and still stay within budget. 
MAKE MONTH END A BREEZE
Integrate your expenses with major accounting software such as QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and Sage Intacct, and make it effortless to manage your finances and close your books in record time.
Download the BILL Spend & Expense app to streamline your business expense management, save valuable time and resources, and gain real-time control over your expenses.
If you're looking to manage accounts payable and accounts receivable on the go, please download the BILL AP & AR app.
Disclosure: BILL AP/AR services are provided by Bill.com LLC; Spend & Expense services are provided by Divvy Pay LLC; BILL Divvy Corporate Card is issued by Cross River Bank, member FDIC.

bluejetty:00185899:ios.name: Basketball Arcade Hoops
bluejetty:00185899:ios.summary: Get ready for the ultimate basketball arcade challenge. Tap, shoot, and dunk your way to a high score in this classic arcade-style game. With quick controls, dynamic gameplay, and multiple game modes, it's perfect for casual players and hoo
bluejetty:00185899:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate basketball arcade challenge. Tap, shoot, and dunk your way to a high score in this classic arcade-style game. With quick controls, dynamic gameplay, and multiple game modes, it's perfect for casual players and hoop fanatics alike.
FEATURES
- Sharp and beautiful in all devices
- High performance, real basketball physics
- Four different courts, choose the one you like! Unlockable scoring different score levels.
- Quick opening, perfect for a quick session whenever you need it
- Daily ranking that updates as you play
HOW TO PLAY?
Easy! Score as much as you can within 60 seconds to achieve your record.
There are four different balls:
Normal: scores 10 points and gives you 1 extra second when scored clean
Super: scores 20 points and gives you 1 extra second when scored clean
USA: scores 30 points and gives you 1 extra seconds when scored clean
Extra: scores 40 points and gives you 2 extra seconds when scored clean
Mystery: scores 100 points and gives you 5 extra seconds when scored clean
Score lots of balls in a row to achieve better levels:
x2: 3 balls in a row
x3: 6 balls in a row
x4: 9 balls in a row
Play and share this game today.
Remember to rate the game with 5 stars if you like it. We love to see those 5 star comments!

bluejetty:00024652:ios.name: Epic Army Clash
bluejetty:00024652:ios.summary:
Can you think fast enough to merge all of your troops and fight against the enemy army?
Your quest is simple...use your strategy to combine the tanks or soldiers on your battlefield and clash against the enemies! Merge your troops, fuse yo
bluejetty:00024652:ios.description:
Can you think fast enough to merge all of your troops and fight against the enemy army?
Your quest is simple...use your strategy to combine the tanks or soldiers on your battlefield and clash against the enemies! Merge your troops, fuse your helicopters and tanks, create top world class elite squads and chose the target if you want to win!
Epic Army Clash is a cool real-time strategy game for everyone.
The main goal of the game is to beat all the enemies by combining your vehicles or soldiers. The enemies have good defense, epic forts, bridges and castles, so it will not be easy. Attack to capture the enemy bases all over the world! Get ready for rumble!
React and think quickly. Use your strategy and tactics to win the battle, blitz the level and move to the next location. Participate in epic action 3d battle on diverse levels and locations! You can find any map you like - forest, desert, jungle, city, and a lot more!
As a commander you may call for an air strike to call for a rain of rockets and attack enemies from above! Lock the target to bomb their bases and defend your units! Play like a kid, fight like a man in a war without limits!
Fight the huge boss after merging all your troops! In every step of this challenge, an enemy army with increasing power will wait for you! Apply your strategy in real-time war game, and spot the right combination to draw. Choose the target wisely and hear the rumble!
What will be the next right move?
Blitz the map in a mega battle all over the world map! In this game, you will be able to fight on very diverse levels and locations. City, forest, desert, jungle - clash them on any level - wherever you are! 
Unlock new and more powerful weapons and epic vehicles merging them!
Only 1% of players unlock all the units and win the challenge → are you ready for it?
Upgrade your tanks, other war machines, and soldiers from simple recruits and military cars to mega terrific weapons of destruction when you merge them. Use your finger to draw the right combination and evolve your units.
Remember, if you don't merge them fast enough, your enemies will beat you in the final round fight. Are you ready to rumble fight in this drawing challenge? Blitz it up!
Play for free. Challenge yourself to become the commander in Epic Army Clash...
This is not one of those classic and boring merging games. This is a new, free, and cool game in a war setting for boys and girls across the world!
List of the features of your new free casual game:
- Beautiful 3D graphics
- Become the strongest and most strategic mega commander in the World
- 100% free game
- Fun and addictive gameplay
- Easy to learn controls
- For kids and adults
- Game for girls and boys
- Many units, troops and vehicle to merge and clear the map
- Chose the level you like - jungle, desert, city, forest and a lot more!
How to become a successful world class general in Epic Army Clash?
- Display your troops on the battlefield
- Merge your troops to grow your powers.
- Get the most devastating tank on Earth
- Merge into a giant vehicle of destruction. 
- Choose carefully the directions where you want to move. If you don't upgrade fast enough, the enemy army will crash you.
- Upgrade fast, and fight all the enemies.
- Lock the target and win the rumble.
- Be brave and face the battle. Become the strongest army and defend the World!
If you believe that to become the Commander of the strongest army is not just a matter of luck, show your strategic abilities and conquer battlefield. Best of luck!

 • Whisper to it: Dictate quietly without disturbing anyone nearby.
 • Quick capture notes: Use the shortcut to save ideas instantly and sync with the desktop app.
 • 100+ languages supported.
Great for
 • Replying to emails while walking the dog
 • Drafting long documents on your commute
 • Responding to your team with full context, hands‑free
 • Capturing ideas after meetings or before bed

bluejetty:00019252:ios.name: Mortal Kombat
bluejetty:00019252:ios.summary: Get over here and immerse yourself in the iconic and visceral action of MORTAL KOMBAT MOBILE anytime, anywhere. Kollect legendary fighters like Scorpion, Sub-Zero, Raiden, and Kitana and fight in epic 3v3 battles set in the Mortal Kombat un
bluejetty:00019252:ios.description:
Get over here and immerse yourself in the iconic and visceral action of MORTAL KOMBAT MOBILE anytime, anywhere. Kollect legendary fighters like Scorpion, Sub-Zero, Raiden, and Kitana and fight in epic 3v3 battles set in the Mortal Kombat universe. This visually stunning fighting and card collection game has multiple modes and re-introduces characters and lore from Mortal Kombat’s 30-Year fighting game legacy. Launch into the action today and prove yourself in the greatest fighting tournament in all of the realms!
MASSIVE CHARACTER ROSTER
The roster is stacked with over 150 Mortal Kombat fighters spanning from the arcade days to the New Era of Mortal Kombat 1. Kollect the klassic fighters from MK3, legendary kombatants from MKX and MK11, and even reimagined fighters like Shang Tsung from MK1! The roster also features mobile exclusive variants like the Kombat Cup Team, as well as notorious guest fighters like Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, and the Terminator.
BRUTAL 3v3 KOMBAT
Assemble your own team of versatile Mortal Kombat fighters and lead them into battle to earn experience, level up your attacks, and knock out the kompetition in Faction Wars. Each fighter has a set of unique attacks, like Sindel’s Banshee Scream, and Kabal’s Dash and Hook. Strategize with different team combinations such as the MK11 team or Day of the Dead team to maximize synergies and get an advantage over your enemies.
EPIC FRIENDSHIPS & BRUTALITIES
Mortal Kombat brings its trademark Friendships and Brutalities to mobile! Equip your Diamond fighters with the right Gear and unleash these over-the-top and iconic moves. Hug your evil twin with Kitana’s Friendship. Feel the power of Nightwolf’s Tomahawk with his Skull Cracker Brutality!
LORE-BASED TOWER EVENTS
Fight to the top of single-player Tower events to unlock exclusive tower-themed Equipment and earn impressive game rewards. Battle through the tower levels and knock out Bosses like Scorpion in the Shirai Ryu Tower, Sub-Zero in the Lin Kuei Tower, and Johnny Cage in the Action Movie Tower. Claim victory and Test Your Might in the Fatal versions for an extra challenge!
THE KRYPT
Shang Tsung’s Krypt awaits! Choose your own path and crawl through the Krypt to find hidden treasures that lie beyond the Fog. Explore and fight through the map to earn Krypt Hearts and Konsumables to unlock featured Diamond Fighters and Equipment!
MULTIPLAYER FACTION WARS
Compete and fight with other players in Faction Wars, an online competitive arena mode where players duel against other player’s teams. Climb the ranks of your Faction’s leaderboard to earn seasonal prizes.
WEEKLY TEAM CHALLENGES
Prove yourself in epic battles and complete a series of matches to bring new Mortal Kombat warriors to your roster! Come back every week to take on different fighting Challenges and kontinue to expand and level up your game Kollection with fighters like Jade, Sub-Zero, and Goro!
KOMBAT PASS SEASONS
Earn a variety of rewards including Souls, Dragon Krystals, and more by completing specific game objectives. Ascend featured Gold fighters like Warlock Quan Chi and Aftershock Tremor to instantly make them stronger and unlock their ability to perform a Brutality!
FEATS OF STRENGTH
Unlock unique Mortal Kombat profile and victory kustomizations by completing certain character objectives! Design your War Banner to show off in Faction War fights and gain Kombat stat bonuses by unlocking certain Feats of Strength.
Download this groundbreaking, free fighting game TODAY and unleash your power!
