bluejetty:00127853:ios.description:
Nila Tamil Calendar 2026 - 2027 is one of my prestigious, closer-to-my-heart project that I wanted to bring to our tamil language lovers. The app will provide number of calendar functionalities and day-to-day utility features.
DAILY SHEET
The Daily Sheet of our loveable classic layout is being maintained here, so you get a feel of closer-to real life experience with the calendar app, the daily sheet provides all information such as timings, sun rise and sun set time, the day's importance and speciality and more over you will get your 'Rasi Palan' for your horoscope. You will also see a daily proverb as well.
I have, now, added a modern layout, which will give you more information in a better user experience.
MONTHLY SHEET
The Monthly Sheet provides the same old classic view of our monthly calendars, you will have all festivals marked in the calendar.
ANNUAL SHEET
Now, we introduced annual sheet for hollistic view of the year. One can easily track the marriage (muhurtham) days, government holidays, festival days etc.
PANCHANG
For panchang calendar lovers, we have added the panchang box view where one can find the positions of each planets on a given day, and also find out rasi transitions.
THIRUKURAL
Daily A Thirukural is implemented, so you get to know our great Valluvan's Kural a day.
HOROSCOPE
You will also see Rasi Palan for year 2026 & 2027, sani peyarchi, guru peyarchi palan, vaastu saasthiram, manai adi saasthiram, gowri panchangam etc. Now, we have added daily horoscope and monthly horoscope as well.
IMPORTANT DAYS
Marriage Days, Important Ritual Days such as Ammavasai, Pournami, Government Holidays, All Religion Festivals Etc.
TAMIL SIDDHA MEDICINAL TIPS
You have 1000s of medicinal tips as devised by our great Siddhargal. These are simple medical tips for every one and all age group.
TAMIL JYOTHIDAR NEWS
You will have daily news on Jyothidam from popular web portal (One India) via RSS Feeds.
BEAUTY TIPS
A set of 1000+ simple tips for maintaining our beauty (face, body, nails & hair) with easy to find & use tips for everyone.
MARRIAGE MATCHING
Now, you can also check the marriage matching between bride & bridegroom's horoscope, you can see all the 10 matchings, their result and importance.
NUMEROLOGY
This helps you to check your name spelling in accordance with your birth date as per international numerology. You can also check the relevance between two names.
DICTIONARY
Now you can search & find words in our in-built dictionary. It has both Tamil to English and English to Tamil dictionaries.
PROVERBS & WISHES
These are day-to-day proverbs and wishes we use, I have collected and provided them here. You can read them and share it with everyone.
SHIVA TEMPLES
I have also given the complete details of Shiva Temples in Tamil Nadu, this will be your reference for all the shiva temples and their history and importance.
AND MORE

Star Phase (For Nakshatra)

DAILY SHEET

The Daily Sheet of our loveable classic layout is being maintained here, so you get a feel of closer-to real life experience with the calendar app, the daily sheet provides all information such as timings, sun rise and sun set time, the day's importance and speciality and more over you will get your 'Rasi Palan' for your horoscope. You will also see a daily proverb as well.

I have, now, added a modern layout, which will give you more information in a better user experience.

MONTHLY SHEET

The Monthly Sheet provides the same old classic view of our monthly calendars, you will have all festivals marked in the calendar.

ANNUAL SHEET

Now, we introduced annual sheet for hollistic view of the year. One can easily track the marriage (muhurtham) days, government holidays, festival days etc.

PANCHANG

For panchang calendar lovers, we have added the panchang box view where one can find the positions of each planets on a given day, and also find out rasi transitions.

THIRUKURAL

Daily A Thirukural is implemented, so you get to know our great Valluvan's Kural a day.

HOROSCOPE

You will also see Rasi Palan for year 2026 & 2027, sani peyarchi, guru peyarchi palan, vaastu saasthiram, manai adi saasthiram, gowri panchangam etc. Now, we have added daily horoscope and monthly horoscope as well.

IMPORTANT DAYS

Marriage Days, Important Ritual Days such as Ammavasai, Pournami, Government Holidays, All Religion Festivals Etc.

TAMIL SIDDHA MEDICINAL TIPS

You have 1000s of medicinal tips as devised by our great Siddhargal. These are simple medical tips for every one and all age group.

TAMIL JYOTHIDAR NEWS

You will have daily news on Jyothidam from popular web portal (One India) via RSS Feeds.

BEAUTY TIPS

A set of 1000+ simple tips for maintaining our beauty (face, body, nails & hair) with easy to find & use tips for everyone.

MARRIAGE MATCHING

Now, you can also check the marriage matching between bride & bridegroom's horoscope, you can see all the 10 matchings, their result and importance.

NUMEROLOGY

This helps you to check your name spelling in accordance with your birth date as per international numerology. You can also check the relevance between two names.

DICTIONARY

Now you can search & find words in our in-built dictionary. It has both Tamil to English and English to Tamil dictionaries.

PROVERBS & WISHES

These are day-to-day proverbs and wishes we use, I have collected and provided them here. You can read them and share it with everyone.

SHIVA TEMPLES

I have also given the complete details of Shiva Temples in Tamil Nadu, this will be your reference for all the shiva temples and their history and importance.

AND MORE

Moon Phase (For Thithi)
Star Phase (For Nakshatra)
Utilities Price List (updated daily)
Tamil Monthly Sheet
Rasi Kattam (Horoscope Generator)
Gowri Panchang (based on the sun-rise time at your place)
Planet positions (Sani, Guru and Ragu & Kethu)
Palmistry
Audio Books / Stories
Pooja Corner (You can perform Virtual Pooja)
Aanmeegam (Spiritual) Q&A
Parigarams (For majority of life problems)
Dreams & its implications in our life
Moles & its implications
Kirubananda Vaariyaar Life History
APJ Abdul Kalam Life & Speeches
Mandiram for everyday life
Yoga Articles
First Aid
Baby Names
Compass
Calculator
BMI, EMI Calculator etc.

bluejetty:00170684:ios.description:
Bandle: The Ultimate Song Guessing Quiz & Music Trivia Challenge!
You have to recognize a song, but there's a twist. You only start with a single instrument. Can you guess the song with the least number of instruments playing?
"Bandle is the best Worldle-alike I've seen for a long while" - Tom Scott (Youtuber)
"Bandle - Now we're talking! Something good bro!" - Nathan Stanz (Youtuber)
Bandle has also caught the attention of Twitch personalities, including NorthernLion, theneedledrop and PooperNoodle, becoming a part of their daily gaming lineup.
How to play this unique music trivia quiz:
- Start with the rhythm: Listen to the drums and feel the beat.
- Add the bass: Let the groove set in and take your best guess.
- Add guitar, piano, and other instruments as the song builds up.
- Can you guess the song without all instruments playing?
Features:
- Daily Challenge and hundreds of songs available!
- Multiplayer mode!
- Great variety of latest hit songs as well as songs from the 70s, 80s, 90s, 2000s and 2010s
- Pop, Rock, Metal, R&B, Rap Hip-Hop, Hard Rock, Easy listening, Country, latin, alternative, funk, Movie theme and more!
- Musical Mastery: Learn to identify songs by their individual instruments.
- 9 Extra trivia quiz games to enjoy with friends and family: 
 - Can you complete the song's lyrics?
 - Spot the performer from photos.
 - Identify the band's lead member.
 - Guess where the artist hails from.
 - Answer trivia quiz questions about the songs.
 - Guess the song from the same year.
 - Guess the name of the album.
 - Guess the song with the same BPM.
 - Identify the song with similar instruments.
Whether you're a music lover or just seeking a unique way to enjoy a quiz night with friends, Bandle offers a symphonic blend of challenge and quiz entertainment. 
Download now and start your song guessing journey!

bluejetty:00149577:ios.description:
The Memoji app on Apple Watch Series 4 and later lets you express yourself and delight your friends and family with customized Memoji, created right on your wrist. You can choose from over a trillion combinations of skin tones, hairstyles, accessories and more to create a Memoji, then share it with Memoji stickers or show it off as a watch face.
Features
• Create and edit Memoji with a Memoji editor that has been optimized for Apple Watch. While editing, tap the Memoji preview to see your Memoji move and pose to give you a better look.
• Send a wide range of emotions to your friends in apps like Messages and Mail with Memoji stickers, which are automatically generated from the Memoji you create on any of your devices
• Have fun creating watch faces with your favorite Memoji or characters like Cow and Ghost, and customize with a complication and over 100 background colors.

bluejetty:00163003:ios.description:
Bine ai venit pe Eat & Track, cel mai rapid și ușor de folosit jurnal de nutriție cu alimente exclusiv din România. Aplicația noastră este mai mult decât un simplu calculator de calorii, uite de ce:
ALIMENTE ȘI REȚETE DIN ROMÂNIA
Peste 50.000 de alimente pe care le găsești în magazinele din România și sute de rețete cu instrucțiuni si informații nutriționale complete te așteaptă în aplicație.
JURNAL ALIMENTAR
Devii conștient de ceea ce mănânci, cât mănânci, cum mănânci și când mănânci.
OBIECTIVE PERSONALIZATE
Vei știi de câ te calorii ai nevoie zilnic și cum să-ți împarți macronutrienții pentru a-ți atinge obiectivul.
MĂSURĂTORI
Te ajutăm să menții focusul asupra ceea ce este important și să ajungi la rezultatele dorite.
COLABOREZI CU NUTRIȚIONIȘTI
- Alege nutriționistul și contactează-l direct din aplicație.
- Nutritionistul iti poate oferi planuri alimentare, activitati pe care sa le indeplinesti zilnic, antrenamente video, toate direct in aplicatie.
- Ești monitorizat îndeaproape și poți primi și oferi feedback prin intermediul chat-ului integrat.
ALTE FUNCȚIONALITĂȚI 
- Urmărește progresul și evoluția spre obiectivele tale cu rapoarte și grafice intuitive.
- Scanează codul de bare al alimentelor pentru a le găsi mai rapid.
- Nu ai găsit un aliment în baza de date? Îl poți crea chiar tu.
- Creează rețete noi, adaugă ingredientele, iar noi calculăm automat informațiile nutriționale pentru fiecare porție.
- Adaugi des aceleași alimente la o masă? Salvează combinația de alimente într-o masă salvată pentru o adăugare rapidă în jurnal.
- Monitorizează câtă apă bei zilnic cu funcționalitatea de Aport Apă din Jurnal.
- Generează lista de cumpărături direct din jurnalul alimentar. Adaugă-ți alimentele și rețetele în jurnalul alimentar în avans pentru perioada următoare iar noi îți generăm lista de cumpărături automat.
- Programează notificări iar noi îți vom aduce aminte să logezi ce ai mâncat, să bei apă, să-ți logezi măsurătorile, sau orice altceva ai nevoie.
- Logează-ți activitățile fizice iar noi estimăm automat câte calorii ai ars.
Toate functionalitatile de mai sus sunt si vor fi gratuite. Pe langa acestea, cu abonamentul EAT & TRACK PRO primesti acces la un set de functionalitati extra cu ajutorul carora iti va fi mai usor sa-ti atingi obiectivele si sa faci alegeri mai sanatoase.
- Idei de mese
Nu mai știi ce să mănânci și vrei o idee simplă care să se încadreze în caloriile tale? Primești acces la peste 300 de idei de mese, simple, rapide și gustoase.
- Poze progres
Pozele îți arată progresul în moduri în care cântarul și măsurătorile nu o pot face.
- Poze mese jurnal 
Cu această funcționalitate poți adaugă poze la fiecare masă din jurnal pentru a avea un istoric vizual al meselor consumate în fiecare zi.
- Prieteni
Îți vei putea adăuga prieteni pentru a împărtăși libraria personală de alimente și rețete, obiectivele, jurnalul alimentar și măsuratorile.
- Comparare Alimente
Compară două sau mai multe alimente pentru a afla care este mai caloric, mai bogat în proteine sau care aliment aduce un aport mai mare de fibre.
- Activități fizice
Ne integrăm cu Apple Health si FitBit pentru sincronizarea automata a pașilor și a caloriilor arse din activități fizice.
Alte funcționalități PRO
- Adaugă alimente, rețete, idei de mese ca și favorite
- Export jurnal alimentar și măsurători în Excel
- 
PRO este un abonament anual pe care îl puteți achiziționa direct din aplicație, achiziție care va fi aplicată contului dumneavoastră de iTunes. Puteți administra sau anula abonamentul PRO oricând, din setările contului dumneavoastră de iTunes. Abonamentul se va reînnoi automat, cu excepția cazului în care este anulat cu 24 de ore înainte de sfârșitul perioadei curente.
Pentru mai multe informații citiți Termenii și Condițiile la adresa: https://eatntrack.ro/termenisiconditii

bluejetty:00024857:ios.description:
Challenge your friends with these fun games for 2 players! Two players in the same device. Are you ready for an amazing party with friends? Senior games presents this multiplayer fun game for two people to play on the same device. Its 3D design will make you enjoy the mini games more realistically. Compete with your friends! Only one player can be the winner of the mini games offline! 
GAME MODES
- 2 player - With this multiplayer mode you can play to the mini games with friends on the same smartphone or tablet; from home, at school, university or during free time. Don't miss the crazy party for 2 players offline!
- 1 player - If you want to play alone to the mini games, this is your ideal option. You will have to face AI and compete against it.
This application contains quick and short party games for 2 players. The offline mini games are really addictive! The challenge consist in being the fastest! Some games consist of several rounds of play so you can offer revenge to your opponent.
FUN 2 PLAYER GAMES
Let's play the offline mini games and let the party begin! Within this game you will find different challenges to compete with your friends: 
- Color puzzle
- Duel in the Far West
- Space adventure
- Slapping
- Car fight
- Pinball
- Hockey game
- Ninja runner
- Basketball
- Jetpack
- Camel race
- Mathematical operations
- Ping pong 
- Hungry hippos
- Turtle race
- Disk battle
ACHIEVEMENTS
In each of the mini games in this collection of multiplayer mini games there are different challenges to overcome. Win 3 games in a row, win a game on hard mode, play games with friends and many more! Complete the different achievements, improve your skills in each game and become an expert in 2 player games. 
CHAMPIONSHIP MODE
The championship mode is a combination of mini games from the different games that appear in the application offline. A perfect option for those who like to try all the games. The winner of the competition will be the player who wins the most rounds!
FEATURES OF 2 PLAYER GAMES - PASTIMES
- Multiplayer: play against another person or against AI
- Available in several languages
- Fun and fast party games offline
- 3D design for a more realistic experience
- For all ages
- Completely free
ABOUT SENIOR GAMES - TELLMEWOW
Senior Games is a project of Tellmewow, a mobile game development company specialized in easy adaptation and basic usability, which make our games ideal for older people or young people who simply want to play an occasional game without major complications.
If you have any suggestions for improvement or want to stay informed about upcoming games that we are going to publish, follow us on our social networks: Seniorgames_tmw

bluejetty:00146326:ios.description:
Unleash your inner demolition expert in Captain TNT, the ultimate building destruction game! With a wide array of powerful explosives at your disposal, it's time to bring down structures in spectacular fashion. Strategize your blasts, place your dynamite carefully, and watch the chaos unfold as buildings crumble to the ground.
Features:
Variety of Explosives: Use dynamite, bombs, barrels, and detonators to demolish different structures. Challenging Levels: Each level presents unique challenges and structures to destroy. Realistic Physics: Enjoy lifelike destruction with our advanced physics engine. Strategic Gameplay: Plan your demolition carefully to achieve the best results and unlock new levels. apple-macos:6447647340.name: S3 Client - Files location
apple-macos:6447647340.description:
Access your S3 storage directly from the Files app, Finder, and other applications on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Developed by the creator of Working Copy, this application provides seamless integration with S3-compatible storage services.
Once configured, S3 buckets appear alongside other cloud storage providers, with files available on demand. Files are downloaded as needed and automatically synchronized back to S3 when modified.
The app supports a wide range of S3-compatible services, including AWS S3, BackBlaze B2, CloudFlare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO, and others.
Files and directories can be uploaded through the system share sheet on iOS and the Services menu on macOS. The app remembers preferred upload destinations for different file types, streamlining file management.
Pre-signed sharing links can be generated directly from Finder and the Files app, allowing temporary access to files for up to seven days.
Support for server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C) and client-side AES-GCM encryption compatible with the Amazon S3 Encryption Client.
Comprehensive support for Shortcuts automation enables operations such as listing, downloading, uploading, and moving files.
The app is free to use with a single server. A Pro Unlock is required for multiple servers, available as a one-time purchase or a monthly subscription, with access shared across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. A one-week free trial allows users to evaluate Pro features before purchase.

fdroid:it.allard.rassh.summary: SSH client on the real OpenSSH: ssh, sftp and scp, keys behind your fingerprint
fdroid:it.allard.rassh.description:
rassh is an SSH client built around the real OpenSSH 10.6p2 and LibreSSL 4.4.1. There is no SSH reimplementation: ssh, sftp, scp, ssh-agent, ssh-add and ssh-keygen are the OpenSSH programs, so what works with ssh on a computer works here, ~/.ssh/config included.
FILE TRANSFERS WITH YOUR PHONE'S STORAGE
• sftp and scp work straight from your phone's folders: Download, DCIM, Documents or any other
• Copy whole folders with put -r, get -r and scp -r, or many files at once with wildcards
• A file browser over SFTP to browse, download, upload, rename, delete and create folders
• This needs All files access, asked when you open sftp or scp without it. Without it, transfers work from the app's private folder
TERMINAL
• xterm compatible terminal with colours and alternate screen, for vim, tmux, htop and the like
• Two rows of keys a phone keyboard lacks: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, Home, End, Page Up and Down
• Several sessions at once, kept open in the background
• A host option to attach to your last tmux session or start one
HOSTS
• Saved as Host blocks in ~/.ssh/config: user, port, identity file, local, remote and dynamic forwards, jump hosts, and any other ssh_config option
• Reordered by holding and dragging a host, the order kept in ~/.ssh/config
• Your own blocks, Host * and Match included, are left as they are, apart from IdentityFile and CertificateFile lines kept pointing at your keys, and ssh checks the file before it is saved
• Quick connect with plain ssh arguments, like -p 2222 me@example.org or -J jump host
KEYS
• Generate ed25519, ecdsa, rsa and post-quantum mldsa44-ed25519 keys, or import your own
• Private keys with their public key move into a vault encrypted with a key held in the Android Keystore and unlocked with your fingerprint, a few, such as links, staying in clear
• Each connection gets its own ssh-agent, emptied once ssh is logged in, or after 60 seconds for sftp, scp and shared connections, so jump hosts, sftp and scp use the keys without writing them to disk
• A warning when a server's host key changes, with the new fingerprint to confirm
LOCAL SHELL
• Android's own shell and toybox, with the OpenSSH programs first in PATH, and access to your files with All files access
MOVING TO ANOTHER PHONE
• Hosts, keys and font size exported in one file encrypted with a passphrase
PRIVACY
No ads, no analytics, no tracking. rassh connects only to the servers you choose.
